    }

    td small {
      color: var(--mut);
      font-size: 12px
    }

    .act {
      white-space: nowrap
    }

    .act>* {
      margin-right: 4px
    }

    .act>*:last-child {
      margin-right: 0
    }

    .act button {
      min-height: 28px;
      padding: 2px 10px;
      font-size: 13px
    }

    .act a {
      font-size: 13px;
      margin-right: 6px
    }

    td.empty {
      text-align: center;
      color: var(--mut);
      padding: 30px
    }

    tr.click {
      cursor: pointer
    }

    tr.sel td {
      background: var(--accent-t) !important
    }

    tr.sel td:first-child {
      box-shadow: inset 3px 0 0 var(--accent)
    }

    .actbar {
      display: flex;
      gap: 8px;
      align-items: center;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      margin-top: 16px
    }

    .md {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(240px, 270px) minmax(0, 1fr);
      gap: 16px;
      align-items: start
    }

    .lc {
      position: sticky;
      top: calc(var(--hdr) + 16px);
      max-height: calc(100vh - var(--hdr) - 32px);
      overflow: auto
    }

    /* ---------- segmented switch ---------- */
    .seg {
      display: inline-flex;
      gap: 2px;
      max-width: 100%;
      overflow-x: auto;
      background: var(--panel-2);
      border: 1px solid var(--line);
      border-radius: 11px;
      padding: 3px;
      margin-bottom: 16px
    }

    .seg button {
      border: 0;
      background: none;
      padding: 6px 16px;
      min-height: 34px;
      border-radius: 8px;
      color: var(--mut);
      font-weight: 600;
      white-space: nowrap
    }

    .seg button:hover {
      background: var(--hover);
      color: var(--ink)
    }

    .seg button.on {
      background: var(--accent-t);
      color: #fff;
      box-shadow: none
    }

    .seg i {
      font-style: normal;
      font-weight: 500;
      font-size: 12px;
      margin-left: 8px;
      padding: 0 7px;
      border-radius: 99px;
      background: #ffffff14;
      color: var(--mut)
    }

    .seg button.on i {
      background: var(--accent);
      color: #fff
    }

    #bw[data-k=purchase] .pane-s,
    #bw[data-k=sales] .pane-p {
      display: none
    }

    /* ---------- bill stub ---------- */
    .split {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 300px;
      gap: 16px;
      align-items: start
    }

    .stub {
      position: sticky;
      top: calc(var(--hdr) + 16px);
      background: var(--panel);
      border: 1px solid var(--line);
      border-radius: var(--r);
      overflow: hidden
    }

    .stub .hd {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent), #3A50C4);
      color: #fff;
      padding: 12px 18px;
      font: 600 15px var(--ui);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line)
    }

    .stub .bd {
      padding: 16px 18px 18px
    }

    .stub dl {
      margin: 0;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr auto;
      gap: 8px 12px;
      color: var(--mut)
    }

    .stub dd {
      margin: 0;
      text-align: right;
      color: var(--ink);
      font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums
    }

    .stub .tt {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: baseline;
      margin: 16px 0;
      padding-top: 14px;
      border-top: 1px dashed var(--line);
      position: relative
    }

    .stub .tt b {
      font: 700 26px var(--ui);
      letter-spacing: -.01em;
      font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
      color: var(--ink)
    }

    .stub .tt::before,
    .stub .tt::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      top: -9px;
      width: 16px;
      height: 16px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--bg);
      border: 1px solid var(--line)
    }

    .stub .tt::before {
      left: -27px
    }

    .stub .tt::after {
      right: -27px
    }

    .stub button+button {
      margin-top: 8px
    }

    #sbd p {
      margin: 0 0 14px
    }

    /* ---------- voucher balance bar ---------- */
    .bar {
      position: sticky;
      bottom: 14px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 18px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      background: var(--panel);
      border: 1px solid var(--line);
      border-radius: var(--r);
      padding: 12px 18px;
      box-shadow: 0 10px 30px -12px #0009
    }

    #tot {
      display: flex;
      gap: 22px;
      align-items: center;
      font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums
    }

    #tot span {
      color: var(--mut)
    }

    #tot b {
      font-weight: 650;
      margin-left: 6px;
      color: var(--ink)
    }

    #tot .ok {
      color: var(--ok)
    }

    #tot .err {
      color: var(--err)
    }

    #tot .ok b,
    #tot .err b {
      color: inherit;
      margin-left: 0
    }

    .bar .sp {
      margin-left: auto;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      flex-wrap: wrap
    }

    /* ---------- figure strips ---------- */
    .vat {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(190px, 1fr));
      margin-bottom: 16px;
      background: var(--panel);
      border: 1px solid var(--line);
      border-radius: var(--r);
      overflow: hidden
    }

    .vat>div {
      min-width: 0;
      padding: 14px 18px;
      border-right: 1px solid var(--line);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
      margin: 0 -1px -1px 0
    }

    .vat span {
      display: block;
      font-size: 12.5px;
      color: var(--mut)
    }

    .vat b {
      display: block;
      margin-top: 2px;
      font: 650 22px/1.3 var(--ui);
      letter-spacing: -.01em;
      font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
      overflow-wrap: anywhere;
      color: var(--ink)
    }

    .vat small {
      display: block;
      color: var(--mut);
      font-size: 12px;
      margin-top: 2px
    }

    .vat .net {
      background: var(--accent-t);
      color: #fff
    }

    .vat .net span,
    .vat .net small {
      color: #A9B6FF
    }

    .vat .net b {
      color: #fff
    }

    .vat.k4 {
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr))
    }

    .card>.vat {
      border-radius: 10px
    }

    /* ---------- toast ---------- */
    #toast {
      display: none;
      position: fixed;
      right: 22px;
      bottom: 22px;
      max-width: 440px;
      background: var(--panel-2);
      color: var(--ink);
      padding: 13px 18px;
      border-radius: 12px;
      border: 1px solid var(--line);
      border-left: 4px solid var(--accent);
      box-shadow: 0 18px 40px -12px #000b;
      white-space: pre-line;
      overflow-wrap: anywhere;
      z-index: 20;
      animation: tin .22s ease-out
    }

    @keyframes tin {
      from {
        opacity: 0;
        transform: translateY(10px)
      }
    }

    /* ---------- dashboard ---------- */
    .dash {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(420px, 100%), 1fr));
      gap: 16px;
      align-items: start
    }

    .dash .card {
      margin: 0
    }

    .dash .full {
      grid-column: 1/-1
    }

    .hb {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(70px, 130px) 1fr auto;
      gap: 2px 12px;
      align-items: center;
      margin: 10px 0;
      font-size: 13px
    }

    .hb>span {
      overflow: hidden;
      text-overflow: ellipsis;
      white-space: nowrap
    }

    .hb>div {
      background: var(--panel-2);
      border-radius: 99px;
      height: 10px
    }

    .hb i {
      display: block;
      height: 100%;
      border-radius: 99px
    }

    .hb b {
      font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
      font-weight: 600
    }

    .hb small {
      grid-column: 2/-1;
      color: var(--mut);
      font-size: 12px
    }

    .lg {
      display: flex;
      gap: 16px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      margin: 8px 0 0;
      font-size: 12px;
      color: var(--mut)
    }

    .lg i,
    .lgi i {
      display: inline-block;
      width: 10px;
      height: 10px;
      border-radius: 3px;
      margin-right: 6px
    }

    .dn {
      display: flex;
      gap: 20px;
      align-items: center;
      flex-wrap: wrap
    }

    .dn>div {
      min-width: 170px;
      flex: 1
    }

    .lgi {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      font-size: 13px;
      margin: 6px 0
    }

    .lgi b {
      margin-left: auto;
      padding-left: 14px;
      font-weight: 600
    }

    .fl {
      display: flex;
      gap: 8px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      align-items: center
    }

    .fl input,
    .fl select {
      width: auto;
      min-width: 130px
    }

    .fl input[type=search] {
      min-width: 260px;
      flex: 1
    }

    .fl label {
      flex-direction: row;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px
    }

    .ag {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(240px, 1fr));
      gap: 24px
    }

    .ag h3 {
      margin: 0 0 6px;
      font: 600 13px var(--ui);
      color: var(--ink)
    }

    /* ---------- collapsed sidebar ---------- */
    @media(min-width:861px) {
      .app {
        transition: grid-template-columns .18s ease
      }

      .app.sc {
        grid-template-columns: 68px minmax(0, 1fr)
      }

      .sc .side {
        padding: 18px 8px 12px
      }

      .sc .brand {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 10px;
        padding: 0 0 12px
      }

      .sc .brand .full,
      .sc .brand .lat,
      .sc .co {
        display: none
      }

      .sc .brand .short {
        display: inline
      }

      .sc .brand .dev {
        font-size: 24px
      }

      .sc .tog {
        position: static
      }

      .sc .tog svg {
        transform: rotate(180deg)
      }

      .sc .ng {
        height: 1px;
        margin: 10px 10px;
        padding: 0;
        font-size: 0;
        background: var(--line)
      }

      .sc .side nav button {
        justify-content: center;
        padding: 7px 0
      }

      .sc .side nav button span {
        display: none
      }

      .sc .side nav button.on {
        box-shadow: none
      }
    }

    /* ---------- responsive ---------- */
    @media(max-width:1100px) {
      .vat.k4 {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr))
      }
    }

    @media(max-width:1000px) {
      .split {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr
      }

      .stub {
        position: static
      }

      .md {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr
      }

      .lc {
        position: static;
        max-height: none
      }
    }

    @media(max-width:860px) {
      .app {
        grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr)
      }

      .side {
        position: static;
        height: auto;
        padding: 10px 10px 0;
        overflow: visible;
        border-right: 0;
        border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line)
      }

      .side::after,
      .co,
      .ng,
      .tog {
        display: none
      }

      .brand {
        display: flex;
        align-items: baseline;
        gap: 10px;
        padding: 0 6px 8px;
        margin: 0;
        border: 0
      }

      .brand .dev {
        font-size: 24px
      }

      .brand .lat {
        margin: 0
      }

      .side nav {
        flex: none;
        display: flex;
        overflow-x: auto;
        gap: 2px;
        padding-bottom: 8px
      }

      .side nav button {
        width: auto;
        white-space: nowrap
      }

      .side nav button.on {
        box-shadow: inset 0 -3px 0 var(--accent)
      }

      .top {
        position: static;
        padding: 12px 14px
      }

      .period {
        margin-left: 0;
        flex-wrap: wrap
      }

      main {
        padding: 16px 12px 60px
      }

      .row .w2 {
        grid-column: auto
      }

      .vat.k4 {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr))
      }

      .vat b {
        font-size: 19px
      }
    }

    @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) {
      * {
        transition: none !important;
        animation: none !important
      }
    }

    @media print {

      .side,
      .tws,
      .period,
      .tool,
      button,
      .bar,
      .seg {
        display: none !important
      }

      .app {
        display: block
      }

      .top {
        position: static;
        border: 0;
        background: none
      }

      main {
        padding: 0;
        max-width: none
      }

      .card {
        border: 0;
        padding: 0
      }
    }

    @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) {
      * {
        transition: none !important;
        animation: none !important
      }
    }

    @media print {

      .side,
      .tws,
      .period,
      .tool,
      button,
      .bar,
      .seg {
        display: none !important
      }

      .app {
        display: block
      }

      .top {
        position: static;
        border: 0;
        background: none
      }

      main {
        padding: 0;
        max-width: none
      }

      .card {
        border: 0;
        padding: 0
      }
    }

    /* ===== roomier layout ===== */
    main {
      max-width: 1440px;
      padding: 28px 32px 80px
    }

    :root {
      --hdr: 72px;
      --pad: 24px
    }

    .top {
      padding: 14px 32px
    }

    .card {
      padding: var(--pad)
    }

    .card>.ch {
      margin: -4px 0 18px
    }

    .fh {
      margin: 28px 0 12px
    }

    /* forms: wider fields, wrap sooner */
    .row {
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(240px, 100%), 1fr));
      gap: 16px 18px;
      margin-bottom: 10px
    }

    .row label,
    .fld {
      gap: 7px
    }

    @media(max-width:720px) {
      .row .w2 {
        grid-column: 1/-1
      }
    }

    .card .row:has(.chk) {
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(220px, 100%), 1fr));
      gap: 10px 14px
    }

    /* tables: more padding */
    th,
    td {
      padding: 13px 14px
    }

    th {
      padding-top: 12px;
      padding-bottom: 12px
    }

    tr.t td {
      padding-top: 14px;
      padding-bottom: 14px
    }

    /* left list panels: wider, wrap names instead of truncating */
    .md {
      grid-template-columns: minmax(280px, 320px) minmax(0, 1fr);
      gap: 20px
    }

    @media(max-width:1000px) {
      .md {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr
      }
    }

    .lc .tw td:first-child {
      white-space: normal;
      overflow-wrap: anywhere
    }

    .lc .tw td:first-child b {
      line-height: 1.35
    }

    /* bill stub + voucher bar */
    .split {
      gap: 20px;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 320px
    }

    .stub .bd {
      padding: 18px 20px 20px
    }

    .stub .hd {
      padding: 14px 20px
    }

    .bar {
      padding: 14px 20px;
      gap: 22px
    }

    #tot {
      gap: 28px
    }

    /* voucher line items */
    #ls td:nth-child(1) {
      min-width: 260px
    }

    #ls td:nth-child(2),
    #ls td:nth-child(3) {
      width: 180px
    }

    #ls td:nth-child(4) {
      width: 48px
    }

    #ls td input {
      padding: 8px 10px
    }

    #ls+table th.n {
      width: 180px !important
    }

    /* figures + dashboard */
    .vat>div {
      padding: 18px 20px
    }

    .vat b {
      font-size: 24px;
      margin-top: 4px
    }

    .dash {
      gap: 20px
    }

    .lg {
      margin-top: 12px;
      gap: 20px
    }

    .hb {
      margin: 12px 0;
      gap: 4px 14px
    }
  </style>
</head>

<body>
  <div class="app">
    <aside class="side">
      <div class="brand">
        <div class="dev" lang="ne"><span class="full">लेखा</span><span class="short">ले</span></div>
        <div class="lat">Travel &amp; Tours accounts</div>
        <button class="tog" id="sbtog" type="button" onclick="toggleSide()"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true">
            <path d="m15 6-6 6 6 6" />
          </svg></button>
      </div>
      <nav id="nav" aria-label="Main"></nav>
      <div class="co"><b id="co"></b><span id="cov"></span></div>
    </aside>
    <div class="pg">
      <header class="top">
        <div class="tt">
          <h1 id="pgt"></h1>
          <p id="pgs"></p>
        </div>
        <div class="period" id="period"><span>Period</span><input type="date" id="from" aria-label="From date"
            onchange="if(!NOPERIOD.includes(tab))render()"><span aria-hidden="true">to</span><input type="date" id="to"
            aria-label="To date" onchange="if(!NOPERIOD.includes(tab))render()">
          <select id="pq" aria-label="Quick range" onchange="quickPeriod(this.value)">
            <option value="">Quick range</option>
            <option value="fy">This fiscal year</option>
            <option value="pfy">Last fiscal year</option>
            <option value="m">This month</option>
            <option value="all">All dates</option>
          </select>
        </div>
      </header>
      <main id="m"></main>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div id="toast" role="status" aria-live="polite"></div><datalist id="al"></datalist><datalist
    id="pls"></datalist><datalist id="plc"></datalist><datalist id="stf"></datalist>
  <script>
    let D, tab = 'dash'; const $ = s => document.querySelector(s);
    const ymd = (d = new Date()) => d.getFullYear() + '-' + String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0') + '-' + String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0'); // local date, not UTC
    const f = n => (+n).toLocaleString('en-IN', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 }); // lakh/crore grouping
    const esc = s => String(s ?? '').replace(/[&<>"]/g, c => ({ '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;' }[c]));
    const TABS = { dash: 'Dashboard', rec: 'Records', stmt: 'Statements', sal: 'Salary payment', voucher: 'New voucher', bills: 'Purchase & sales bills', rcv: 'Payments received', pay: 'Payments made', reg: 'VAT registers', daybook: 'Day book', ledger: 'Ledger', tb: 'Trial balance', pl: 'Income statement', bs: 'Balance sheet', coa: 'Accounts', parties: 'Parties', settings: 'Settings' };
    const ic = p => `<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true">${p}</svg>`;
    const IC = {
      dash: ic('<rect x="3" y="3" width="7" height="9" rx="1.5"/><rect x="14" y="3" width="7" height="5" rx="1.5"/><rect x="14" y="12" width="7" height="9" rx="1.5"/><rect x="3" y="16" width="7" height="5" rx="1.5"/>'),
      rec: ic('<path d="M4 4h16v5H4z"/><path d="M5 9v10a1 1 0 0 0 1 1h12a1 1 0 0 0 1-1V9"/><path d="M10 13h4"/>'),
      stmt: ic('<path d="M14 3H7a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v14a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h10a2 2 0 0 0 2-2V8Z"/><path d="M14 3v5h5"/><path d="M9 13h6M9 17h6"/>'),
      sal: ic('<rect x="3" y="6" width="18" height="14" rx="2"/><path d="M3 10h18"/><circle cx="16.5" cy="15" r="1"/>'),
      voucher: ic('<path d="M12 20h9"/><path d="M16.5 3.5a2.1 2.1 0 0 1 3 3L7 19l-4 1 1-4Z"/>'),
      bills: ic('<path d="M5 3h14v18l-2.3-1.5L14.3 21 12 19.5 9.7 21l-2.4-1.5L5 21Z"/><path d="M9 8h6M9 12h6"/>'),
      rcv: ic('<path d="M12 3v12"/><path d="m7 10 5 5 5-5"/><path d="M4 17v2a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h12a2 2 0 0 0 2-2v-2"/>'),
      pay: ic('<path d="M12 15V3"/><path d="m7 8 5-5 5 5"/><path d="M4 17v2a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h12a2 2 0 0 0 2-2v-2"/>'),
      reg: ic('<path d="M5 3h12a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v16H7a2 2 0 0 1-2-2Z"/><path d="M5 19a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h12"/><path d="M9 7h6M9 11h6"/>'),
      daybook: ic('<rect x="3" y="5" width="18" height="16" rx="2"/><path d="M3 10h18M8 3v4M16 3v4"/>'),
      ledger: ic('<path d="M12 6.5C10.5 5 8 4.5 3 4.5v14c5 0 7.5.5 9 2 1.5-1.5 4-2 9-2v-14c-5 0-7.5.5-9 2Z"/><path d="M12 6.5v14"/>'),
      tb: ic('<path d="M12 3v18M7 21h10"/><path d="M5 7h14"/><path d="m5 7-3 7a4 4 0 0 0 6 0Z"/><path d="m19 7-3 7a4 4 0 0 0 6 0Z"/>'),
      pl: ic('<path d="m3 17 6-6 4 4 8-8"/><path d="M15 7h6v6"/>'),
      bs: ic('<rect x="3" y="4" width="18" height="16" rx="2"/><path d="M12 4v16"/><path d="M6.5 9h2M6.5 13h2M15.5 9h2M15.5 13h2"/>'),
      coa: ic('<path d="M8 6h13M8 12h13M8 18h13"/><path d="M3 6h.01M3 12h.01M3 18h.01"/>'),
      parties: ic('<circle cx="9" cy="8" r="3.5"/><path d="M2.5 20a6.5 6.5 0 0 1 13 0"/><path d="M16 4.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 0 7"/><path d="M18 14a6 6 0 0 1 3.5 6"/>'),
      settings: ic('<path d="M3 7h9M16 7h5"/><circle cx="14" cy="7" r="2"/><path d="M3 17h5M12 17h9"/><circle cx="10" cy="17" r="2"/>')
    };
    const TSUB = {
      dash: 'How the business is doing in the selected period.',

    const NAV = [['Overview', ['dash']], ['Enter', ['voucher', 'bills', 'rcv', 'pay', 'sal']], ['Records', ['rec', 'stmt', 'daybook']], ['Books', ['ledger', 'reg']], ['Reports', ['tb', 'pl', 'bs']], ['Setup', ['coa', 'parties', 'settings']]];
    const NOPERIOD = ['voucher', 'bills', 'rcv', 'pay', 'sal', 'rec', 'stmt', 'coa', 'parties', 'settings'];

    const ofType = t => D.accounts.filter(a => t.includes(a.type));

    const hid = () => { const n = D.vouchers.filter(v => v.date < FR() || v.date > TO()).length; return n ? `<div class="warn err">${n} voucher(s) have dates outside ${FR()} to ${TO()}, so they are not fully shown here. <button onclick="showAll()">Show all dates</button></div>` : ''; };
    function quickPeriod(k) {
      const t = new Date(), p = n => String(n).padStart(2, '0'), s = (y, m, d) => y + '-' + p(m) + '-' + p(d), fy = t.getMonth() > 5 && !(t.getMonth() == 6 && t.getDate() < 16) ? t.getFullYear() : t.getFullYear() - 1; $('#pq').value = '';
      if (k == 'all') return showAll();
      const r = { fy: [s(fy, 7, 16), s(fy + 1, 7, 15)], pfy: [s(fy - 1, 7, 16), s(fy, 7, 15)], m: [s(t.getFullYear(), t.getMonth() + 1, 1), s(t.getFullYear(), t.getMonth() + 1, new Date(t.getFullYear(), t.getMonth() + 1, 0).getDate())] }[k];
      if (!r) return; $('#from').value = r[0]; $('#to').value = r[1]; if (!NOPERIOD.includes(tab)) render();

    const badAD = d => d && +d.slice(0, 4) > 2060 && (alert('The Date (AD) field says year ' + d.slice(0, 4) + ', which looks like a BS date. Put the English (AD) date there and type the BS date in the BS field.'), true);
    const resolveAcc = t => {

      const part = A.filter(a => a.name.toLowerCase().includes(t)); return part.length == 1 ? part[0].code : null;

    async function load() { D = await (await fetch('/api/data')).json(); render(); const o = (D.settings || {}).folderOwner; if (o && !o.ok && !window.ownWarned) { window.ownWarned = 1; alert('Warning: the storage folder (' + D.settings.folder + ') belongs to another copy of this app:\n' + o.owner + '\n\nThis copy will NOT write or delete any files there, so nothing is overwritten. If this is a copy you only wanted to try, set a different storage folder under Settings. If you moved the project, open Settings and press Save settings to take the folder over.'); } }
    async function rebuildFiles() {

'\n\n' + j.orphanCount + ' file(s) in the folder do not belong to any voucher here (maybe made by another copy). They were left alone:\n' + j.orphans.slice(0, 25).join(', ') + (j.orphanCount > 25 ? ', …' : '') : ''));

    function render() {

' aria-current="page"' : ''} onclick="tab='${k}';window.eb=window.ev=window.er=window.rnew=window.pye=window.pyn=window.sle=window.sls=window.slp=window.bm=window.bke=null;render()">${IC[k]}<span>${TABS[k]}</span></button>`).join('')).join('');

    function addLine(l) {

  <td><button class="x" title="Remove line" onclick="this.closest('tr').remove();calc()">×</button></td></tr>`);
    }
    function calc() {
      let d = 0, c = 0; document.querySelectorAll('#ls tr').forEach(r => { const ac = r.querySelector('.ac'); ac.style.borderColor = ac.value && !resolveAcc(ac.value) ? '#B42318' : ''; d += +r.querySelector('.dr').value || 0; c += +r.querySelector('.cr').value || 0; });
      $('#tot').innerHTML = `<span>Debit <b>${f(d)}</b></span><span>Credit <b>${f(c)}</b></span>` + (Math.abs(d - c) < .005 && d > 0 ? '<span class="ok"><b>Balanced</b></span>' : !d && !c ? '<span>Enter debit and credit amounts</span>' : `<span class="err"><b>Difference ${f(d - c)}</b></span>`);
    }
    async function save() {
      if (badAD($('#vd').value)) return;

      const bad = rows.filter(r => (+r.dr || +r.cr) && !resolveAcc(r.t));
      if (bad.length) return showErr('Account not found: ' + bad.map(r => '"' + (r.t || 'blank') + '"').join(', ') + '. Pick an account from the list while typing, or add it in the Accounts tab.');
      const lines = rows.map(r => ({ account: resolveAcc(r.t), dr: r.dr, cr: r.cr }));
      const body = { type: $('#vt').value, date: $('#vd').value, bs: $('#vb').value, ref: $('#vr').value, narration: $('#vn').value, lines };
      const ed = window.ev, r = await fetch('/api/vouchers' + (ed ? '/' + ed.id : ''), { method: ed ? 'PUT' : 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(body) });
      const j = await r.json(); if (!r.ok) return showErr(j.error);
      if (ed) { window.ev = null; tab = 'daybook'; await load(); return toast('Updated ' + j.no + (j.saved ? '\nExcel refreshed: ' + j.saved : '')); }
      await load(); const out = body.date < FR() || body.date > TO(); $('#msg').innerHTML = `<span class="ok">Saved ${j.no}${j.saved ? ' → ' + esc(j.saved) : ''}</span>` + (out ? ' <span class="err">but its date is outside the From/To period at the top, so it will not show in reports until you change that period.</span>' : '');
    }
    async function rm(id, ask) { if (!confirm(ask)) return; window.sp = null; if (window.er && window.er.id == id) window.er = null; if (window.pye && window.pye.id == id) window.pye = null; if (window.ev && window.ev.id == id) window.ev = null; if (window.sle && window.sle.id == id) window.sle = null; if (window.eb && window.eb.voucherId == id) window.eb = null; const r = await fetch('/api/vouchers/' + id, { method: 'DELETE' }), j = await r.json().catch(() => ({})); await load(); toast(j.files && j.files.length ? 'Deleted. Excel file(s) removed:\n' + j.files.join('\n') : 'Deleted.'); }
    const del = id => rm(id, 'Delete this voucher and its Excel file? This cannot be undone.');
    async function addAcc() {
      const g = i => $('#' + i).value, r = await fetch('/api/accounts', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ code: g('ac1'), name: g('ac2'), type: g('ac3'), group: g('ac4') }) });
      if (!r.ok) return alert((await r.json()).error); load();
    }
    const rows = (list, valFn) => list.map(a => ({ a, v: valFn(a) })).filter(x => Math.abs(x.v) > .004);
    const section = (title, list, sign) => { // list of accounts, sign flips Dr-Cr into natural balance
      let tot = 0, h = `<tr class="sec"><th colspan="2">${title}</th></tr>`;
      groups(list).forEach(g => {
        const r = rows(list.filter(a => a.group == g), a => sign * closing(a)); if (!r.length) return;
        h += (g == title ? '' : `<tr class="grp"><td colspan="2">${esc(g)}</td></tr>`) + r.map(x => `<tr><td class="ind">${x.a.code} ${esc(x.a.name)}</td><td class="n">${f(x.v)}</td></tr>`).join(''); tot += r.reduce((s, x) => s + x.v, 0);
      });
      return { h, tot };
    };
    const dl = k => `<div class="tool"><button class="p" onclick="getFile('/api/xlsx/statement/${k}?from=${FR()}&to=${TO()}')">Download Excel</button></div>`;
    const toast = (m, k) => { const t = $('#toast'); t.innerHTML = esc(m) + (k ? '<br><a href="#" style="color:#fff;font-weight:600" onclick="goRec(\'' + k + '\');return false">View in Records →</a>' : ''); t.style.display = 'block'; clearTimeout(window.tt); window.tt = setTimeout(() => t.style.display = 'none', 7000); };
    async function getFile(url) {
      const r = await fetch(url); if (!r.ok) return alert((await r.json()).error || 'Download failed');
      const saved = r.headers.get('X-Saved-To'); if (saved) return toast('Saved to ' + decodeURIComponent(saved));
      const a = document.createElement('a'); a.href = URL.createObjectURL(await r.blob()); a.download = (/filename="([^"]+)"/.exec(r.headers.get('Content-Disposition')) || [])[1] || 'file.xlsx'; a.click();
      toast("Downloaded by the browser. Set a storage folder (and keep its switch on) in Settings to save elsewhere.");
    }

    async function delAcc(code) { if (!confirm('Delete account ' + code + '?')) return; const r = await fetch('/api/accounts/' + code, { method: 'DELETE' }); if (!r.ok) return alert((await r.json()).error); load(); }
    async function addCat() { const j = await post('/api/categories', { name: F('newcat') }); if (j) load(); }
    async function delCat(i) { if (!confirm('Remove this category from the list? Existing entries keep their accounts.')) return; await fetch('/api/categories/' + encodeURIComponent(D.settings.categories[i]), { method: 'DELETE' }); load(); }
    // ---- Dashboard helpers (plain SVG/HTML, no libraries) ----
    const K = n => { const a = Math.abs(n), s = n < 0 ? '-' : ''; return s + (a >= 1e7 ? (a / 1e7).toFixed(2) + ' Cr' : a >= 1e5 ? (a / 1e5).toFixed(2) + ' L' : a >= 1e3 ? (a / 1e3).toFixed(1) + 'k' : Math.round(a)); };
    const f0 = n => Math.round(n).toLocaleString('en-IN'), PAL = ['#4D6BFE', '#F5A524', '#3DD68C', '#FF7AB6', '#6B84FF', '#FF5C5C', '#7DD3FC', '#9A9A9A'];
    const hbars = (items, col = 'var(--pine)') => { const mx = Math.max(...items.map(i => Math.abs(i.v)), 1); return items.length ? items.map(i => `<div class="hb" title="${esc(i.l)}: ${f(i.v)}"><span>${esc(i.l)}</span><div><i style="width:${Math.max(Math.abs(i.v) / mx * 100, 1.5)}%;background:${col}"></i></div><b>${K(i.v)}</b>${i.s ? `<small>${esc(i.s)}</small>` : ''}</div>`).join('') : '<p class="sub" style="margin:0">Nothing to show for this period.</p>'; };
    function barChart(labels, series) {
      const W = 720, H = 250, L = 50, B = 26, T = 10, all = series.flatMap(s => s.vals), mx = Math.max(...all, 1), mn = Math.min(...all, 0), raw = (mx - mn) / 4, p = 10 ** Math.floor(Math.log10(raw)), step = [1, 2, 2.5, 5, 10].map(x => x * p).find(x => x >= raw), top = Math.ceil(mx / step) * step, bot = Math.floor(mn / step) * step;
      const y = v => T + (top - v) / ((top - bot) || 1) * (H - T - B), gw = (W - L - 8) / labels.length, bw = Math.min(26, gw * .8 / series.length);
      let s = `<svg viewBox="0 0 ${W} ${H}" role="img" style="width:100%;height:auto;display:block">`;
      for (let v = bot; v <= top + 1e-9; v += step) s += `<line x1="${L}" x2="${W - 8}" y1="${y(v)}" y2="${y(v)}" stroke="#E4E2DB"/><text x="${L - 6}" y="${y(v) + 4}" text-anchor="end" font-size="11" fill="#656A77">${K(v)}</text>`;
      labels.forEach((lb, i) => {
        const x0 = L + i * gw + (gw - bw * series.length) / 2;
        series.forEach((se, j) => { const v = se.vals[i]; s += `<rect x="${x0 + j * bw}" y="${Math.min(y(v), y(0))}" width="${bw - 2}" height="${Math.abs(y(v) - y(0))}" rx="2" fill="${v < 0 ? '#B42318' : se.color}"><title>${esc(lb)} · ${esc(se.name)}: ${f(v)}</title></rect>`; });
        s += `<text x="${L + i * gw + gw / 2}" y="${H - 8}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#656A77">${esc(lb)}</text>`;
      });
      return s + '</svg>' + (series.length > 1 ? `<div class="lg">${series.map(x => `<span><i style="background:${x.color}"></i>${esc(x.name)}</span>`).join('')}</div>` : '');
    }
    function donut(items) {
      const tot = items.reduce((s, i) => s + i.v, 0); if (!tot) return '<p class="sub" style="margin:0">Nothing to show for this period.</p>'; let off = 25;
      const arcs = items.map((i, k) => { const q = i.v / tot * 100, a = `<circle r="15.915" cx="21" cy="21" fill="none" stroke="${PAL[k % PAL.length]}" stroke-width="7" stroke-dasharray="${q} ${100 - q}" stroke-dashoffset="${off}"><title>${esc(i.l)}: ${f(i.v)} (${q.toFixed(1)}%)</title></circle>`; off -= q; return a; }).join('');
      return `<div class="dn"><svg viewBox="0 0 42 42" width="170" height="170" role="img">${arcs}<text x="21" y="22.5" text-anchor="middle" font-size="4.2" font-weight="600" fill="#1E2230">${K(tot)}</text></svg><div>${items.map((i, k) => `<div class="lgi"><i style="background:${PAL[k % PAL.length]}"></i>${esc(i.l)}<b>${(i.v / tot * 100).toFixed(0)}%</b></div>`).join('')}</div></div>`;
    }
    // ---- Records page ----
    function recFilter() {
      const g = id => { const e = document.getElementById(id); return e ? e.value : ''; }, q = g('rq').trim().toLowerCase().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean), c = g('rfc'), a = g('rfa'), p = g('rfp'), m = g('rfm'), d1 = g('rd1'), d2 = g('rd2'); let n = 0, all = 0, tot = 0;
      document.querySelectorAll('#rbody tr[data-q]').forEach(r => { all++; const x = r.dataset, ok = q.every(w => x.q.includes(w)) && (!c || x.c == c) && (!a || x.a == a) && (!p || x.p == p) && (!m || x.m == m) && (!d1 || x.d >= d1) && (!d2 || x.d <= d2); r.hidden = !ok; if (ok) { n++; tot += +x.amt; } });
      const el = $('#rcount'); if (el) el.textContent = `Showing ${n} of ${all} · total ${f(tot)}`;
    }

    function pickPurchase(id) { if (id) makeSale(id); else { window.sp = null; render(); } }
    // ---- Salary payment page ----
    function lmode() { $('#lfw').hidden = $('#lmo').value != 'Fonepay'; const want = { Cash: ['cash'], Cheque: ['bank'], Fonepay: ['fonepay', 'bank'], 'Bank transfer': ['bank'] }[$('#lmo').value] || []; for (const w of want) { const a = cashAccs().find(x => x.name.toLowerCase().includes(w)); if (a) { $('#lac').value = a.code; break; } } chqPick('lin', 'lac', 'lmo'); }
    async function saveSalary() {

    async function saveStaff() { const j = await post('/api/db/staff', { name: F('ldn'), designation: F('ldg'), phone: F('lph') }); if (j) { window.sls = j.name; await load(); toast('Staff saved'); } }
    async function delStaff(i) { if (!confirm('Remove this person from the staff list? Their past salary payments stay in the books.')) return; await fetch('/api/db/staff/' + encodeURIComponent(D.db.staff[i].name), { method: 'DELETE' }); window.sls = null; load(); }
    async function migrateOld() {

      if (!confirm((p.salaries.length ? p.salaries.length + ' payment(s) will become salary payments:\n\n' + p.salaries.map(x => x.date + '  ' + x.payee + '  ' + f(x.amount)).join('\n') : '') + (p.files ? '\n\n' + p.files + ' payment voucher Excel file(s) will be moved from the PV folder to the PMV folder.' : '') + '\n\nA backup of data.json and db.json is made first. Continue?')) return;
      const j = await (await fetch('/api/migrate', { method: 'POST' })).json(); await load(); toast(j.converted + ' payment(s) converted, ' + j.moved + ' file(s) moved to PMV. Backup files end with .bak-' + j.backup);
    }

    // ---- Bank accounts and cheque number formats ----
    // Same rule as server.js: a cheque number fits a bank when one run of digits in it matches the format (7895xxxx: x = any digit; digits only = "starts with").
    const fmtParts = f => String(f || '').split(/[,;]+/).map(x => x.toLowerCase().replace(/[\s-]/g, '').replace(/[#*?]/g, 'x')).filter(Boolean).map(s => ({ s, pre: !s.includes('x') }));
    const fmtHit = (p, run) => p.pre ? run.startsWith(p.s) : run.length === p.s.length && [...p.s].every((c, i) => c === 'x' || c === run[i]);
    const banksFor = instr => { const runs = String(instr || '').match(/\d+/g) || []; return (D.db.banks || []).filter(b => acc(b.ledger) && fmtParts(b.chequeFormat).some(p => runs.some(r => fmtHit(p, r)))); };
    function chqPick(inId, accId, modeId) { if (F(modeId) != 'Cheque') return; const h = banksFor(F(inId)), s = $('#' + accId); if (h.length == 1 && s.querySelector(`option[value="${h[0].ledger}"]`)) s.value = h[0].ledger; }
    function chqOk(inId, accId, modeId) {
      if (F(modeId) != 'Cheque') return true; const h = banksFor(F(inId)); if (h.length != 1 || h[0].ledger == F(accId)) return true;
      return confirm(`Cheque no. ${F(inId)} fits the format of ${h[0].name} (${h[0].chequeFormat}), but "${(acc(F(accId)) || {}).name || 'another account'}" is chosen under Paid from.\n\nSave anyway?`);
    }
    const payFromName = p => p.splits ? [...new Set(p.splits.map(y => (acc(y.account) || {}).name || y.account))].join(' + ') : (acc(p.account) || {}).name || ''; // a split payment (several cheques / banks) lists every bank
    const paidFrom = vid => { const v = D.vouchers.find(y => y.id == vid), p = v && (v.pmt || v.sal), a = p && payFromName(p); return a ? `<br><small>Paid from ${esc(a)}</small>` : ''; };
    function bankCard() {
      const B = D.db.banks || [], e = B.find(b => b.ledger == window.bke), bkey = window.bke || ''; if (!window.bkfs || window.bkfsFor !== bkey) { window.bkfs = e ? fmtParts(e.chequeFormat).map(p => p.s) : []; window.bkfsFor = bkey; }
      const free = D.accounts.filter(a => a.type == 'A' && (/bank/i.test(a.name) || a.group == 'Bank Accounts') && !B.some(b => b.ledger == a.code));
      return `<div class="card" id="bkcard"><div class="ch"><h2>Bank accounts</h2><span class="sub" style="margin:0">Pick one under “Paid from” on Payments made and Salary payment</span></div>
    <div class="row"><label>Bank name<input id="bkn" value="${esc(e ? e.bank : '')}" placeholder="e.g. Nabil Bank"></label><label>Account no.<input id="bka" value="${esc(e ? e.account : '')}"></label>
      <div class="fld w2"><span>Cheque no. formats <small>(one for each cheque book)</small></span><div id="bkfc" style="display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;min-height:26px;align-items:center">${bkfChips()}</div>
        <div style="display:flex;gap:8px"><input id="bkf" placeholder="e.g. 7895xxxx, then Enter" onkeydown="bkfKey(event)" onblur="bkfAdd(true)"><button type="button" style="white-space:nowrap" onclick="bkfAdd()">Add format</button></div></div>
      ${!e && free.length ? `<label>Ledger account<select id="bkl"><option value="">Create a new one</option>${free.map(a => `<option value="${a.code}">Use existing: ${esc(a.name)}</option>`).join('')}</select></label>` : ''}
      <div><button class="p" onclick="saveBank()">${e ? 'Update bank account' : 'Add bank account'}</button>${e ? ' <button onclick="window.bke=null;window.bkfs=null;render()">Cancel</button>' : ''}</div></div>
    <p class="sub" style="margin:4px 0 14px"><small>Cheque no. format: type the digits that are the same on every cheque of that bank and <b>x</b> for the digits that change, e.g. <b>7895xxxx</b>. A bank can have <b>several formats</b>, one for each cheque book: type one and press Enter (or Add format), then add the next, e.g. 7895xxxx and 4410xxxx; typing digits only (7895) means “starts with 7895”. It is used to pick the bank when you type a cheque number, and to update old records below. Each bank account gets its own ledger account, so it shows in the ledger, trial balance and balance sheet.</small></p>
    <div class="tw"><table><thead><tr><th>Bank</th><th>Account no.</th><th>Cheque no. formats</th><th>Ledger account</th><th></th></tr></thead><tbody>${B.map(b => `<tr><td><b>${esc(b.bank)}</b></td><td>${esc(b.account)}</td><td>${fmtParts(b.chequeFormat).map(p => `<span class="chip" style="margin:0 4px 4px 0" title="${esc(fmtHint(p.s))}">${esc(p.s)}</span>`).join('') || '—'}</td><td>${esc((acc(b.ledger) || {}).name || '')}<br><small>${esc(b.ledger)}</small></td><td class="act"><button onclick="editBank('${b.ledger}')">Edit</button> <button class="d" onclick="delBank('${b.ledger}')">Remove</button></td></tr>`).join('') || '<tr><td class="empty" colspan="5">No bank accounts yet.</td></tr>'}</tbody></table></div></div>`;
    }
    async function saveBank() { if (!bkfAdd()) return; const e = window.bke, j = await post('/api/banks' + (e ? '/' + e : ''), { bank: F('bkn'), account: F('bka'), chequeFormat: window.bkfs.join(', '), ledger: e || !$('#bkl') ? '' : F('bkl') }, e ? 'PUT' : 'POST'); if (!j) return; window.bke = null; window.bkfs = null; await load(); toast('Bank account ' + (e ? 'updated' : 'added') + ': ' + j.name); }
    function editBank(code) { window.bke = code; window.bkfs = null; render(); $('#bkcard').scrollIntoView({ block: 'start' }); $('#bkn').focus(); }
    async function delBank(code) { if (!confirm('Remove this bank account from the list? Payments already made from it keep their ledger account.')) return; const r = await fetch('/api/banks/' + encodeURIComponent(code), { method: 'DELETE' }), j = await r.json(); if (!r.ok) return alert(j.error); if (window.bke == code) { window.bke = null; window.bkfs = null; } await load(); toast(j.kept ? 'Removed from the list. Its ledger account is kept because it has entries.' : 'Bank account removed.'); }
    async function bankScan() { const r = await fetch('/api/bank-match'); window.bm = await r.json(); render(); $('#bmcard').scrollIntoView({ block: 'start' }); }
    async function bankApply() {
      if (!confirm(window.bm.change.length + ' cheque payment(s) will be moved to the bank account their cheque number belongs to. Amounts and dates stay the same; only the “paid from” account changes.\n\nA backup of data.json is made first. Continue?')) return;
      const j = await post('/api/bank-match', {}); if (!j) return; window.bm = null; await load(); toast(j.moved + ' payment(s) moved to their bank account' + (j.files ? ', ' + j.files + ' voucher Excel file(s) refreshed' : '') + (j.skipped ? '. ' + j.skipped + ' skipped (no bank line found)' : '') + (j.backup ? '. Backup: data.json.bak-' + j.backup : ''));
    }
    function bankMatchCard() {
      const m = window.bm, rows = (L, cols) => `<div class="tw"><table><thead><tr><th>Date</th><th>Voucher</th><th>Paid to</th><th>Cheque no.</th><th class="n">Amount</th>${cols.map(c => `<th>${c[0]}</th>`).join('')}</tr></thead><tbody>${L.map(r => `<tr><td>${r.date}${r.bs ? '<br><small>' + esc(r.bs) + '</small>' : ''}</td><td><b>${r.no}</b></td><td>${esc(r.who)}</td><td>${esc(r.cheque) || '—'}</td><td class="n">${f(r.amount)}</td>${cols.map(c => `<td>${c[1](r)}</td>`).join('')}</tr>`).join('')}</tbody></table></div>`;
      const more = (L, t, cols) => L.length ? `<details style="margin:10px 0 0"><summary style="cursor:pointer;font-weight:600;font-size:13px">${L.length} ${t}</summary>${rows(L, cols)}</details>` : '';
      const body = !m ? '' : !m.banks ? '<p class="sub" style="margin:12px 0 0">Add a cheque no. format to at least one bank account above first.</p>' : `<div style="margin-top:14px">
    <p class="sub" style="margin:0 0 10px"><b>${m.change.length}</b> cheque payment(s) will move to the bank their cheque number belongs to. <b>${m.check.length}</b> need your check and <b>${m.none.length}</b> have no matching bank; those are left as they are.</p>
    ${m.change.length ? rows(m.change, [['Now', r => esc(r.from)], ['Will be', r => '<b>' + esc(r.to) + '</b>']]) : '<p class="sub" style="margin:0">Nothing to move: every cheque that fits a bank format is already on that bank.</p>'}
    ${more(m.check, 'to check', [['Paid from', r => esc(r.from)], ['Why', r => esc(r.note)]])}${more(m.none, 'with no matching bank', [['Paid from', r => esc(r.from)], ['Why', r => esc(r.note)]])}
    <div class="actbar">${m.change.length ? `<button class="p" onclick="bankApply()">Move ${m.change.length} payment(s)</button>` : ''}<button onclick="window.bm=null;render()">Close</button></div></div>`;
      return `<div class="card" id="bmcard"><div class="ch"><h2>Match old cheque payments to banks</h2></div><p class="sub" style="margin:0 0 10px">Looks at every old payment made and salary payment paid by cheque and, using the cheque no. formats above, works out which bank account it came from. You see the list first; nothing changes until you press Move. Ledgers, trial balance and the voucher Excel files are updated, and a backup of data.json is made first. Run it again any time, for example after adding another bank.</p><button onclick="bankScan()">Check old cheque payments</button>${body}</div>`;
    }

    // ---- One payment by several cheques / banks (Payments made). The first cheque uses the normal Paid from + Cheque no. fields; each extra cheque is a row here. ----
    const spRow = (ca, m = {}) => `<div class="row" data-sp style="margin-top:8px;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.4fr) minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1fr) auto"><label>Paid from<select data-f="account">${ca.map(a => `<option value="${a.code}" ${a.code == m.account ? 'selected' : ''}>${esc(a.name)}</option>`).join('')}</select></label>
  <label>Cheque no.<input data-f="instrument" value="${esc(m.instrument || '')}" oninput="spPick(this)"></label><label>Amount<input data-f="amount" type="number" step="any" value="${m.amount ?? ''}" oninput="spSum()"></label>
  <div><button type="button" class="x" title="Remove this cheque" onclick="this.closest('[data-sp]').remove();spSum()">×</button></div></div>`;
    const splitBox = pre => `<div id="ysw" ${pre.mode == 'Cheque' ? '' : 'hidden'} style="margin-top:6px"><div id="ysp">${(pre.more || []).map(m => spRow(cashAccs(), m)).join('')}</div>
  <div class="actbar" style="margin:8px 0 0"><button type="button" onclick="spAdd()">+ Part paid by another cheque / bank</button><span id="ysum" class="sub" style="margin:0">${spText(+pre.amount || 0, (pre.more || []).reduce((t, m) => t + (+m.amount || 0), 0), (pre.more || []).length)}</span></div></div>`;
    function spAdd() { const ca = cashAccs(), other = ca.find(a => /bank/i.test(a.name) && a.code != F('yac')) || ca[0]; $('#ysp').insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', spRow(ca, { account: other && other.code })); spSum(); $('#ysp').lastElementChild.querySelector('[data-f=instrument]').focus(); }
    function spPick(el) { const h = banksFor(el.value), s = el.closest('[data-sp]').querySelector('[data-f=account]'); if (h.length == 1 && s.querySelector(`option[value="${h[0].ledger}"]`)) s.value = h[0].ledger; }
    const spText = (total, ex, n) => { const first = rd(total - ex); return n ? (first > 0 ? `First cheque: <b>${f(first)}</b> · other cheques: <b>${f(ex)}</b>` : '<b style="color:var(--err)">The other cheques are as much as the whole payment</b>') : 'Use this when one payment is made with more than one cheque, or from more than one bank.'; };
    function spSum() { const o = $('#ysum'); if (!o) return; const rows = [...document.querySelectorAll('#ysp [data-sp]')]; o.innerHTML = spText(N('yam'), rows.reduce((t, r) => t + (+r.querySelector('[data-f=amount]').value || 0), 0), rows.length); }
    function spRows() {
      if (!$('#ysp') || F('ymo') != 'Cheque') return []; const out = [];
      for (const r of document.querySelectorAll('#ysp [data-sp]')) {
        const g = k => r.querySelector('[data-f=' + k + ']').value, amount = +g('amount') || 0, instrument = g('instrument').trim(); if (!amount && !instrument) continue; // empty row: ignored
        if (amount <= 0) { alert('Enter an amount for every extra cheque, or remove the empty one.'); return null; }
        const h = banksFor(instrument); if (h.length == 1 && h[0].ledger != g('account') && !confirm(`Cheque no. ${instrument} fits the format of ${h[0].name} (${h[0].chequeFormat}), but "${(acc(g('account')) || {}).name || 'another account'}" is chosen under Paid from.\n\nSave anyway?`)) return null;
        out.push({ account: g('account'), instrument, amount });
      }
      if (out.length && rd(N('yam') - out.reduce((t, x) => t + x.amount, 0)) <= 0) { alert('The extra cheques add up to the whole payment or more. Nothing is left for the first cheque.'); return null; }
      return out;
    }

    // ---- Several cheque number formats for one bank (chips) ----
    const fmtHint = s => s.includes('x') ? `Any ${s.length}-digit cheque number that matches ${s} (x = any digit)` : `Any cheque number starting with ${s}`;
    const bkfChips = () => (window.bkfs || []).map((s, i) => `<span class="chip" title="${esc(fmtHint(s))}">${esc(s)} <a href="#" title="Remove this format" onclick="bkfDel(${i});return false">×</a></span>`).join(' ') || '<small>No format yet</small>';
    function bkfAdd(silent) {
      const el = $('#bkf'); if (!el) return true; const parts = fmtParts(el.value); if (!parts.length) return true;
      if (parts.some(p => !/^[0-9x]+$/.test(p.s) || !/\d/.test(p.s))) { if (!silent) alert('A cheque number format can only contain digits and x, for example 7895xxxx'); return false; }
      parts.forEach(p => { if (!window.bkfs.includes(p.s)) window.bkfs.push(p.s); }); el.value = ''; $('#bkfc').innerHTML = bkfChips(); return true;
    }
    function bkfDel(i) { window.bkfs.splice(i, 1); $('#bkfc').innerHTML = bkfChips(); }
    function bkfKey(e) { if (e.key == 'Enter' || e.key == ',') { e.preventDefault(); bkfAdd(); } }

    // ---- Old payments with several cheque numbers from different banks in one voucher: type each cheque's amount, then split ----
    async function splitScanUI() { window.bsp = await (await fetch('/api/bank-split')).json(); render(); $('#bspcard').scrollIntoView({ block: 'start' }); }
    function splitSum(id) {
      const r = window.bsp.rows.find(x => x.id == id), ins = [...document.querySelectorAll(`[data-sv="${id}"]`)], sum = rd(ins.reduce((t, i) => t + (+i.value || 0), 0)), o = $('#bsr' + id);
      o.innerHTML = !sum ? '<small>Type each cheque’s amount</small>' : Math.abs(sum - r.total) < .005 ? '<span class="chip ok">Adds up</span>' : `<small style="color:var(--err)">${f(sum)} entered · ${f(r.total - sum)} ${sum > r.total ? 'too much' : 'to go'}</small>`;
    }
    function splitType(el, id) {
      const r = window.bsp.rows.find(x => x.id == id), ins = [...document.querySelectorAll(`[data-sv="${id}"]`)]; el.dataset.auto = '';
      if (ins.length == 2) { const o = ins.find(i => i !== el); if (!o.value || o.dataset.auto) { const v = rd(r.total - (+el.value || 0)); o.value = el.value && v > 0 ? v : ''; o.dataset.auto = '1'; } } // two cheques: the second is filled in with what is left
      splitSum(id);
    }
    async function bankSplitApply() {
      const items = [];
      for (const r of window.bsp.rows) {
        const vals = [...document.querySelectorAll(`[data-sv="${r.id}"]`)].map(i => ({ cheque: i.dataset.ch, amount: +i.value || 0 })); if (!vals.some(v => v.amount)) continue;
        if (vals.some(v => v.amount <= 0)) return alert(`Enter an amount for every cheque of ${r.no}, or clear them all to leave it for later.`);
        const sum = rd(vals.reduce((t, v) => t + v.amount, 0)); if (Math.abs(sum - r.total) > .004) return alert(`${r.no}: the cheques add up to ${f(sum)} but the payment is ${f(r.total)}.`);
        items.push({ id: r.id, parts: vals });
      }
      if (!items.length) return alert('Type the amount of each cheque first. Payments left empty stay as they are.');
      if (!confirm(items.length + ' payment(s) will be split so each cheque is booked to its own bank account. The supplier, total amount and date stay the same; only the “paid from” side is divided.\n\nA backup of data.json is made first. Continue?')) return;
      const j = await post('/api/bank-split', { items }); if (!j) return; window.bsp = null; await load(); toast(j.split + ' payment(s) split by bank' + (j.files ? ', ' + j.files + ' voucher Excel file(s) refreshed' : '') + '. Backup: data.json.bak-' + j.backup);
    }
    function bankSplitCard() {
      const m = window.bsp,
        amt = (r, p) => `<div style="margin:0 0 8px"><b>${esc(p.cheque)}</b> <small>· ${esc(p.bank)}</small><br><input type="number" step="any" placeholder="Amount" style="width:150px;margin-top:3px" data-sv="${r.id}" data-ch="${esc(p.cheque)}" oninput="splitType(this,${r.id})"></div>`,
        who = r => `<td>${r.date}${r.bs ? '<br><small>' + esc(r.bs) + '</small>' : ''}</td><td><b>${r.no}</b></td><td>${esc(r.who)}<br><small>Cheque field: ${esc(r.ref)}</small></td>`,
        body = !m ? '' : m.error ? `<p class="sub" style="margin:12px 0 0;color:var(--err)">The server did not understand this request (${esc(m.error)}). It is probably still running the old server.js: replace it with the new server.js, stop the server and start it again with <b>node server.js</b>, then press Check old payments.</p>` : m.banks < 2 ? '<p class="sub" style="margin:12px 0 0">Add a cheque no. format to at least two bank accounts above first.</p>' : `<div style="margin-top:14px">
      <p class="sub" style="margin:0 0 10px"><b>${m.rows.length}</b> payment(s) can be split. ${m.check.length ? `<b>${m.check.length}</b> need a look by hand.` : ''}</p>
      ${m.rows.length ? `<div class="tw"><table><thead><tr><th>Date</th><th>Voucher</th><th>Paid to</th><th>Now paid from</th><th class="n">Payment</th><th>Cheques and their amounts</th><th></th></tr></thead><tbody>${m.rows.map(r => `<tr>${who(r)}<td>${esc(r.from)}</td><td class="n">${f(r.total)}</td><td>${r.parts.map(p => amt(r, p)).join('')}</td><td id="bsr${r.id}"><small>Type each cheque’s amount</small></td></tr>`).join('')}</tbody></table></div>` : '<p class="sub" style="margin:0">No old payment has cheque numbers from different banks in one voucher.</p>'}
      ${m.check.length ? `<details style="margin:10px 0 0"><summary style="cursor:pointer;font-weight:600;font-size:13px">${m.check.length} to check by hand</summary><div class="tw"><table><thead><tr><th>Date</th><th>Voucher</th><th>Paid to</th><th class="n">Payment</th><th>Why</th></tr></thead><tbody>${m.check.map(r => `<tr>${who(r)}<td class="n">${f(r.total)}</td><td>${esc(r.note)}</td></tr>`).join('')}</tbody></table></div></details>` : ''}
      <div class="actbar">${m.rows.length ? '<button class="p" onclick="bankSplitApply()">Split the payments I filled in</button>' : ''}<button onclick="window.bsp=null;render()">Close</button></div></div>`;
      return `<div class="card" id="bspcard"><div class="ch"><h2>Split old payments made with several cheques</h2></div><p class="sub" style="margin:0 0 10px">Finds old payments where one voucher lists cheque numbers from <b>different banks</b> (for example “7895001, 4410002”). Each cheque is matched to its bank by the formats above; you type the amount of each cheque, and the payment is split so every bank’s ledger shows its own cheque. The supplier, total, date and bill stay the same. Payments you leave empty are not touched, and a backup of data.json is made first.</p><button onclick="splitScanUI()">Check old payments</button>${body}</div>`;
    }

    // ---- Statements page ----
    const SK = [['supplier', 'Suppliers'], ['customer', 'Customers'], ['staff', 'Staff'], ['expense', 'Expenses']];
    function stmtList(k) {
      const key = x => String(x || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      if (k == 'supplier') return D.payables.map(x => ({ n: x.name, s: f(x.balance), t: 'we owe', sub: x.pan }));
      if (k == 'customer') return D.receivables.map(x => ({ n: x.name, s: f(x.balance), t: 'they owe', sub: x.pan }));
      if (k == 'staff') return D.db.staff.slice().sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name)).map(x => ({ n: x.name, s: f(D.vouchers.filter(v => v.sal && key(v.sal.staff) == key(x.name)).reduce((t, v) => t + v.sal.amount, 0)), t: 'paid', sub: x.designation }));
      return D.accounts.filter(a => a.type == 'X').map(a => ({ n: a.name, s: f(net(a.code, cum)), t: 'to date', sub: a.group }));
    }
    function stmtDates() { return { from: window.stf || FR(), to: window.stt || TO() }; }
    function pickStmt(i) { window.stn = window.stl[i].n; window.stlist = false; render(); }
    function sqFilter() {
      const q = $('#sq').value.trim().toLowerCase().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean); let vis = [];
      document.querySelectorAll('#smbody tr[data-q]').forEach(r => { const ok = q.every(w => r.dataset.q.includes(w)); r.hidden = !ok; if (ok) vis.push(r); });
      if (q.length && vis.length == 1 && window.stl[+vis[0].dataset.i].n != window.stn) { const v = $('#sq').value; window.stn = window.stl[+vis[0].dataset.i].n; render(); const e = $('#sq'); e.value = v; e.focus(); e.setSelectionRange(v.length, v.length); sqFilter(); }
    } // exactly one match: show its statement
    function setStmtDates() { window.stf = F('sdf'); window.stt = F('sdt'); render(); }
    function stmtUrl(x) { const d = stmtDates(); return `/api/${x}pstatement/${window.stk || 'supplier'}?name=${encodeURIComponent(window.stn)}&from=${d.from}&to=${d.to}`; }
    async function loadStmt() {
      const box = $('#smain'); if (!box || !window.stn) return; const want = window.stn + '|' + stmtDates().from + '|' + stmtDates().to, r = await fetch(stmtUrl('')); if (!$('#smain') || want != window.stn + '|' + stmtDates().from + '|' + stmtDates().to) return;
      const S = await r.json(); if (!r.ok) { box.innerHTML = '<p class="sub">' + esc(S.error) + '</p>'; return; }
      box.innerHTML = `<div class="vat" style="margin:0 0 12px"><div><span>Opening balance</span><b>${f(S.opening)}</b></div><div><span>${esc(S.cols.a)}</span><b>${f(S.a)}</b></div><div><span>${esc(S.cols.b)}</span><b>${f(S.b)}</b></div><div class="net"><span>Closing balance</span><b>${f(S.closing)}</b></div></div>
  <div class="tw"><table><thead><tr><th>Date</th><th>Voucher</th><th>Particulars</th><th class="n">${esc(S.cols.a)}</th><th class="n">${esc(S.cols.b)}</th><th class="n">${esc(S.cols.bal)}</th></tr></thead><tbody>
  <tr><td></td><td></td><td><i>Opening balance</i></td><td></td><td></td><td class="n">${f(S.opening)}</td></tr>${S.rows.map(e => `<tr><td>${e.date}${e.bs ? '<br><small>' + esc(e.bs) + '</small>' : ''}</td><td><b>${esc(e.no)}</b>${e.ref ? '<br><small>' + esc(e.ref) + '</small>' : ''}</td><td>${esc(e.text)}</td><td class="n">${e.a ? f(e.a) : ''}</td><td class="n">${e.b ? f(e.b) : ''}</td><td class="n">${f(e.bal)}</td></tr>`).join('') || '<tr><td class="empty" colspan="6">No entries in this period.</td></tr>'}</tbody></table></div>`;
    }
    function fonepayCard() {
      const L = D.vouchers.filter(v => (v.pmt || v.sal) && (v.pmt || v.sal).mode == 'Fonepay' && (v.pmt || v.sal).fee === undefined).sort((a, b) => a.date.localeCompare(b.date) || a.id - b.id);
      return `<div class="card"><div class="ch"><h2>Fonepay charges to update</h2><button class="sp" onclick="getFile('/api/xlsx/fonepay')">Download list (Excel)</button></div><p class="sub" style="margin:0 0 10px">Payments made and salary payments paid by Fonepay before the charge field existed. Type the charge you paid (0 if there was none) and press Save. The payment is re-posted in the ledgers, day book and income statement, and the row leaves this list.</p>
  <div class="tw"><table><thead><tr><th>Date</th><th>Voucher</th><th>Paid to</th><th class="n">Amount</th><th style="width:150px">Fonepay charge</th><th></th></tr></thead><tbody>${L.map(v => { const p = v.pmt || v.sal; return `<tr><td>${v.date}${v.bs ? '<br><small>' + esc(v.bs) + '</small>' : ''}</td><td><b>${v.no}</b>${v.sal ? '<br><small>Salary</small>' : ''}</td><td>${esc(v.sal ? p.staff : p.other ? p.payee : p.supplier)}${p.instrument ? '<br><small>' + esc(p.instrument) + '</small>' : ''}</td><td class="n">${f(p.amount)}</td><td><input id="ff${v.id}" type="number" step="any" placeholder="0.00" onkeydown="if(event.key=='Enter')saveFee(${v.id})"></td><td class="act"><button class="p" onclick="saveFee(${v.id})">Save</button> <button onclick="editV(${v.id})">Edit</button></td></tr>`; }).join('') || '<tr><td class="empty" colspan="6">No Fonepay payments need updating.</td></tr>'}</tbody></table></div></div>`;
    }
    async function saveFee(id) { const el = $('#ff' + id), v = D.vouchers.find(x => x.id == id); if (el.value === '') return alert('Enter the Fonepay charge (0 if there was none).'); const r = await fetch('/api/' + (v.sal ? 'salaries/' : 'payments/') + id + '/fee', { method: 'PUT', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ fee: +el.value }) }), j = await r.json(); if (!r.ok) return alert(j.error); await load(); toast('Fonepay charge saved for ' + j.no); }

      dash: () => {

        const inc = -ofType('I').reduce((s, a) => s + net(a.code, per), 0), exp = ofType('X').reduce((s, a) => s + net(a.code, per), 0), profit = inc - exp;
        const cash = cashAccs().reduce((s, a) => s + net(a.code, cum), 0), rec = D.receivables.reduce((t, c) => t + Math.max(c.balance, 0), 0), pay = D.payables.reduce((t, c) => t + Math.max(c.balance, 0), 0);
        const vat = -net('2020', cum) - net('1050', cum), unsold = D.bills.filter(b => b.kind == 'purchase' && !b.sold), unsoldAmt = unsold.reduce((t, b) => t + b.total, 0);
        // months in the selected period
        const months = []; let [y, m] = FR().split('-').map(Number); const [ey, em] = TO().split('-').map(Number);
        while ((y < ey || (y == ey && m <= em)) && months.length < 36) { months.push(y + '-' + String(m).padStart(2, '0')); if (++m > 12) { m = 1; y++; } }
        const MN = ['Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'May', 'Jun', 'Jul', 'Aug', 'Sep', 'Oct', 'Nov', 'Dec'], lab = months.map(k => MN[+k.slice(5) - 1] + " '" + k.slice(2, 4));
        const byM = l => months.map(k => rd(l.filter(b => b.date.slice(0, 7) == k).reduce((s, b) => s + b.total, 0)));
        const plM = months.map(k => rd(D.vouchers.filter(v => per(v.date) && v.date.slice(0, 7) == k).reduce((s, v) => s + v.lines.reduce((t, l) => { const a = acc(l.account); return a && 'IX'.includes(a.type) ? t + l.cr - l.dr : t; }, 0), 0)));
        // sales by category with margin on bills made from a purchase
        const cat = {}; sales.forEach(b => { const c = b.category || 'Other', pb = D.bills.find(x => x.id == b.purchaseId), e = cat[c] = cat[c] || { v: 0, m: 0, n: 0 }, rev = b.nonTax + b.taxable; e.v += rev; e.n++; if (pb) e.m += rev - (pb.nonTax + pb.taxable); });
        const catItems = Object.entries(cat).sort((a, b) => b[1].v - a[1].v).map(([l, e]) => ({ l, v: e.v, s: e.n + ' bill' + (e.n > 1 ? 's' : '') + (e.m ? ' · margin ' + K(e.m) : '') }));
        const top = (list, key) => { const o = {}; list.forEach(b => o[b[key]] = (o[b[key]] || 0) + b.total); return Object.entries(o).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]).slice(0, 5).map(([l, v]) => ({ l, v })); };
        const age = d => Math.floor((Date.now() - new Date(d)) / 864e5), aging = list => { const b = [0, 0, 0, 0]; list.forEach(x => b[age(x.date) <= 30 ? 0 : age(x.date) <= 60 ? 1 : age(x.date) <= 90 ? 2 : 3] += x.due); return ['0–30 days', '31–60 days', '61–90 days', '90+ days'].map((l, i) => ({ l, v: b[i] })); };
        const dueR = D.receivables.flatMap(c => c.bills.filter(b => b.due > .004)), dueP = D.payables.flatMap(c => c.bills.filter(b => b.due > .004));
        let ex = ofType('X').map(a => ({ l: a.name, v: net(a.code, per) })).filter(x => x.v > .004).sort((a, b) => b.v - a.v); if (ex.length > 6) ex = [...ex.slice(0, 6), { l: 'Other expenses', v: ex.slice(6).reduce((s, x) => s + x.v, 0) }];

        return `<p class="sub">Figures for <b>${FR()}</b> to <b>${TO()}</b> (change the period at the top). Balances such as cash, receivable and payable are as at ${TO()}. Months are English (AD) months.</p>
    <div class="vat k4">${kp('Sales billed', f0(tot(sales)), sales.length + (sales.length == 1 ? ' bill' : ' bills') + ', incl. VAT')}${kp('Purchases billed', f0(tot(purch)), purch.length + (purch.length == 1 ? ' bill' : ' bills') + ', incl. VAT')}${kp('Net profit', f0(profit), 'Income ' + K(inc) + ' − expenses ' + K(exp), 'net')}${kp('Cash &amp; bank', f0(cash), '')}
      ${kp('Receivable from customers', f0(rec), dueR.length + (dueR.length == 1 ? ' unpaid bill' : ' unpaid bills'))}${kp('Payable to suppliers', f0(pay), dueP.length + (dueP.length == 1 ?       <div class="card"><div class="ch"><h2>Expenses by account</h2></div>${donut(ex)}</div>

        <div class="ag"><div><h3>Customers owe you</h3>${hbars(aging(dueR), '#B42318')}</div><div><h3>You owe suppliers</h3>${hbars(aging(dueP), '#A8730F')}</div></div></div>
    </div>`;

      reg: () => {

          const P = kind == 'purchase', noBs = R.filter(b => !b.bs).length;

            `<tr class="t"><td colspan="5">Total</td><td class="n">${f(sum(R, 'total'))}</td><td class="n">${f(sum(R, 'nonTax'))}</td><td class="n">${f(sum(R, 'taxable'))}</td><td class="n">${f(sum(R, 'vat'))}</td></tr></table></div></div>`;
