    ${detail}`;
      },
      reg: () => {
        const rows = k => D.bills.filter(b => b.kind == k && b.date >= FR() && b.date <= TO()).sort((a, b) => a.date.localeCompare(b.date) || String(a.billNo).localeCompare(String(b.billNo), undefined, { numeric: true }));
        const sum = (R, k) => rd(R.reduce((s, b) => s + b[k], 0)), PR = rows('purchase'), SR = rows('sales');
        const mk = (kind, title, R) => {
          const P = kind == 'purchase', noBs = R.filter(b => !b.bs).length;
          return `<div class="card"><div class="ch"><h2>${title}</h2>${noBs ? `<span class="err">${noBs} bill(s) have no BS date, so the AD date is shown in the register.</span>` : ''}<button class="p sp" onclick="getFile('/api/xlsx/register/${kind}?from=${FR()}&to=${TO()}')">Download Excel</button></div>
      <div class="tw"><table><tr><th>Miti</th><th>Bill no.</th><th>${P ? 'Supplier' : 'Buyer'}</th><th>PAN</th><th>Particulars</th><th class="n">Total</th><th class="n">Exempt</th><th class="n">Taxable</th><th class="n">VAT</th></tr>` +
            R.map(b => `<tr><td>${esc(b.bs || b.date)}</td><td>${esc(b.billNo)}</td><td>${esc(P ? b.supplier : b.customer)}</td><td>${esc(P ? b.supplierPan : b.customerVat)}</td><td>${esc(b.particulars)}</td><td class="n">${f(b.total)}</td><td class="n">${f(b.nonTax)}</td><td class="n">${f(b.taxable)}</td><td class="n">${f(b.vat)}</td></tr>`).join('') +
            `<tr class="t"><td colspan="5">Total</td><td class="n">${f(sum(R, 'total'))}</td><td class="n">${f(sum(R, 'nonTax'))}</td><td class="n">${f(sum(R, 'taxable'))}</td><td class="n">${f(sum(R, 'vat'))}</td></tr></table></div></div>`;
        };
        const o = sum(SR, 'vat'), i = sum(PR, 'vat');
        return `<div class="vat"><div><span>Output VAT (sales)</span><b>${f(o)}</b></div><div><span>Input VAT (purchases)</span><b>${f(i)}</b></div><div class="net"><span>VAT for this period: ${o >= i ? 'payable' : 'credit carried forward'}</span><b>${f(o - i)}</b></div></div>` +
          mk('purchase', 'Purchase book (खरिद खाता)', PR) + mk('sales', 'Sales book (बिक्री खाता)', SR);
      },
      bills: () => {
        const s = window.sp || {}, e = window.eb || {}, ek = e.kind, pe = ek == 'purchase' ? e : {}, so = ek == 'sales' ? e : s, today = ymd(), bt = window.bt || 'purchase', inp = (id, l, v = '', x = '', c = '') => `<label class="${c}">${l}<input id="${id}" value="${esc(v)}" ${x}></label>`;
        const catSel = (id, v) => `<label>Category<select id="${id}">${[...D.settings.categories, ...(v && !D.settings.categories.includes(v) ? [v] : [])].map(c => `<option ${c == v ? 'selected' : ''}>${esc(c)}</option>`).join('')}</select></label>`, P = D.bills.filter(b => b.kind == 'purchase').reverse(), S = D.bills.filter(b => b.kind == 'sales').reverse(), nx = 'type="number" step="any"';
        const q = (...a) => esc(a.join(' ').toLowerCase()), pst = {}; D.receivables.forEach(c => c.bills.forEach(x => pst[x.id] = x));

        return `<div id="bw" data-k="${bt}"><div class="seg"><button data-k="purchase" class="${bt == 'purchase' ?     <div class="pane-p">${ek == 'purchase' ? `<div class="note">Editing purchase bill <b>${esc(e.billNo)}</b> (${esc(e.voucher)}). ' A sales bill (' + esc(e.sold) + ') was already made from it; that sales bill is not changed.' : ''}</div>` : ''}<div class="split"><div class="card">
      <div class="fh">Supplier and customer</div><div class="row">${inp('ps', 'Supplier (pick or type new)', pe.supplier, 'list="pls" onchange="fillParty(\'ps\',\'ppan\')"', 'w2')}${inp('ppan', 'Supplier PAN/VAT no.', pe.supplierPan)}${inp('pc', 'Customer (bill to)', pe.customer, 'list="plc"', 'w2')}${inp('pp', 'Passenger name', pe.passenger)}</div>
      <div class="fh">Bill</div><div class="row">${inp('pb', 'Supplier bill no.', pe.billNo)}${catSel('pcat', pe.category)}<label>Date (AD)<input type="date" id="pd" value="${pe.date || today}"></label>${inp('pbs', 'Date (BS)', pe.bs)}</div>
      <div class="fh">Charges</div><div class="row">${inp('pi', 'Particulars (route, ticket no., hotel...)', pe.particulars, '', 'w4')}${inp('pn', 'Non-taxable', pe.nonTax, nx + ' oninput="pcalc()"')}${inp('pt', 'Taxable', pe.taxable, nx + ' oninput="pcalc()"')}${inp('pv', 'VAT 13% (as on bill)', pe.vat, nx + ' oninput="pcalc()"')}</div>
    </div>
    <aside class="stub"><div class="hd">Purchase bill</div><div class="bd"><dl><dt>Non-taxable</dt><dd id="pnv"></dd><dt>Taxable</dt><dd id="ptv"></dd><dt>VAT 13%</dt><dd id="pvv"></dd></dl>
      <div class="tt"><span>Total</span><b id="ptot"></b></div>${ek == 'purchase' ? '<button class="p wide" onclick="savePurchase()">Update purchase bill</button><button class="wide" onclick="cancelEdit()">Cancel</button>' : '<button class="p wide" onclick="savePurchase()">Save as journal voucher</button>'}</div></aside></div>

</div>

    <div class="pane-s">${ek == 'sales' ? `<div class="note">Editing sales bill <b>${esc(e.billNo)}</b> (${esc(e.voucher)}). Saving updates its sales voucher, the customer's account, the reports and the invoice Excel.</div>` : ''}${s.id ? `<div class="note">Creating a sales bill from purchase bill <b>${esc(s.billNo)}</b> (${esc(s.supplier)}). The amounts below are filled in for you.</div>` : ''}<div class="split"><div class="card">
      <div class="fh">Customer</div><div class="row">${inp('sc', 'Customer (M/S)', so.customer, 'list="plc" onchange="fillParty(\'sc\',\'sv\')"', 'w2')}${inp('sv', "Buyer's VAT/PAN no.", ek == 'sales' ? e.customerVat : '')}${inp('sp2', 'Passenger', so.passenger)}${ek == 'sales' ? '' : `<label class="w2">From purchase bill (optional)<select id="spb" onchange="pickPurchase(this.value)"><option value="">None, enter manually</option>${D.bills.filter(b => b.kind == 'purchase' && (!b.sold || b.id == s.id)).reverse().map(b => `<option value="${b.id}" ${b.id == s.id ?       <div class="fh">Bill</div><div class="row">${catSel('sct', so.category)}${ek == 'sales' ? inp('sbn', 'Bill no.', e.billNo) : ''}<label>Date (AD)<input type="date" id="sd" value="${ek == 'sales' ? e.date : today}"></label>${inp('sbs', 'Date (BS)', ek == 'sales' ? e.bs : '')}${inp('si', 'Particulars', so.particulars, '', 'w4')}</div>
      <div class="fh">Amounts</div><div class="row">${inp('sn', 'Non-taxable', so.nonTax, nx + ' oninput="scalc(this.id)"')}${inp('sb', 'Purchase total', s.total, nx + ' oninput="scalc(this.id)"')}${inp('sm', 'Markup %', 15, nx + ' oninput="scalc(this.id)"')}${inp('st', 'Bill total', ek == 'sales' ? e.total : '', nx + ' oninput="scalc(this.id)"')}</div>
    </div>
    <aside class="stub"><div class="hd">Sales bill (VAT invoice)</div><div class="bd"><div id="sbd"></div>${ek == 'sales' ? '<button class="p wide" onclick="saveSale()">Update sales bill</button><button class="wide" onclick="cancelEdit()">Cancel</button>' : '<button class="p wide" onclick="saveSale()">Save &amp; download Excel</button><button class="wide" onclick="window.sp=null;render()">Clear</button>'}</div></aside></div>

</div></div>`;
      },

      voucher: () => {
        const ev = window.ev || {}; return `${window.ev ? `<div class="note">Editing <b>${esc(ev.no)}</b>. Saving updates the ledgers and reports. The voucher number and type stay the same.</div>` : ''}<div class="card"><div class="row">
   <label>Type<select id="vt" ${window.ev ? 'disabled' : ''}>${['Journal', 'Payment', 'Receipt', 'Purchase', 'Sales', 'Contra'].map(t => `<option ${t == ev.type ? 'selected' : ''}>${t}</option>`).join('')}</select></label>
   <label>Date (AD)<input type="date" id="vd" value="${ev.date || ymd()}"></label>
   <label>Date (BS, optional)<input id="vb" placeholder="2083-06-30" value="${esc(ev.bs)}"></label>
   <label>Bill / Ref no.<input id="vr" value="${esc(ev.ref)}"></label><label class="w4">Narration<input id="vn" value="${esc(ev.narration)}"></label></div></div>
   <div class="card"><div class="tw" style="margin-bottom:0"><table><thead><tr><th>Account</th><th class="n" style="width:170px">Debit</th><th class="n" style="width:170px">Credit</th><th style="width:44px"></th></tr></thead><tbody id="ls"></tbody></table></div>
   <div style="margin-top:14px"><button onclick="addLine()">+ Add line</button></div></div>
   <div class="bar"><span id="tot"></span><span class="sp"><span id="msg"></span> ${window.ev ? '<button onclick="window.ev=null;render()">Cancel</button> ' : ''}<button class="p" onclick="save()">${window.ev ? 'Update voucher' : 'Save voucher'}</button></span></div>`;
      },
      daybook: () => `<div class="card"><div class="tw"><table><tr><th>Date</th><th>Voucher</th><th>Particulars</th><th class="n">Debit</th><th class="n">Credit</th><th></th></tr>` +
        (D.vouchers.filter(v => per(v.date)).sort((a, b) => a.date.localeCompare(b.date) || a.id - b.id).map(v =>
          v.lines.map((l, i) => `<tr class="${i ? '' : 'vs'}"><td>${i ? '' : v.date + (v.bs ? '<br><small>' + esc(v.bs) + '</small>' : '')}</td><td>${i ? '' : '<b>' + v.no + '</b>' + (v.ref ? '<br><small>' + esc(v.ref) + '</small>' : '')}</td>
      <td>${esc(nm(l.account))}${i == v.lines.length - 1 && v.narration ? '<br><small><i>' + esc(v.narration) + '</i></small>' : ''}</td>
      <td class="n">${l.dr ? f(l.dr) : ''}</td><td class="n">${l.cr ? f(l.cr) : ''}</td><td class="act">${i ? '' : `<a href="#" onclick="getFile('/api/xlsx/voucher/${v.id}');return false">Excel</a> <button onclick="editV(${v.id})">Edit</button> <button class="d" onclick="del(${v.id})">Delete</button>`}</td></tr>`).join('')).join('') || '<tr><td class="empty" colspan="6">No vouchers in this period.</td></tr>') + '</table></div></div>',
      ledger: () => {
        const c = window.lc || D.accounts[0].code, a = acc(c), isB = 'ALE'.includes(a.type);
        let run = isB ? net(c, pre) : 0; const open = run;
        const items = D.vouchers.filter(v => per(v.date)).sort((x, y) => x.date.localeCompare(y.date) || x.id - y.id).flatMap(v => v.lines.filter(l => l.account == c).map(l => ({ v, l })));
        const bal = n => f(Math.abs(n)) + (n >= 0 ? ' Dr' : ' Cr');
        return `<div class="card"><div class="row" style="grid-template-columns:minmax(220px,420px)"><label>Account<select onchange="lc=this.value;render()">${D.accounts.map(x => `<option value="${x.code}" ${x.code == c ? 'selected' : ''}>${x.code} ${esc(x.name)}</option>`).join('')}</select></label></div></div>
    <div class="card"><div class="tw"><table><tr><th>Date</th><th>Voucher</th><th>Narration</th><th class="n">Debit</th><th class="n">Credit</th><th class="n">Balance</th></tr>
    <tr class="grp"><td colspan="5">Opening balance</td><td class="n">${bal(open)}</td></tr>` + items.map(({ v, l }) => {
          run += l.dr - l.cr;
          return `<tr><td>${v.date}</td><td>${v.no}</td><td>${esc(v.narration)}</td><td class="n">${l.dr ? f(l.dr) : ''}</td><td class="n">${l.cr ? f(l.cr) : ''}</td><td class="n">${bal(run)}</td></tr>`;
        }).join('') +
          `<tr class="t"><td colspan="5">Closing balance</td><td class="n">${bal(run)}</td></tr></table></div></div>`;
      },
      tb: () => {
        let dr = 0, cr = 0; const p = priorPL();
        const r = ofType('ALEIX').map(a => ({ a, v: closing(a) })).filter(x => Math.abs(x.v) > .004);
        if (Math.abs(p) > .004) r.push({ a: { code: '', name: "Prior years' profit/(loss) carried forward" }, v: p });
        return `<p class="sub">As at ${TO()}</p>${dl('tb')}<div class="card sheet"><div class="tw"><table><tr><th>Account</th><th class="n">Debit</th><th class="n">Credit</th></tr>` + r.map(x => {
          x.v > 0 ? dr += x.v : cr -= x.v;

//  SERVER  —  where every top-level name of server.js goes
// ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// [file, what it holds, [names moved here verbatim]]   (names the script adds itself are listed in INJECT below)
const SERVER_SPEC = [
  ['server/http.js', 'HTTP helpers: send(), readBody(), serveStatic()', ['send']],
  ['server/store.js', 'data.json / db.json / settings.json load + save, master-data lists', ['DB', 'DBF', 'SETF', 'load', 'save', 'loadDb', 'saveDb', 'loadSet', 'saveSet', 'SCHEMA', 'upsert', 'touchParty']],
  ['server/accounts.js', 'chart-of-accounts seed and small accounting helpers', ['seed', 'EXTRA', 'rd', 'split', 'nkey', 'party', 'catName', 'nextBankCode']],
  ['server/settings.js', 'constants and defaults: storage folders, hotel categories, company details', ['FOLDERS', 'HOTEL_CATS', 'COMPANY_DEFAULT', 'COMPANY']],
  ['server/excel/workbook.js', 'shared Excel building blocks: frame(), put(), box(), fx(), words()', ['W', 'TY', 'w', 'words', 'frame', 'put', 'box', 'fx']],
  ['server/excel/voucher.js', 'journal voucher workbook', ['jvXlsx']],
  ['server/excel/invoice.js', 'sales invoice and purchase bill workbooks', ['invoiceXlsx', 'purchaseBillXlsx']],
  ['server/excel/statements.js', 'trial balance / income statement / balance sheet and party statements', ['bal', 'priorPL', 'sec', 'statementXlsx', 'stmtData', 'STM_LABEL', 'pstatementXlsx']],
  ['server/excel/registers.js', 'VAT registers (IRD templates)', ['purchaseRegisterXlsx', 'registerXlsx']],
  ['server/posting/lines.js', 'voucher numbering and posting: cleanLines(), PFX, post(), resync()', ['PFX', 'post', 'resync', 'cleanLines']],
  ['server/posting/purchase.js', 'purchase bill validation and posting', ['purchaseBad', 'purchaseParts', 'purchaseFields']],
  ['server/posting/sales.js', 'sales bill validation and posting', ['salesBad', 'salesParts']],
  ['server/posting/receipts.js', 'payments received from customers', ['MODES', 'receiptParts']],
  ['server/posting/payments.js', 'payments made to suppliers, cheque splits', ['chequeSplits', 'splitCredits', 'splitNote', 'paymentParts']],
  ['server/posting/salaries.js', 'salary payments and the old-record migration', ['salaryParts', 'migratable', 'migrateSalaries']],
  ['server/posting/receivables.js', 'per-customer receivables picture', ['receivables']],
  ['server/posting/payables.js', 'per-supplier payables picture', ['payables']],
  ['server/banks.js', 'bank accounts, cheque-number formats, bank matching and splitting', ['fmtParts', 'fmtBad', 'fmtHit', 'fmtBoth', 'banksFor', 'bankAcctName', 'bankMatch', 'chqRuns', 'splitScan', 'splitPlan', 'splitApply']],
  ['server/files.js', 'Excel files in the storage folder: ownership, auto-save, rewrite, delete, rebuild', ['OWNER_F', 'ownerState', 'claimFolder', 'canWrite', 'store', 'autoStore', 'autoSaveVoucher', 'autoSaveInvoice', 'autoSaveBill', 'vkey', 'safeName', 'vFile', 'bFile', 'folderPath', 'rmFile', 'dropVoucher', 'dropBill', 'refresh', 'resaveVoucher', 'resaveBill', 'rebuildFiles', 'pvToPmv']],
];
// code the script writes itself (needed because the pieces used to share one file)
const INJECT = {
  'server/http.js': { names: ['readBody', 'serveStatic'], code: `
// Reads a request body (same behaviour as the old inline req.on('data') loop).
const readBody = req => new Promise(resolve => { let b = ''; req.on('data', c => b += c); req.on('end', () => resolve(b)); });

// Static files from ./public. Anything that is not a real file inside public/ gets the app shell (index.html),
// exactly as the old single-file server answered every non-API URL.
const PUBLIC = path.join(__dirname, '..', 'public');
const MIME = { '.html': 'text/html; charset=utf-8', '.js': 'text/javascript; charset=utf-8', '.mjs': 'text/javascript; charset=utf-8', '.css': 'text/css; charset=utf-8', '.json': 'application/json; charset=utf-8', '.svg': 'image/svg+xml', '.png': 'image/png', '.jpg': 'image/jpeg', '.jpeg': 'image/jpeg', '.gif': 'image/gif', '.webp': 'image/webp', '.ico': 'image/x-icon', '.woff': 'font/woff', '.woff2': 'font/woff2', '.map': 'application/json', '.txt': 'text/plain; charset=utf-8' };
function serveStatic(res, u) {
  let rel; try { rel = decodeURIComponent(u); } catch { rel = '/'; }
  const file = path.resolve(PUBLIC, '.' + rel), inside = file.startsWith(PUBLIC + path.sep);
  if (inside && fs.existsSync(file) && fs.statSync(file).isFile()) {
    res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': MIME[path.extname(file).toLowerCase()] || 'application/octet-stream' });
    return res.end(fs.readFileSync(file));
  }
  res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'text/html' });
  return res.end(fs.readFileSync(path.join(PUBLIC, 'index.html')));
}` },
  'server/store.js': { names: ['ROOT'], code: `
const ROOT = path.join(__dirname, '..'); // project folder (data.json, db.json, settings.json and templates/ live here)`, first: true },
  'server/excel/workbook.js': { names: ['getExcelJS'], code: `
// exceljs is loaded the first time an Excel file is made, so the app still starts without it installed.
let _ExcelJS;
const getExcelJS = () => _ExcelJS || (_ExcelJS = require('exceljs'));`, first: true },
};
const ROUTE_FILES = [  // order = order the router tries them (statements must stay before xlsx: /api/xlsx/pstatement/ before the generic /api/xlsx/)
  ['data', 'GET /api/data'], ['vouchers', '/api/vouchers CRUD'], ['receipts', '/api/receipts CRUD'], ['payments', '/api/payments CRUD + /fee'],
  ['salaries', '/api/salaries CRUD + /fee'], ['purchase', '/api/purchase CRUD'], ['sales', '/api/sales CRUD'], ['accounts', '/api/accounts CRUD'],
  ['parties', '/api/db/<collection> (parties and any other master list except staff)'], ['staff', '/api/db/staff'],
  ['banks', '/api/banks + /api/bank-match + /api/bank-split'], ['settings', '/api/settings'], ['categories', '/api/categories'],
  ['statements', '/api/pstatement/:kind + /api/xlsx/pstatement/:kind'], ['xlsx', '/api/xlsx/{voucher,bill,statement,register,fonepay}/...'],
  ['migrate', '/api/migrate + /api/rebuild-files'],
];
const GROUP_OF = { data: 'data', vouchers: 'vouchers', receipts: 'receipts', payments: 'payments', salaries: 'salaries', purchase: 'purchase', sales: 'sales', accounts: 'accounts', settings: 'settings', categories: 'categories', banks: 'banks', 'bank-match': 'banks', 'bank-split': 'banks', migrate: 'migrate', 'rebuild-files': 'migrate', db: 'db' };
const NODE_GLOBALS = new Set('require module exports __dirname __filename process console Buffer setTimeout clearTimeout setInterval clearInterval setImmediate URL URLSearchParams Math JSON Date Object Array String Number Boolean Set Map WeakMap Error TypeError Promise parseInt parseFloat isNaN isFinite undefined NaN Infinity RegExp Symbol encodeURIComponent decodeURIComponent encodeURI decodeURI escape unescape globalThis arguments'.split(' '));

function routeGroup(src, st) {
  const txt = (st.type === 'IfStatement' ? src.slice(st.test.start, st.test.end) : src.slice(st.start, st.end)).replace(/\\/g, '');
  if (/\/api\/(xlsx\/)?pstatement/.test(txt)) return 'statements';
  if (/\/api\/xlsx/.test(txt)) return 'xlsx';
  const m = /\/api\/([\w-]+)/.exec(txt); if (m) { if (GROUP_OF[m[1]]) return GROUP_OF[m[1]]; fail('Unknown API path /api/' + m[1] + ' — add it to GROUP_OF in migrate.js'); }
  if (/^dm\b/.test(txt)) return 'db';
  fail('Could not tell which API a block belongs to:\n' + txt.slice(0, 200));
}

function splitServer(srcRaw) {
  console.log('\n— server.js');
  let src = srcRaw.replace(/\r\n/g, '\n');
  if (/^\/ /.test(src)) { warn('server.js line 1 starts with a single "/" (a broken comment, so the file would not start). Fixed to "//".'); src = src.replace(/^\/ /, '// '); }
  const ast = parse(src, 'server.js'), chunks = chunkProgram(src, ast, 0), prot = protectedRanges(ast);

  // 1. builtin requires become imports where needed
  const provider = new Map();                  // name -> { builtin } | { file }
  const body = [];
  let headerComment = '';
  for (const c of chunks) {
    if (c.requireOf) { for (const n of c.names) provider.set(n, { builtin: c.requireOf }); if (c.lead && !headerComment) headerComment = c.lead; continue; }
    body.push(c);
  }
  // 2. the http.createServer(...) statement is taken apart separately
  const srv = body.find(c => c.kind === 'stmt' && /createServer/.test(c.decl));
  if (!srv) fail('Could not find the http.createServer(...) statement.');
  const rest = body.filter(c => c !== srv && !(c.names.length === 1 && c.names[0] === 'ExcelJS'));   // `let ExcelJS;` is replaced by getExcelJS()

  // 3. assign every declaration to its module
  const fileOf = new Map(); for (const [f, , names] of SERVER_SPEC) for (const n of names) { if (fileOf.has(n)) fail(`"${n}" is listed in two server modules`); fileOf.set(n, f); }
  const have = new Set(rest.flatMap(c => c.names));
  for (const [n, f] of fileOf) if (!have.has(n)) warn(`server map: "${n}" (${f}) is not in server.js — ignored`);
  const unmapped = rest.filter(c => c.names.length && !c.names.every(n => fileOf.has(n))).flatMap(c => c.names.filter(n => !fileOf.has(n)));
  const strays = rest.filter(c => !c.names.length);
  if (unmapped.length || strays.length) fail('Not placed in any server module: ' + [...unmapped, ...strays.map(c => 'statement @' + c.node.loc.start.line)].join(', ') + '\n   → add them to SERVER_SPEC in migrate.js');

  // 4. text fixes needed because pieces no longer share one scope
  const fixText = t => t
    .replace(/ExcelJS = ExcelJS \|\| require\('exceljs'\);/g, 'const ExcelJS = getExcelJS();')   // lazy exceljs, now a function
    .replace(/\b__dirname\b/g, 'ROOT');                                                      // data files stay in the project root
  const mods = new Map();                      // file -> { file, desc, parts:[{pos,text}], names:Set }
  const modOf = f => { if (!mods.has(f)) { const s = SERVER_SPEC.find(x => x[0] === f); mods.set(f, { file: f, desc: s ? s[1] : '', parts: [], declared: new Set(), exportsExtra: [] }); } return mods.get(f); };
  for (const [f] of SERVER_SPEC) modOf(f);
  for (const c of rest) {
    const m = modOf(fileOf.get(c.names[0])); c.decl = fixText(c.decl);
    m.parts.push({ pos: c.pos, text: chunkText(c) }); c.names.forEach(n => m.declared.add(n));
  }
  for (const [f, inj] of Object.entries(INJECT)) { const m = modOf(f); inj.names.forEach(n => m.declared.add(n)); m.parts.push({ pos: inj.first ? -1 : 1e12, text: inj.code.trim() }); }

  // 5. the route table: every `if (...) {...}` block of the old handler, verbatim, grouped by API
  const call = srv.node.expression, fn = call.callee.object.arguments[0];
  const onEnd = fn.body.body.find(s => s.type === 'ExpressionStatement' && s.expression.type === 'CallExpression' && s.expression.callee.property && s.expression.callee.property.name === 'on' && s.expression.arguments[0] && s.expression.arguments[0].value === 'end');
  if (!onEnd) fail('Could not find req.on("end", ...) inside the server handler.');
  const tryS = onEnd.expression.arguments[1].body.body[0]; if (!tryS || tryS.type !== 'TryStatement') fail('Expected a try { ... } inside req.on("end").');
  const st = tryS.block.body, pre = st.slice(0, 3), last = st[st.length - 1], routes = st.slice(3, -1);
  if (!(pre[0].type === 'VariableDeclaration' && pre[1].type === 'ExpressionStatement' && pre[2].type === 'BlockStatement')) fail('Unexpected start of the request handler (expected: const d = load(); Object.assign(COMPANY, ...); { writeHead wrapper }).');
  if (!/404/.test(src.slice(last.start, last.end))) fail('Expected the last statement of the handler to be the 404 reply.');
  const endOf = n => { const eol = src.indexOf('\n', n.end), r = src.slice(n.end, eol < 0 ? src.length : eol), m = /^[ \t]*(\/\/.*)?$/.exec(r); return m ? n.end + r.length : n.end; };
  const sliceStm = (n, from, remove) => dedent(src.slice(from, endOf(n)), from, remove, prot);
  const groups = new Map(); let prevEnd = tryS.block.body[3].start, prevNode = pre[2];
  for (const s of routes) {
    const g = routeGroup(src, s);
    // keep comment lines that sit directly above the block
    const between = src.slice(endOf(prevNode), s.start).split('\n').map(x => x.trim()).filter(Boolean).join('\n    ');
    const text = (between ? '  ' + between.replace(/\n {4}/g, '\n  ') + '\n' : '') + '  ' + sliceStm(s, s.start, 4);
    if (!groups.has(g)) groups.set(g, []); groups.get(g).push(text); prevNode = s;
  }
  const preText = pre.map(s => '    ' + sliceStm(s, s.start, 2)).join('\n');
  const catchText = src.slice(tryS.handler.body.start, tryS.handler.body.end), fallbackText = sliceStm(last, last.start, 2);
  const tail = call.arguments;                  // .listen(5000, cb)
  const port = src.slice(tail[0].start, tail[0].end);

  const handleWrap = (blocks, extra) => `async function handle({ req, res, u, b, d }) {\n${blocks.join('\n')}\n}`;
  const routeMods = [];
  for (const [g, desc] of ROUTE_FILES) {
    const file = `server/routes/${g}.js`;
    const m = { file, desc: desc, parts: [], declared: new Set(['handle']), exportsExtra: ['handle'], route: true };
    if (g === 'staff') { m.custom = `const { makeHandler } = require('./parties');\n\nmodule.exports = { handle: makeHandler(n => n === 'staff') };\n`; m.requires = ['server/routes/parties.js']; }
    else if (g === 'parties') {
      const blocks = (groups.get('db') || []).map(t => t.replace('if (dm && SCHEMA[dm[1]])', 'if (dm && SCHEMA[dm[1]] && accept(dm[1]))'));
      if (!blocks.some(t => t.includes('accept(dm[1])'))) fail('Could not find `if (dm && SCHEMA[dm[1]])` in the /api/db block.');
      m.parts.push({ pos: 0, text: `const makeHandler = accept => async function handle({ req, res, u, b, d }) {\n${blocks.join('\n')}\n};` });
      m.declared.add('makeHandler'); m.exportsExtra = ['makeHandler']; m.tailExports = `module.exports = { handle: makeHandler(n => n !== 'staff'), makeHandler };`;
    } else {
      const blocks = groups.get(g); if (!blocks) fail('No routes found for ' + g);
      m.parts.push({ pos: 0, text: handleWrap(blocks.map(fixText)) });
    }
    routeMods.push(m); mods.set(file, m);
  }
  for (const g of groups.keys()) if (!ROUTE_FILES.some(([x]) => x === g) && g !== 'db') fail('Route group without a file: ' + g);
  // blocks that used the lazy ExcelJS need the same text fix
  for (const m of routeMods) m.parts.forEach(p => { p.text = fixText(p.text); });

  // router index
  const idx = { file: 'server/routes/index.js', desc: 'router: runs the route modules in order, 404 / 500 handling', declared: new Set(['dispatch']), exportsExtra: ['dispatch'], parts: [], localNames: new Set(routeMods.map(m => path.basename(m.file, '.js'))), extraRequires: routeMods.map(m => `const ${path.basename(m.file, '.js')} = require('./${path.basename(m.file, '.js')}');`) };
  idx.parts.push({ pos: 0, text: `const handlers = [${routeMods.map(m => path.basename(m.file, '.js')).join(', ')}];` });
  idx.parts.push({ pos: 1, text: `// Every route module exports handle(ctx). A module that answers the request sends a reply, which stops the loop;\n// one that does not match just returns, and the next one is tried. If none answers: 404.\nasync function dispatch(req, res, u, b) {\n  try {\n${preText}\n    const ctx = { req, res, u, b, d };\n    for (const h of handlers) { await h.handle(ctx); if (res.headersSent) return; }\n    ${fallbackText}\n  } catch (e) ${catchText}\n}` });
  mods.set(idx.file, idx);
  return { src, mods, provider, headerComment, port, fileOf, routeMods, srv };
}

// builds all server modules + returns {file: text}
function emitServer(S) {
  const outFiles = {}, { mods, provider } = S;
  const declaredIn = new Map(); for (const m of mods.values()) for (const n of m.declared) if (!m.route && m.file !== 'server/routes/index.js') declaredIn.set(n, m.file);
  // route modules / router import the other modules the same way
  const imports = new Map(), graph = new Map(), needed = new Map();
  const entryNeeds = { 'server/http.js': ['send', 'readBody', 'serveStatic'], 'server/routes/index.js': ['dispatch'] };
  for (const [f, ns] of Object.entries(entryNeeds)) needed.set(f, new Set(ns));
  const bodies = new Map();
  for (const m of mods.values()) {
    if (m.custom) { bodies.set(m.file, m.custom); graph.set(m.file, new Set(m.requires || [])); continue; }
    const body = m.parts.sort((a, b) => a.pos - b.pos).map(p => p.text).join('\n\n');
    const { free } = freeNames(body, m.file), im = new Map(); // source -> Set(names)
    for (const n of free) {
      if (NODE_GLOBALS.has(n) || (m.localNames && m.localNames.has(n))) continue;
      const bi = provider.get(n); if (bi && bi.builtin) { (im.get('builtin:' + bi.builtin) || im.set('builtin:' + bi.builtin, new Set()).get('builtin:' + bi.builtin)).add(n); continue; }
      const f = declaredIn.get(n); if (!f) fail(`${m.file}: uses "${n}" which is not defined anywhere (not declared in server.js).`);
      if (f === m.file) continue;
      (im.get(f) || im.set(f, new Set()).get(f)).add(n);
      if (!needed.has(f)) needed.set(f, new Set()); needed.get(f).add(n);
    }
    imports.set(m.file, im); bodies.set(m.file, body);
    graph.set(m.file, new Set([...im.keys()].filter(k => !k.startsWith('builtin:'))));
  }
  for (const m of mods.values()) if (m.route) { graph.get('server/routes/index.js').add(m.file); }
  const cyc = findCycle(graph); if (cyc) fail('Circular require between modules: ' + cyc.join(' → ') + '\n   → move a function so the cycle disappears (edit SERVER_SPEC).');

  for (const m of mods.values()) {
    const head = `// ${m.file} — ${m.desc}\n// (split out of the old single-file server.js by migrate.js; code is unchanged)\n`;
    if (m.custom) { outFiles[m.file] = head + m.custom; continue; }
    const im = imports.get(m.file), lines = [];
    const bi = [...im.keys()].filter(k => k.startsWith('builtin:')).sort();
    if (bi.length) lines.push(bi.map(k => [...im.get(k)].map(n => `${n} = require('${k.slice(8)}')`)).flat().join(', ').replace(/^/, 'const ') + ';');
    for (const f of [...im.keys()].filter(k => !k.startsWith('builtin:')).sort()) lines.push(`const { ${[...im.get(f)].sort().join(', ')} } = require('${requireFn(m.file, f)}');`);
    if (m.extraRequires) lines.push(...m.extraRequires);
    const exp = [...new Set([...(needed.get(m.file) || []), ...(m.route ? m.exportsExtra : [])])].sort();
    const tail = m.tailExports || `module.exports = { ${exp.join(', ')} };`;
    outFiles[m.file] = head + (lines.length ? lines.join('\n') + '\n' : '') + '\n' + bodies.get(m.file) + '\n\n' + tail + '\n';
  }
  return outFiles;
}

function serverEntry(S) {
  const hc = (S.headerComment || '// Zero-dependency server: `node server.js` then open http://localhost:5000').replace(/localhost:3000/g, 'localhost:5000');
  return `${hc}
// Entry point only: the code now lives in ./server (http, store, excel/, posting/, banks, files, routes/).
const http = require('http');
const { readBody, serveStatic } = require('./server/http');
const { dispatch } = require('./server/routes');

const PORT = process.env.PORT || ${S.port};
http.createServer((req, res) => {
  const u = req.url.split('?')[0];
  if (!u.startsWith('/api/')) return serveStatic(res, u);   // the page, /app.js, /pages/*.js, /styles/*.css ...
  readBody(req).then(b => dispatch(req, res, u, b));
}).listen(PORT, () => console.log('Accounts app running at http://localhost:' + PORT));
`;
}

  ['public/pages/registers.js', 'VAT register page', ['reg']],

  ['public/pages/trial.js', 'Trial balance, income statement, balance sheet', ['tb', 'pl', 'bs', 'rows', 'section', 'dl', 'collected']],
  ['public/pages/accounts.js', 'Chart of accounts page', ['coa', 'addAcc', 'delAcc']],
  ['public/pages/parties.js', 'Parties page', ['parties', 'saveParty', 'editParty', 'delParty']],

const big = f => { try { return fs.statSync(f).size > 2000; } catch { return false; } };
function pickSources() {

function restore() {
  for (const [from, to] of [['_original/server.js', 'server.js'], ['_original/index.html', 'public/index.html']]) {

}

function main() {
  if (flag('restore')) return restore();
  const { s, h } = pickSources();
  console.log(`Root: ${ROOT}${DRY ? '   (DRY RUN: nothing will be written)' : ''}\nserver source: ${path.relative(ROOT, s)}\nhtml source:   ${path.relative(ROOT, h)}`);
  const serverSrc = fs.readFileSync(s, 'utf8'), htmlSrc = fs.readFileSync(h, 'utf8');

    const imports = [...o.im.entries()].sort((a, b) => a[0].localeCompare(b[0])).map(([from, names]) => `import { ${[...names].sort().join(', ')} } from '${importFn(f, from)}';`).join('\n');

    .replace(/<style>[\s\S]*?<\/style>/, CSS_FILES.map(f => `<link rel="stylesheet" href="/styles/${f}.css">`).join('\n  '))

  for (const [f, n] of written) console.log('  ' + f.padEnd(36) + String(n).padStart(5) + ' lines');

function selfTest() {   // load every server module in a child process (catches typos / missing exports at once)

  const code = `for (const f of ${JSON.stringify(files)}) require('./' + f); console.log('  self-test: all ${files.length} server modules load');`;
  const r = cp.spawnSync(process.execPath, ['-e', code], { cwd: ROOT, encoding: 'utf8' });
  if (r.status !== 0) { console.log(r.stderr || r.stdout); fail('self-test failed — run  node migrate.js --restore  and send me the message above'); }
  console.log(r.stdout.trim());
}

try { main(); } catch (e) { console.error('\n✗ ' + e.message); process.exit(1); }

import * as m_pages_receipts from './pages/receipts.js';
import * as m_pages_records from './pages/records.js';
import * as m_pages_registers from './pages/registers.js';
import * as m_pages_salary_forms from './pages/salary-forms.js';
import * as m_pages_salary from './pages/salary.js';
import * as m_pages_settings from './pages/settings.js';
import * as m_pages_statement_forms from './pages/statement-forms.js';
import * as m_pages_statements from './pages/statements.js';
import * as m_pages_trial from './pages/trial.js';
import * as m_pages_voucher from './pages/voucher.js';
import { $, NARROW, applySide, setSideTmp, syncAllTW } from './lib/dom.js';
import { load } from './lib/state.js';
import * as m_pages_cashbook from './pages/cashbook.js';
import * as m_pages_refunds from './pages/refunds.js';
import './lib/datepair.js';

// Inline handlers (onclick="save()", onchange="...tab...") run in the global scope. The old single <script> put every
// top-level name there, so mirror the same names on window. Page renderers (dash, rec, ...) were never global and are skipped.
const NAMESPACES = [m_pages_refunds, m_pages_cashbook, m_lib_charts, m_lib_dom, m_lib_format, m_lib_state, m_pages_accounts, m_pages_bills_forms, m_pages_bills, m_pages_dashboard, m_pages_daybook, m_pages_index, m_pages_ledger, m_pages_parties, m_pages_payments_forms, m_pages_payments, m_pages_receipts_forms, m_pages_receipts, m_pages_records, m_pages_registers, m_pages_salary_forms, m_pages_salary, m_pages_settings, m_pages_statement_forms, m_pages_statements, m_pages_trial, m_pages_voucher];
const SKIP = new Set(["refunds", "cashbook", "stmt","dash","rec","sal","parties","settings","rcv","pay","reg","bills","voucher","daybook","ledger","tb","pl","bs","coa","D","tab","sideTmp","twQueued","setTab","setSideTmp"]);
for (const ns of NAMESPACES) for (const k of Object.keys(ns)) {
  if (SKIP.has(k)) continue;
  try { Object.defineProperty(window, k, { value: ns[k], writable: true, configurable: true, enumerable: true }); } catch (e) { console.warn('could not expose', k, e.message); }
}
// Shared variables that handlers read or assign directly (e.g. onclick="tab='rec'; render()") stay live through accessors.
for (const [k, get, set] of [
  ['D', () => m_lib_state.D],
  ['tab', () => m_lib_state.tab, v => m_lib_state.setTab(v)],
  ['sideTmp', () => m_lib_dom.sideTmp, v => m_lib_dom.setSideTmp(v)],
  ['twQueued', () => m_lib_dom.twQueued]
]) Object.defineProperty(window, k, { get, set: set || (() => {}), configurable: true });

// ---- boot (was the end of the old <script>) ----
NARROW.addEventListener('change', () => { setSideTmp(null); applySide(); });

applySide();

new MutationObserver(syncAllTW).observe($('#m'), { childList: true, subtree: true });

addEventListener('resize', syncAllTW);

const t = new Date();

const y = t.getMonth() > 5 && !(t.getMonth() == 6 && t.getDate() < 16) ? t.getFullYear() : t.getFullYear() - 1; // Shrawan 1 ≈ Jul 16

$('#from').value = y + '-07-16';

$('#to').value = (y + 1) + '-07-15';

load();

 .sc .tog{position:static}.sc .tog svg{transform:rotate(180deg)}
 .sc .ng{height:1px;margin:10px 10px;padding:0;font-size:0;background:#ffffff22}
 .sc .side nav button{justify-content:center;padding:7px 0}
 .sc .side nav button span{display:none}
 .sc .side nav button.on{box-shadow:inset 3px 0 0 var(--foil)}
}

/* ---------- responsive ---------- */
@media(max-width:1100px){.vat.k4{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}}
@media(max-width:1000px){.split{grid-template-columns:1fr}.stub{position:static}.md{grid-template-columns:1fr}.lc{position:static;max-height:none}}
@media(max-width:860px){
 .app{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}
 .side{position:static;height:auto;padding:10px 10px 0;overflow:visible}.side::after,.co,.ng,.tog{display:none}
 .brand{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:10px;padding:0 6px 8px;margin:0;border:0}.brand .dev{font-size:24px}.brand .lat{margin:0}
 .side nav{flex:none;display:flex;overflow-x:auto;gap:2px;padding-bottom:8px}
 .side nav button{width:auto;white-space:nowrap}.side nav button.on{box-shadow:inset 0 -3px 0 var(--foil)}
 .top{position:static;padding:12px 14px}.period{margin-left:0;flex-wrap:wrap}main{padding:16px 12px 60px}
 .row .w2{grid-column:auto}.vat.k4{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}.vat b{font-size:19px}
}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{transition:none!important;animation:none!important}}
@media print{.side,.tws,.period,.tool,button,.bar,.seg{display:none!important}.app{display:block}.top{position:static;border:0;background:none}main{padding:0;max-width:none}.card{border:0;padding:0}}
</style></head><body>
<div class="app">
<aside class="side">
<div class="brand"><div class="dev" lang="ne"><span class="full">लेखा</span><span class="short">ले</span></div><div class="lat">Travel &amp; Tours accounts</div>
<button class="tog" id="sbtog" type="button" onclick="toggleSide()"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m15 6-6 6 6 6"/></svg></button></div>
<nav id="nav" aria-label="Main"></nav>
<div class="co"><b id="co"></b><span id="cov"></span></div>
</aside>
<div class="pg">
<header class="top"><div class="tt"><h1 id="pgt"></h1><p id="pgs"></p></div>
<div class="period" id="period"><span>Period</span><input type="date" id="from" aria-label="From date" onchange="if(!NOPERIOD.includes(tab))render()"><span aria-hidden="true">to</span><input type="date" id="to" aria-label="To date" onchange="if(!NOPERIOD.includes(tab))render()">
<select id="pq" aria-label="Quick range" onchange="quickPeriod(this.value)"><option value="">Quick range</option><option value="fy">This fiscal year</option><option value="pfy">Last fiscal year</option><option value="m">This month</option><option value="all">All dates</option></select></div></header>
<main id="m"></main></div></div>
<div id="toast" role="status" aria-live="polite"></div><datalist id="al"></datalist><datalist id="pls"></datalist><datalist id="plc"></datalist><datalist id="stf"></datalist>
<script>
let D, tab = 'dash'; const $ = s => document.querySelector(s);
const ymd = (d = new Date()) => d.getFullYear() + '-' + String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0') + '-' + String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0'); // local date, not UTC
const f = n => (+n).toLocaleString('en-IN', {minimumFractionDigits:2, maximumFractionDigits:2}); // lakh/crore grouping
const esc = s => String(s ?? '').replace(/[&<>"]/g, c => ({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;'}[c]));
const TABS = {dash:'Dashboard',rec:'Records',stmt:'Statements',sal:'Salary payment',voucher:'New voucher',bills:'Purchase & sales bills',rcv:'Payments received',pay:'Payments made',reg:'VAT registers',daybook:'Day book',ledger:'Ledger',tb:'Trial balance',pl:'Income statement',bs:'Balance sheet',coa:'Accounts',parties:'Parties',settings:'Settings'};
const ic = p => `<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true">${p}</svg>`;
const IC = {
 dash: ic('<rect x="3" y="3" width="7" height="9" rx="1.5"/><rect x="14" y="3" width="7" height="5" rx="1.5"/><rect x="14" y="12" width="7" height="9" rx="1.5"/><rect x="3" y="16" width="7" height="5" rx="1.5"/>'),
 rec: ic('<path d="M4 4h16v5H4z"/><path d="M5 9v10a1 1 0 0 0 1 1h12a1 1 0 0 0 1-1V9"/><path d="M10 13h4"/>'),
 stmt: ic('<path d="M14 3H7a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v14a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h10a2 2 0 0 0 2-2V8Z"/><path d="M14 3v5h5"/><path d="M9 13h6M9 17h6"/>'),
 sal: ic('<rect x="3" y="6" width="18" height="14" rx="2"/><path d="M3 10h18"/><circle cx="16.5" cy="15" r="1"/>'),
 voucher: ic('<path d="M12 20h9"/><path d="M16.5 3.5a2.1 2.1 0 0 1 3 3L7 19l-4 1 1-4Z"/>'),
 bills: ic('<path d="M5 3h14v18l-2.3-1.5L14.3 21 12 19.5 9.7 21l-2.4-1.5L5 21Z"/><path d="M9 8h6M9 12h6"/>'),
 rcv: ic('<path d="M12 3v12"/><path d="m7 10 5 5 5-5"/><path d="M4 17v2a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h12a2 2 0 0 0 2-2v-2"/>'),
 pay: ic('<path d="M12 15V3"/><path d="m7 8 5-5 5 5"/><path d="M4 17v2a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h12a2 2 0 0 0 2-2v-2"/>'),
 reg: ic('<path d="M5 3h12a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v16H7a2 2 0 0 1-2-2Z"/><path d="M5 19a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h12"/><path d="M9 7h6M9 11h6"/>'),
 daybook: ic('<rect x="3" y="5" width="18" height="16" rx="2"/><path d="M3 10h18M8 3v4M16 3v4"/>'),
 ledger: ic('<path d="M12 6.5C10.5 5 8 4.5 3 4.5v14c5 0 7.5.5 9 2 1.5-1.5 4-2 9-2v-14c-5 0-7.5.5-9 2Z"/><path d="M12 6.5v14"/>'),
 tb: ic('<path d="M12 3v18M7 21h10"/><path d="M5 7h14"/><path d="m5 7-3 7a4 4 0 0 0 6 0Z"/><path d="m19 7-3 7a4 4 0 0 0 6 0Z"/>'),
 pl: ic('<path d="m3 17 6-6 4 4 8-8"/><path d="M15 7h6v6"/>'),
 bs: ic('<rect x="3" y="4" width="18" height="16" rx="2"/><path d="M12 4v16"/><path d="M6.5 9h2M6.5 13h2M15.5 9h2M15.5 13h2"/>'),
 coa: ic('<path d="M8 6h13M8 12h13M8 18h13"/><path d="M3 6h.01M3 12h.01M3 18h.01"/>'),
 parties: ic('<circle cx="9" cy="8" r="3.5"/><path d="M2.5 20a6.5 6.5 0 0 1 13 0"/><path d="M16 4.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 0 7"/><path d="M18 14a6 6 0 0 1 3.5 6"/>'),
 settings: ic('<path d="M3 7h9M16 7h5"/><circle cx="14" cy="7" r="2"/><path d="M3 17h5M12 17h9"/><circle cx="10" cy="17" r="2"/>')};
const TSUB = {
 dash: 'How the business is doing in the selected period.',
 rec: 'Find, edit or delete anything you have entered.',
 stmt: 'Statements for suppliers, customers, staff and expenses.',
 sal: 'Record salary paid to staff.',
 voucher: 'Post a manual journal, payment or receipt voucher.',
 bills: 'Enter supplier bills and make VAT invoices for customers.',
 rcv: 'Money received from customers, and what is still due.',
 pay: 'Money paid to suppliers, and what is still owed.',
 reg: 'Purchase and sales books for your VAT return.',
 daybook: 'Every voucher in date order.',
 ledger: 'All entries for one account, with a running balance.',
 tb: 'Debit and credit balance of every account.',
 pl: 'Income, costs and profit for the period.',
 bs: 'Assets, liabilities and equity as at the end date.',
 coa: 'The accounts available in vouchers and reports.',
 parties: 'Suppliers and customers saved for the bill forms.',
 settings: 'Storage folder, categories, bank accounts and company details.'};
const NAV = [['Overview',['dash']],['Enter',['voucher','bills','rcv','pay','sal']],['Records',['rec','stmt','daybook']],['Books',['ledger','reg']],['Reports',['tb','pl','bs']],['Setup',['coa','parties','settings']]];
const NOPERIOD = ['voucher','bills','rcv','pay','sal','rec','stmt','coa','parties','settings'];
const acc = c => D.accounts.find(a => a.code == c), nm = c => acc(c) ? c + ' ' + acc(c).name : c;
const FR = () => $('#from').value, TO = () => $('#to').value;
const cum = d => d <= TO(), per = d => d >= FR() && d <= TO(), pre = d => d < FR();
const net = (c, p) => D.vouchers.reduce((s,v) => p(v.date) ? s + v.lines.reduce((t,l) => l.account == c ? t + l.dr - l.cr : t, 0) : s, 0); // Dr - Cr
const closing = a => net(a.code, 'ALE'.includes(a.type) ? cum : per);
const priorPL = () => D.accounts.filter(a => 'IX'.includes(a.type)).reduce((s,a) => s + net(a.code, pre), 0); // Dr-Cr; profit = -this
const ofType = t => D.accounts.filter(a => t.includes(a.type));
const groups = list => [...new Set(list.map(a => a.group))];

const hid = () => { const n = D.vouchers.filter(v => v.date < FR() || v.date > TO()).length; return n ? `<div class="warn err">${n} voucher(s) have dates outside ${FR()} to ${TO()}, so they are not fully shown here. <button onclick="showAll()">Show all dates</button></div>` : ''; };
function quickPeriod(k) { const t = new Date(), p = n => String(n).padStart(2, '0'), s = (y, m, d) => y + '-' + p(m) + '-' + p(d), fy = t.getMonth() > 5 && !(t.getMonth() == 6 && t.getDate() < 16) ? t.getFullYear() : t.getFullYear() - 1; $('#pq').value = '';
  if (k == 'all') return showAll();
  const r = {fy: [s(fy, 7, 16), s(fy + 1, 7, 15)], pfy: [s(fy - 1, 7, 16), s(fy, 7, 15)], m: [s(t.getFullYear(), t.getMonth() + 1, 1), s(t.getFullYear(), t.getMonth() + 1, new Date(t.getFullYear(), t.getMonth() + 1, 0).getDate())]}[k];
  if (!r) return; $('#from').value = r[0]; $('#to').value = r[1]; if (!NOPERIOD.includes(tab)) render(); }
function showAll() { const ds = D.vouchers.map(v => v.date).sort(); if (!ds.length) return; $('#from').value = ds[0]; $('#to').value = ds[ds.length - 1]; render(); }
const badAD = d => d && +d.slice(0, 4) > 2060 && (alert('The Date (AD) field says year ' + d.slice(0, 4) + ', which looks like a BS date. Put the English (AD) date there and type the BS date in the BS field.'), true);
const resolveAcc = t => { t = t.trim().toLowerCase(); if (!t) return null; const A = D.accounts;
  const ex = A.find(a => t == a.code || t == a.name.toLowerCase() || t == (a.code + ' ' + a.name).toLowerCase()) || A.find(a => a.code == t.split(' ')[0]); if (ex) return ex.code;
  const part = A.filter(a => a.name.toLowerCase().includes(t)); return part.length == 1 ? part[0].code : null; };
const showErr = m => { $('#msg').innerHTML = `<span class="err">${esc(m)}</span>`; alert(m); };
async function load() { D = await (await fetch('/api/data')).json(); render(); const o = (D.settings || {}).folderOwner; if (o && !o.ok && !window.ownWarned) { window.ownWarned = 1; alert('Warning: the storage folder (' + D.settings.folder + ') belongs to another copy of this app:\n' + o.owner + '\n\nThis copy will NOT write or delete any files there, so nothing is overwritten. If this is a copy you only wanted to try, set a different storage folder under Settings. If you moved the project, open Settings and press Save settings to take the folder over.'); } }
async function rebuildFiles() { if (!confirm('Rewrite the Excel files of every voucher and bill from this app\'s data? Files with the same names in the storage folder are replaced.')) return;
  const j = await post('/api/rebuild-files', {missing: $('#rbm').checked}); if (!j) return; await load();
  alert(j.vouchers + ' voucher file(s) and ' + j.bills + ' bill file(s) rebuilt.' + (j.orphanCount ? '\n\n' + j.orphanCount + ' file(s) in the folder do not belong to any voucher here (maybe made by another copy). They were left alone:\n' + j.orphans.slice(0, 25).join(', ') + (j.orphanCount > 25 ? ', …' : '') : '')); }
function render() {
  $('#nav').innerHTML = NAV.map(([g, ks]) => `<div class="ng">${g}</div>` + ks.map(k => `<button class="${k==tab?'on':''}" title="${TABS[k]}" aria-label="${TABS[k]}"${k==tab?' aria-current="page"':''} onclick="tab='${k}';window.eb=window.ev=window.er=window.rnew=window.pye=window.pyn=window.sle=window.sls=window.slp=window.bm=window.bke=null;render()">${IC[k]}<span>${TABS[k]}</span></button>`).join('')).join('');
  $('#pgt').textContent = TABS[tab]; $('#pgs').textContent = TSUB[tab] || ''; document.title = TABS[tab] + ' – Lekha'; { const co = D.settings.company; $('#co').textContent = co.name || ''; $('#cov').textContent = co.vat ? 'PAN/VAT ' + co.vat : ''; } $('#period').classList.toggle('off', NOPERIOD.includes(tab));
  $('#al').innerHTML = D.accounts.map(a => `<option value="${a.code} ${esc(a.name)}">`).join('');
  const pl = t => D.db.parties.filter(p => p.type != t).map(p => `<option value="${esc(p.name)}">`).join(''); $('#pls').innerHTML = pl('customer'); $('#plc').innerHTML = pl('supplier'); $('#stf').innerHTML = D.db.staff.map(p => `<option value="${esc(p.name)}">`).join('');
  $('#m').innerHTML = (NOPERIOD.includes(tab) ? '' : hid()) + V[tab]();
  if (tab == 'voucher') { (window.ev ? window.ev.lines : [null, null]).forEach(l => addLine(l)); calc(); } if (tab == 'bills') { pcalc(); scalc(''); if (!(window.eb && window.eb.kind == 'sales')) fillParty('sc', 'sv'); } if (tab == 'rec') recFilter(); if (tab == 'stmt') loadStmt();
}
function addLine(l) {
  $('#ls').insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', `<tr><td><input list="al" class="ac" placeholder="Type code or name" value="${l ? esc(nm(l.account)) : ''}" oninput="calc()"></td>
  <td class="n"><input class="dr" type="number" step="any" style="text-align:right" value="${l && l.dr ? l.dr : ''}" oninput="calc()"></td><td class="n"><input class="cr" type="number" step="any" style="text-align:right" value="${l && l.cr ? l.cr : ''}" oninput="calc()"></td>
  <td><button class="x" title="Remove line" onclick="this.closest('tr').remove();calc()">×</button></td></tr>`);
}
function calc() {
  let d = 0, c = 0; document.querySelectorAll('#ls tr').forEach(r => { const ac = r.querySelector('.ac'); ac.style.borderColor = ac.value && !resolveAcc(ac.value) ? '#B42318' : ''; d += +r.querySelector('.dr').value || 0; c += +r.querySelector('.cr').value || 0; });
  $('#tot').innerHTML = `<span>Debit <b>${f(d)}</b></span><span>Credit <b>${f(c)}</b></span>` + (Math.abs(d-c) < .005 && d > 0 ? '<span class="ok"><b>Balanced</b></span>' : !d && !c ? '<span>Enter debit and credit amounts</span>' : `<span class="err"><b>Difference ${f(d-c)}</b></span>`);
}
async function save() {
  if (badAD($('#vd').value)) return;
  const rows = [...document.querySelectorAll('#ls tr')].map(r => ({t: r.querySelector('.ac').value, dr: r.querySelector('.dr').value, cr: r.querySelector('.cr').value}));
  const bad = rows.filter(r => (+r.dr || +r.cr) && !resolveAcc(r.t));
  if (bad.length) return showErr('Account not found: ' + bad.map(r => '"' + (r.t || 'blank') + '"').join(', ') + '. Pick an account from the list while typing, or add it in the Accounts tab.');
  const lines = rows.map(r => ({account: resolveAcc(r.t), dr: r.dr, cr: r.cr}));
  const body = {type: $('#vt').value, date: $('#vd').value, bs: $('#vb').value, ref: $('#vr').value, narration: $('#vn').value, lines};
  const ed = window.ev, r = await fetch('/api/vouchers' + (ed ? '/' + ed.id : ''), {method: ed ? 'PUT' : 'POST', headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'}, body: JSON.stringify(body)});
  const j = await r.json(); if (!r.ok) return showErr(j.error);
  if (ed) { window.ev = null; tab = 'daybook'; await load(); return toast('Updated ' + j.no + (j.saved ? '\nExcel refreshed: ' + j.saved : '')); }
  await load(); const out = body.date < FR() || body.date > TO(); $('#msg').innerHTML = `<span class="ok">Saved ${j.no}${j.saved ? ' → ' + esc(j.saved) : ''}</span>` + (out ? ' <span class="err">but its date is outside the From/To period at the top, so it will not show in reports until you change that period.</span>' : '');
}
async function rm(id, ask) { if (!confirm(ask)) return; window.sp = null; if (window.er && window.er.id == id) window.er = null; if (window.pye && window.pye.id == id) window.pye = null; if (window.ev && window.ev.id == id) window.ev = null; if (window.sle && window.sle.id == id) window.sle = null; if (window.eb && window.eb.voucherId == id) window.eb = null; const r = await fetch('/api/vouchers/' + id, {method: 'DELETE'}), j = await r.json().catch(() => ({})); await load(); toast(j.files && j.files.length ? 'Deleted. Excel file(s) removed:\n' + j.files.join('\n') : 'Deleted.'); }
const del = id => rm(id, 'Delete this voucher and its Excel file? This cannot be undone.');
async function addAcc() {
  const g = i => $('#' + i).value, r = await fetch('/api/accounts', {method:'POST', headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'}, body: JSON.stringify({code:g('ac1'), name:g('ac2'), type:g('ac3'), group:g('ac4')})});
  if (!r.ok) return alert((await r.json()).error); load();
}
const rows = (list, valFn) => list.map(a => ({a, v: valFn(a)})).filter(x => Math.abs(x.v) > .004);
const section = (title, list, sign) => { // list of accounts, sign flips Dr-Cr into natural balance
  let tot = 0, h = `<tr class="sec"><th colspan="2">${title}</th></tr>`;
  groups(list).forEach(g => { const r = rows(list.filter(a => a.group == g), a => sign * closing(a)); if (!r.length) return;
    h += (g == title ? '' : `<tr class="grp"><td colspan="2">${esc(g)}</td></tr>`) + r.map(x => `<tr><td class="ind">${x.a.code} ${esc(x.a.name)}</td><td class="n">${f(x.v)}</td></tr>`).join(''); tot += r.reduce((s,x) => s + x.v, 0); });
  return {h, tot};
};
const dl = k => `<div class="tool"><button class="p" onclick="getFile('/api/xlsx/statement/${k}?from=${FR()}&to=${TO()}')">Download Excel</button></div>`;
const toast = (m, k) => { const t = $('#toast'); t.innerHTML = esc(m) + (k ? '<br><a href="#" style="color:#fff;font-weight:600" onclick="goRec(\'' + k + '\');return false">View in Records →</a>' : ''); t.style.display = 'block'; clearTimeout(window.tt); window.tt = setTimeout(() => t.style.display = 'none', 7000); };
async function getFile(url) { const r = await fetch(url); if (!r.ok) return alert((await r.json()).error || 'Download failed');
  const saved = r.headers.get('X-Saved-To'); if (saved) return toast('Saved to ' + decodeURIComponent(saved));
  const a = document.createElement('a'); a.href = URL.createObjectURL(await r.blob()); a.download = (/filename="([^"]+)"/.exec(r.headers.get('Content-Disposition')) || [])[1] || 'file.xlsx'; a.click();
  toast("Downloaded by the browser. Set a storage folder (and keep its switch on) in Settings to save elsewhere."); }
const delBill = (id, kind) => rm(id, 'Delete this ' + kind + ' bill, its voucher and their Excel files? This cannot be undone.');
async function delAcc(code) { if (!confirm('Delete account ' + code + '?')) return; const r = await fetch('/api/accounts/' + code, {method: 'DELETE'}); if (!r.ok) return alert((await r.json()).error); load(); }
async function addCat() { const j = await post('/api/categories', {name: F('newcat')}); if (j) load(); }
async function delCat(i) { if (!confirm('Remove this category from the list? Existing entries keep their accounts.')) return; await fetch('/api/categories/' + encodeURIComponent(D.settings.categories[i]), {method: 'DELETE'}); load(); }
// ---- Dashboard helpers (plain SVG/HTML, no libraries) ----
const K = n => { const a = Math.abs(n), s = n < 0 ? '-' : ''; return s + (a >= 1e7 ? (a / 1e7).toFixed(2) + ' Cr' : a >= 1e5 ? (a / 1e5).toFixed(2) + ' L' : a >= 1e3 ? (a / 1e3).toFixed(1) + 'k' : Math.round(a)); };
const f0 = n => Math.round(n).toLocaleString('en-IN'), PAL = ['#27418F', '#E0A030', '#7A1F33', '#2E8B77', '#6C7BB8', '#C9694B', '#8FB3A6', '#9AA0AE'];
const hbars = (items, col = 'var(--pine)') => { const mx = Math.max(...items.map(i => Math.abs(i.v)), 1); return items.length ? items.map(i => `<div class="hb" title="${esc(i.l)}: ${f(i.v)}"><span>${esc(i.l)}</span><div><i style="width:${Math.max(Math.abs(i.v) / mx * 100, 1.5)}%;background:${col}"></i></div><b>${K(i.v)}</b>${i.s ? `<small>${esc(i.s)}</small>` : ''}</div>`).join('') : '<p class="sub" style="margin:0">Nothing to show for this period.</p>'; };
function barChart(labels, series) {
  const W = 720, H = 250, L = 50, B = 26, T = 10, all = series.flatMap(s => s.vals), mx = Math.max(...all, 1), mn = Math.min(...all, 0), raw = (mx - mn) / 4, p = 10 ** Math.floor(Math.log10(raw)), step = [1, 2, 2.5, 5, 10].map(x => x * p).find(x => x >= raw), top = Math.ceil(mx / step) * step, bot = Math.floor(mn / step) * step;
  const y = v => T + (top - v) / ((top - bot) || 1) * (H - T - B), gw = (W - L - 8) / labels.length, bw = Math.min(26, gw * .8 / series.length);
  let s = `<svg viewBox="0 0 ${W} ${H}" role="img" style="width:100%;height:auto;display:block">`;
  for (let v = bot; v <= top + 1e-9; v += step) s += `<line x1="${L}" x2="${W - 8}" y1="${y(v)}" y2="${y(v)}" stroke="#E4E2DB"/><text x="${L - 6}" y="${y(v) + 4}" text-anchor="end" font-size="11" fill="#656A77">${K(v)}</text>`;
  labels.forEach((lb, i) => { const x0 = L + i * gw + (gw - bw * series.length) / 2;
    series.forEach((se, j) => { const v = se.vals[i]; s += `<rect x="${x0 + j * bw}" y="${Math.min(y(v), y(0))}" width="${bw - 2}" height="${Math.abs(y(v) - y(0))}" rx="2" fill="${v < 0 ? '#B42318' : se.color}"><title>${esc(lb)} · ${esc(se.name)}: ${f(v)}</title></rect>`; });
    s += `<text x="${L + i * gw + gw / 2}" y="${H - 8}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#656A77">${esc(lb)}</text>`; });
  return s + '</svg>' + (series.length > 1 ? `<div class="lg">${series.map(x => `<span><i style="background:${x.color}"></i>${esc(x.name)}</span>`).join('')}</div>` : ''); }
function donut(items) { const tot = items.reduce((s, i) => s + i.v, 0); if (!tot) return '<p class="sub" style="margin:0">Nothing to show for this period.</p>'; let off = 25;
  const arcs = items.map((i, k) => { const q = i.v / tot * 100, a = `<circle r="15.915" cx="21" cy="21" fill="none" stroke="${PAL[k % PAL.length]}" stroke-width="7" stroke-dasharray="${q} ${100 - q}" stroke-dashoffset="${off}"><title>${esc(i.l)}: ${f(i.v)} (${q.toFixed(1)}%)</title></circle>`; off -= q; return a; }).join('');
  return `<div class="dn"><svg viewBox="0 0 42 42" width="170" height="170" role="img">${arcs}<text x="21" y="22.5" text-anchor="middle" font-size="4.2" font-weight="600" fill="#1E2230">${K(tot)}</text></svg><div>${items.map((i, k) => `<div class="lgi"><i style="background:${PAL[k % PAL.length]}"></i>${esc(i.l)}<b>${(i.v / tot * 100).toFixed(0)}%</b></div>`).join('')}</div></div>`; }
// ---- Records page ----
function recFilter() { const g = id => { const e = document.getElementById(id); return e ? e.value : ''; }, q = g('rq').trim().toLowerCase().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean), c = g('rfc'), a = g('rfa'), p = g('rfp'), m = g('rfm'), d1 = g('rd1'), d2 = g('rd2'); let n = 0, all = 0, tot = 0;
  document.querySelectorAll('#rbody tr[data-q]').forEach(r => { all++; const x = r.dataset, ok = q.every(w => x.q.includes(w)) && (!c || x.c == c) && (!a || x.a == a) && (!p || x.p == p) && (!m || x.m == m) && (!d1 || x.d >= d1) && (!d2 || x.d <= d2); r.hidden = !ok; if (ok) { n++; tot += +x.amt; } });
  const el = $('#rcount'); if (el) el.textContent = `Showing ${n} of ${all} · total ${f(tot)}`; }
function goRec(k) { tab = 'rec'; window.rt = k; window.eb = null; render(); scrollTo(0, 0); }
function pickPurchase(id) { if (id) makeSale(id); else { window.sp = null; render(); } }
// ---- Salary payment page ----
function lmode() { $('#lfw').hidden = $('#lmo').value != 'Fonepay'; const want = {Cash: ['cash'], Cheque: ['bank'], Fonepay: ['fonepay', 'bank'], 'Bank transfer': ['bank']}[$('#lmo').value] || []; for (const w of want) { const a = cashAccs().find(x => x.name.toLowerCase().includes(w)); if (a) { $('#lac').value = a.code; break; } } chqPick('lin', 'lac', 'lmo'); }
async function saveSalary() { if (!chqOk('lin', 'lac', 'lmo')) return; const er = window.sle, body = {staff: F('lnm'), period: F('lpr'), date: F('ldt'), bs: F('lbs'), amount: N('lam'), mode: F('lmo'), account: F('lac'), instrument: F('lin'), note: F('lnt'), debitAccount: F('lde'), fee: N('lfe')};
  const j = await post(er ? '/api/salaries/' + er.id : '/api/salaries', body, er ? 'PUT' : 'POST'); if (!j) return; window.sle = null; window.slp = null; window.sls = null; await load();
  toast('Salary ' + j.no + (er ? ' updated' : ' recorded for ' + body.staff) + (j.saved ? '\nSaved to ' + j.saved : ''), 'salary'); }
function pickStaff(i) { window.sle = null; window.sls = D.db.staff[i].name; window.slp = {staff: D.db.staff[i].name}; render(); }
async function saveStaff() { const j = await post('/api/db/staff', {name: F('ldn'), designation: F('ldg'), phone: F('lph')}); if (j) { window.sls = j.name; await load(); toast('Staff saved'); } }
async function delStaff(i) { if (!confirm('Remove this person from the staff list? Their past salary payments stay in the books.')) return; await fetch('/api/db/staff/' + encodeURIComponent(D.db.staff[i].name), {method: 'DELETE'}); window.sls = null; load(); }
async function migrateOld() { const p = await (await fetch('/api/migrate')).json(); if (!p.salaries.length && !p.files) return toast('Nothing to update. No old salary payments or payment voucher files need converting.');
  if (!confirm((p.salaries.length ? p.salaries.length + ' payment(s) will become salary payments:\n\n' + p.salaries.map(x => x.date + '  ' + x.payee + '  ' + f(x.amount)).join('\n') : '') + (p.files ? '\n\n' + p.files + ' payment voucher Excel file(s) will be moved from the PV folder to the PMV folder.' : '') + '\n\nA backup of data.json and db.json is made first. Continue?')) return;
  const j = await (await fetch('/api/migrate', {method: 'POST'})).json(); await load(); toast(j.converted + ' payment(s) converted, ' + j.moved + ' file(s) moved to PMV. Backup files end with .bak-' + j.backup); }

// ---- Bank accounts and cheque number formats ----
// Same rule as server.js: a cheque number fits a bank when one run of digits in it matches the format (7895xxxx: x = any digit; digits only = "starts with").
const fmtParts = f => String(f || '').split(/[,;]+/).map(x => x.toLowerCase().replace(/[\s-]/g, '').replace(/[#*?]/g, 'x')).filter(Boolean).map(s => ({s, pre: !s.includes('x')}));
const fmtHit = (p, run) => p.pre ? run.startsWith(p.s) : run.length === p.s.length && [...p.s].every((c, i) => c === 'x' || c === run[i]);
const banksFor = instr => { const runs = String(instr || '').match(/\d+/g) || []; return (D.db.banks || []).filter(b => acc(b.ledger) && fmtParts(b.chequeFormat).some(p => runs.some(r => fmtHit(p, r)))); };
function chqPick(inId, accId, modeId) { if (F(modeId) != 'Cheque') return; const h = banksFor(F(inId)), s = $('#' + accId); if (h.length == 1 && s.querySelector(`option[value="${h[0].ledger}"]`)) s.value = h[0].ledger; }
function chqOk(inId, accId, modeId) { if (F(modeId) != 'Cheque') return true; const h = banksFor(F(inId)); if (h.length != 1 || h[0].ledger == F(accId)) return true;
  return confirm(`Cheque no. ${F(inId)} fits the format of ${h[0].name} (${h[0].chequeFormat}), but "${(acc(F(accId)) || {}).name || 'another account'}" is chosen under Paid from.\n\nSave anyway?`); }
const payFromName = p => p.splits ? [...new Set(p.splits.map(y => (acc(y.account) || {}).name || y.account))].join(' + ') : (acc(p.account) || {}).name || ''; // a split payment (several cheques / banks) lists every bank
const paidFrom = vid => { const v = D.vouchers.find(y => y.id == vid), p = v && (v.pmt || v.sal), a = p && payFromName(p); return a ? `<br><small>Paid from ${esc(a)}</small>` : ''; };
function bankCard() { const B = D.db.banks || [], e = B.find(b => b.ledger == window.bke), bkey = window.bke || ''; if (!window.bkfs || window.bkfsFor !== bkey) { window.bkfs = e ? fmtParts(e.chequeFormat).map(p => p.s) : []; window.bkfsFor = bkey; }
  const free = D.accounts.filter(a => a.type == 'A' && (/bank/i.test(a.name) || a.group == 'Bank Accounts') && !B.some(b => b.ledger == a.code));
  return `<div class="card" id="bkcard"><div class="ch"><h2>Bank accounts</h2><span class="sub" style="margin:0">Pick one under “Paid from” on Payments made and Salary payment</span></div>
    <div class="row"><label>Bank name<input id="bkn" value="${esc(e ? e.bank : '')}" placeholder="e.g. Nabil Bank"></label><label>Account no.<input id="bka" value="${esc(e ? e.account : '')}"></label>
      <div class="fld w2"><span>Cheque no. formats <small>(one for each cheque book)</small></span><div id="bkfc" style="display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;min-height:26px;align-items:center">${bkfChips()}</div>
        <div style="display:flex;gap:8px"><input id="bkf" placeholder="e.g. 7895xxxx, then Enter" onkeydown="bkfKey(event)" onblur="bkfAdd(true)"><button type="button" style="white-space:nowrap" onclick="bkfAdd()">Add format</button></div></div>
      ${!e && free.length ? `<label>Ledger account<select id="bkl"><option value="">Create a new one</option>${free.map(a => `<option value="${a.code}">Use existing: ${esc(a.name)}</option>`).join('')}</select></label>` : ''}
      <div><button class="p" onclick="saveBank()">${e ? 'Update bank account' : 'Add bank account'}</button>${e ? ' <button onclick="window.bke=null;window.bkfs=null;render()">Cancel</button>' : ''}</div></div>
    <p class="sub" style="margin:4px 0 14px"><small>Cheque no. format: type the digits that are the same on every cheque of that bank and <b>x</b> for the digits that change, e.g. <b>7895xxxx</b>. A bank can have <b>several formats</b>, one for each cheque book: type one and press Enter (or Add format), then add the next, e.g. 7895xxxx and 4410xxxx; typing digits only (7895) means “starts with 7895”. It is used to pick the bank when you type a cheque number, and to update old records below. Each bank account gets its own ledger account, so it shows in the ledger, trial balance and balance sheet.</small></p>
    <div class="tw"><table><thead><tr><th>Bank</th><th>Account no.</th><th>Cheque no. formats</th><th>Ledger account</th><th></th></tr></thead><tbody>${B.map(b => `<tr><td><b>${esc(b.bank)}</b></td><td>${esc(b.account)}</td><td>${fmtParts(b.chequeFormat).map(p => `<span class="chip" style="margin:0 4px 4px 0" title="${esc(fmtHint(p.s))}">${esc(p.s)}</span>`).join('') || '—'}</td><td>${esc((acc(b.ledger) || {}).name || '')}<br><small>${esc(b.ledger)}</small></td><td class="act"><button onclick="editBank('${b.ledger}')">Edit</button> <button class="d" onclick="delBank('${b.ledger}')">Remove</button></td></tr>`).join('') || '<tr><td class="empty" colspan="5">No bank accounts yet.</td></tr>'}</tbody></table></div></div>`; }
async function saveBank() { if (!bkfAdd()) return; const e = window.bke, j = await post('/api/banks' + (e ? '/' + e : ''), {bank: F('bkn'), account: F('bka'), chequeFormat: window.bkfs.join(', '), ledger: e || !$('#bkl') ? '' : F('bkl')}, e ? 'PUT' : 'POST'); if (!j) return; window.bke = null; window.bkfs = null; await load(); toast('Bank account ' + (e ? 'updated' : 'added') + ': ' + j.name); }
function editBank(code) { window.bke = code; window.bkfs = null; render(); $('#bkcard').scrollIntoView({block: 'start'}); $('#bkn').focus(); }
async function delBank(code) { if (!confirm('Remove this bank account from the list? Payments already made from it keep their ledger account.')) return; const r = await fetch('/api/banks/' + encodeURIComponent(code), {method: 'DELETE'}), j = await r.json(); if (!r.ok) return alert(j.error); if (window.bke == code) { window.bke = null; window.bkfs = null; } await load(); toast(j.kept ? 'Removed from the list. Its ledger account is kept because it has entries.' : 'Bank account removed.'); }
async function bankScan() { const r = await fetch('/api/bank-match'); window.bm = await r.json(); render(); $('#bmcard').scrollIntoView({block: 'start'}); }
async function bankApply() { if (!confirm(window.bm.change.length + ' cheque payment(s) will be moved to the bank account their cheque number belongs to. Amounts and dates stay the same; only the “paid from” account changes.\n\nA backup of data.json is made first. Continue?')) return;
  const j = await post('/api/bank-match', {}); if (!j) return; window.bm = null; await load(); toast(j.moved + ' payment(s) moved to their bank account' + (j.files ? ', ' + j.files + ' voucher Excel file(s) refreshed' : '') + (j.skipped ? '. ' + j.skipped + ' skipped (no bank line found)' : '') + (j.backup ? '. Backup: data.json.bak-' + j.backup : '')); }
function bankMatchCard() { const m = window.bm, rows = (L, cols) => `<div class="tw"><table><thead><tr><th>Date</th><th>Voucher</th><th>Paid to</th><th>Cheque no.</th><th class="n">Amount</th>${cols.map(c => `<th>${c[0]}</th>`).join('')}</tr></thead><tbody>${L.map(r => `<tr><td>${r.date}${r.bs ? '<br><small>' + esc(r.bs) + '</small>' : ''}</td><td><b>${r.no}</b></td><td>${esc(r.who)}</td><td>${esc(r.cheque) || '—'}</td><td class="n">${f(r.amount)}</td>${cols.map(c => `<td>${c[1](r)}</td>`).join('')}</tr>`).join('')}</tbody></table></div>`;
  const more = (L, t, cols) => L.length ? `<details style="margin:10px 0 0"><summary style="cursor:pointer;font-weight:600;font-size:13px">${L.length} ${t}</summary>${rows(L, cols)}</details>` : '';
  const body = !m ? '' : !m.banks ? '<p class="sub" style="margin:12px 0 0">Add a cheque no. format to at least one bank account above first.</p>' : `<div style="margin-top:14px">
    <p class="sub" style="margin:0 0 10px"><b>${m.change.length}</b> cheque payment(s) will move to the bank their cheque number belongs to. <b>${m.check.length}</b> need your check and <b>${m.none.length}</b> have no matching bank; those are left as they are.</p>
    ${m.change.length ? rows(m.change, [['Now', r => esc(r.from)], ['Will be', r => '<b>' + esc(r.to) + '</b>']]) : '<p class="sub" style="margin:0">Nothing to move: every cheque that fits a bank format is already on that bank.</p>'}
    ${more(m.check, 'to check', [['Paid from', r => esc(r.from)], ['Why', r => esc(r.note)]])}${more(m.none, 'with no matching bank', [['Paid from', r => esc(r.from)], ['Why', r => esc(r.note)]])}
    <div class="actbar">${m.change.length ? `<button class="p" onclick="bankApply()">Move ${m.change.length} payment(s)</button>` : ''}<button onclick="window.bm=null;render()">Close</button></div></div>`;
  return `<div class="card" id="bmcard"><div class="ch"><h2>Match old cheque payments to banks</h2></div><p class="sub" style="margin:0 0 10px">Looks at every old payment made and salary payment paid by cheque and, using the cheque no. formats above, works out which bank account it came from. You see the list first; nothing changes until you press Move. Ledgers, trial balance and the voucher Excel files are updated, and a backup of data.json is made first. Run it again any time, for example after adding another bank.</p><button onclick="bankScan()">Check old cheque payments</button>${body}</div>`; }

// ---- One payment by several cheques / banks (Payments made). The first cheque uses the normal Paid from + Cheque no. fields; each extra cheque is a row here. ----
const spRow = (ca, m = {}) => `<div class="row" data-sp style="margin-top:8px;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.4fr) minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1fr) auto"><label>Paid from<select data-f="account">${ca.map(a => `<option value="${a.code}" ${a.code == m.account ? 'selected' : ''}>${esc(a.name)}</option>`).join('')}</select></label>
  <label>Cheque no.<input data-f="instrument" value="${esc(m.instrument || '')}" oninput="spPick(this)"></label><label>Amount<input data-f="amount" type="number" step="any" value="${m.amount ?? ''}" oninput="spSum()"></label>
  <div><button type="button" class="x" title="Remove this cheque" onclick="this.closest('[data-sp]').remove();spSum()">×</button></div></div>`;
const splitBox = pre => `<div id="ysw" ${pre.mode == 'Cheque' ? '' : 'hidden'} style="margin-top:6px"><div id="ysp">${(pre.more || []).map(m => spRow(cashAccs(), m)).join('')}</div>
  <div class="actbar" style="margin:8px 0 0"><button type="button" onclick="spAdd()">+ Part paid by another cheque / bank</button><span id="ysum" class="sub" style="margin:0">${spText(+pre.amount || 0, (pre.more || []).reduce((t, m) => t + (+m.amount || 0), 0), (pre.more || []).length)}</span></div></div>`;
function spAdd() { const ca = cashAccs(), other = ca.find(a => /bank/i.test(a.name) && a.code != F('yac')) || ca[0]; $('#ysp').insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', spRow(ca, {account: other && other.code})); spSum(); $('#ysp').lastElementChild.querySelector('[data-f=instrument]').focus(); }
function spPick(el) { const h = banksFor(el.value), s = el.closest('[data-sp]').querySelector('[data-f=account]'); if (h.length == 1 && s.querySelector(`option[value="${h[0].ledger}"]`)) s.value = h[0].ledger; }
const spText = (total, ex, n) => { const first = rd(total - ex); return n ? (first > 0 ? `First cheque: <b>${f(first)}</b> · other cheques: <b>${f(ex)}</b>` : '<b style="color:var(--err)">The other cheques are as much as the whole payment</b>') : 'Use this when one payment is made with more than one cheque, or from more than one bank.'; };
function spSum() { const o = $('#ysum'); if (!o) return; const rows = [...document.querySelectorAll('#ysp [data-sp]')]; o.innerHTML = spText(N('yam'), rows.reduce((t, r) => t + (+r.querySelector('[data-f=amount]').value || 0), 0), rows.length); }
function spRows() { if (!$('#ysp') || F('ymo') != 'Cheque') return []; const out = [];
  for (const r of document.querySelectorAll('#ysp [data-sp]')) { const g = k => r.querySelector('[data-f=' + k + ']').value, amount = +g('amount') || 0, instrument = g('instrument').trim(); if (!amount && !instrument) continue; // empty row: ignored
    if (amount <= 0) { alert('Enter an amount for every extra cheque, or remove the empty one.'); return null; }
    const h = banksFor(instrument); if (h.length == 1 && h[0].ledger != g('account') && !confirm(`Cheque no. ${instrument} fits the format of ${h[0].name} (${h[0].chequeFormat}), but "${(acc(g('account')) || {}).name || 'another account'}" is chosen under Paid from.\n\nSave anyway?`)) return null;
    out.push({account: g('account'), instrument, amount}); }
  if (out.length && rd(N('yam') - out.reduce((t, x) => t + x.amount, 0)) <= 0) { alert('The extra cheques add up to the whole payment or more. Nothing is left for the first cheque.'); return null; }
  return out; }

// ---- Several cheque number formats for one bank (chips) ----
const fmtHint = s => s.includes('x') ? `Any ${s.length}-digit cheque number that matches ${s} (x = any digit)` : `Any cheque number starting with ${s}`;
const bkfChips = () => (window.bkfs || []).map((s, i) => `<span class="chip" title="${esc(fmtHint(s))}">${esc(s)} <a href="#" title="Remove this format" onclick="bkfDel(${i});return false">×</a></span>`).join(' ') || '<small>No format yet</small>';
function bkfAdd(silent) { const el = $('#bkf'); if (!el) return true; const parts = fmtParts(el.value); if (!parts.length) return true;
  if (parts.some(p => !/^[0-9x]+$/.test(p.s) || !/\d/.test(p.s))) { if (!silent) alert('A cheque number format can only contain digits and x, for example 7895xxxx'); return false; }
  parts.forEach(p => { if (!window.bkfs.includes(p.s)) window.bkfs.push(p.s); }); el.value = ''; $('#bkfc').innerHTML = bkfChips(); return true; }
function bkfDel(i) { window.bkfs.splice(i, 1); $('#bkfc').innerHTML = bkfChips(); }
function bkfKey(e) { if (e.key == 'Enter' || e.key == ',') { e.preventDefault(); bkfAdd(); } }

// ---- Old payments with several cheque numbers from different banks in one voucher: type each cheque's amount, then split ----
async function splitScanUI() { window.bsp = await (await fetch('/api/bank-split')).json(); render(); $('#bspcard').scrollIntoView({block: 'start'}); }
function splitSum(id) { const r = window.bsp.rows.find(x => x.id == id), ins = [...document.querySelectorAll(`[data-sv="${id}"]`)], sum = rd(ins.reduce((t, i) => t + (+i.value || 0), 0)), o = $('#bsr' + id);
  o.innerHTML = !sum ? '<small>Type each cheque’s amount</small>' : Math.abs(sum - r.total) < .005 ? '<span class="chip ok">Adds up</span>' : `<small style="color:var(--err)">${f(sum)} entered · ${f(r.total - sum)} ${sum > r.total ? 'too much' : 'to go'}</small>`; }
function splitType(el, id) { const r = window.bsp.rows.find(x => x.id == id), ins = [...document.querySelectorAll(`[data-sv="${id}"]`)]; el.dataset.auto = '';
  if (ins.length == 2) { const o = ins.find(i => i !== el); if (!o.value || o.dataset.auto) { const v = rd(r.total - (+el.value || 0)); o.value = el.value && v > 0 ? v : ''; o.dataset.auto = '1'; } } // two cheques: the second is filled in with what is left
  splitSum(id); }
async function bankSplitApply() { const items = [];
  for (const r of window.bsp.rows) { const vals = [...document.querySelectorAll(`[data-sv="${r.id}"]`)].map(i => ({cheque: i.dataset.ch, amount: +i.value || 0})); if (!vals.some(v => v.amount)) continue;
    if (vals.some(v => v.amount <= 0)) return alert(`Enter an amount for every cheque of ${r.no}, or clear them all to leave it for later.`);
    const sum = rd(vals.reduce((t, v) => t + v.amount, 0)); if (Math.abs(sum - r.total) > .004) return alert(`${r.no}: the cheques add up to ${f(sum)} but the payment is ${f(r.total)}.`);
    items.push({id: r.id, parts: vals}); }
  if (!items.length) return alert('Type the amount of each cheque first. Payments left empty stay as they are.');
  if (!confirm(items.length + ' payment(s) will be split so each cheque is booked to its own bank account. The supplier, total amount and date stay the same; only the “paid from” side is divided.\n\nA backup of data.json is made first. Continue?')) return;
  const j = await post('/api/bank-split', {items}); if (!j) return; window.bsp = null; await load(); toast(j.split + ' payment(s) split by bank' + (j.files ? ', ' + j.files + ' voucher Excel file(s) refreshed' : '') + '. Backup: data.json.bak-' + j.backup); }
function bankSplitCard() { const m = window.bsp,
    amt = (r, p) => `<div style="margin:0 0 8px"><b>${esc(p.cheque)}</b> <small>· ${esc(p.bank)}</small><br><input type="number" step="any" placeholder="Amount" style="width:150px;margin-top:3px" data-sv="${r.id}" data-ch="${esc(p.cheque)}" oninput="splitType(this,${r.id})"></div>`,
    who = r => `<td>${r.date}${r.bs ? '<br><small>' + esc(r.bs) + '</small>' : ''}</td><td><b>${r.no}</b></td><td>${esc(r.who)}<br><small>Cheque field: ${esc(r.ref)}</small></td>`,
    body = !m ? '' : m.error ? `<p class="sub" style="margin:12px 0 0;color:var(--err)">The server did not understand this request (${esc(m.error)}). It is probably still running the old server.js: replace it with the new server.js, stop the server and start it again with <b>node server.js</b>, then press Check old payments.</p>` : m.banks < 2 ? '<p class="sub" style="margin:12px 0 0">Add a cheque no. format to at least two bank accounts above first.</p>' : `<div style="margin-top:14px">
      <p class="sub" style="margin:0 0 10px"><b>${m.rows.length}</b> payment(s) can be split. ${m.check.length ? `<b>${m.check.length}</b> need a look by hand.` : ''}</p>
      ${m.rows.length ? `<div class="tw"><table><thead><tr><th>Date</th><th>Voucher</th><th>Paid to</th><th>Now paid from</th><th class="n">Payment</th><th>Cheques and their amounts</th><th></th></tr></thead><tbody>${m.rows.map(r => `<tr>${who(r)}<td>${esc(r.from)}</td><td class="n">${f(r.total)}</td><td>${r.parts.map(p => amt(r, p)).join('')}</td><td id="bsr${r.id}"><small>Type each cheque’s amount</small></td></tr>`).join('')}</tbody></table></div>` : '<p class="sub" style="margin:0">No old payment has cheque numbers from different banks in one voucher.</p>'}
      ${m.check.length ? `<details style="margin:10px 0 0"><summary style="cursor:pointer;font-weight:600;font-size:13px">${m.check.length} to check by hand</summary><div class="tw"><table><thead><tr><th>Date</th><th>Voucher</th><th>Paid to</th><th class="n">Payment</th><th>Why</th></tr></thead><tbody>${m.check.map(r => `<tr>${who(r)}<td class="n">${f(r.total)}</td><td>${esc(r.note)}</td></tr>`).join('')}</tbody></table></div></details>` : ''}
      <div class="actbar">${m.rows.length ? '<button class="p" onclick="bankSplitApply()">Split the payments I filled in</button>' : ''}<button onclick="window.bsp=null;render()">Close</button></div></div>`;
  return `<div class="card" id="bspcard"><div class="ch"><h2>Split old payments made with several cheques</h2></div><p class="sub" style="margin:0 0 10px">Finds old payments where one voucher lists cheque numbers from <b>different banks</b> (for example “7895001, 4410002”).
