```html
const SK = [['supplier', 'Suppliers'], ['customer', 'Customers'], ['staff', 'Staff'], ['expense', 'Expenses']];
function stmtList(k) { const key = x => String(x || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  if (k == 'supplier') return D.payables.map(x => ({n: x.name, s: f(x.balance), t: 'we owe', sub: x.pan}));
  if (k == 'customer') return D.receivables.map(x => ({n: x.name, s: f(x.balance), t: 'they owe', sub: x.pan}));
  if (k == 'staff') return D.db.staff.slice().sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name)).map(x => ({n: x.name, s: f(D.vouchers.filter(v => v.sal && key(v.sal.staff) == key(x.name)).reduce((t, v) => t + v.sal.amount, 0)), t: 'paid', sub: x.designation}));
  return D.accounts.filter(a => a.type == 'X').map(a => ({n: a.name, s: f(net(a.code, cum)), t: 'to date', sub: a.group})); }

  dash: () => {

</div></div>`; },

  voucher: () => { const ev = window.ev || {}; return `${window.ev ? `<div class="note">Editing <b>${esc(ev.no)}</b>. Saving updates the ledgers and reports. The voucher number and type stay the same.</div>` : ''}<div class="card"><div class="row">

  ledger: () => { const c = window.lc || D.accounts[0].code, a = acc(c), isB = 'ALE'.includes(a.type);

  tb: () => { let dr = 0, cr = 0; const p = priorPL();

};
// ---- Collapsible sidebar: wide screens remember the choice; narrow screens start collapsed ----
const NARROW = matchMedia('(max-width:1180px)');
let sideTmp = null; // temporary choice on a narrow screen (not remembered)
const sideStore = { get() { try { return localStorage.getItem('sideCollapsed') === '1'; } catch (e) { return false; } },
  set(v) { try { localStorage.setItem('sideCollapsed', v ? '1' : '0'); } catch (e) {} } };
function applySide() {
  const c = NARROW.matches ? (sideTmp ?? true) : sideStore.get(), b = $('#sbtog'), lbl = c ? 'Expand menu' : 'Collapse menu';
  document.querySelector('.app').classList.toggle('sc', c);
  b.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(!c)); b.title = lbl; b.setAttribute('aria-label', lbl);
}
function toggleSide() { const c = document.querySelector('.app').classList.contains('sc'); if (NARROW.matches) sideTmp = !c; else sideStore.set(!c); applySide(); }
NARROW.addEventListener('change', () => { sideTmp = null; applySide(); });
applySide();

// ---- Scrollbar above any table wider than its card, mirrored with the one below ----
const twRO = new ResizeObserver(es => es.forEach(e => syncTW(e.target.closest('.tw'))));
function syncTW(tw) {
  if (!tw || !tw.isConnected) return;
  let bar = tw.previousElementSibling;
  if (!bar || !bar.classList.contains('tws')) {
    bar = document.createElement('div'); bar.className = 'tws'; bar.hidden = true; bar.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true'); bar.innerHTML = '<div></div>'; tw.before(bar);
    bar.addEventListener('scroll', () => { if (Math.abs(tw.scrollLeft - bar.scrollLeft) >= 1) tw.scrollLeft = bar.scrollLeft; });
    tw.addEventListener('scroll', () => { if (Math.abs(tw.scrollLeft - bar.scrollLeft) >= 1) bar.scrollLeft = tw.scrollLeft; });
    twRO.observe(tw); const t = tw.querySelector('table'); if (t) twRO.observe(t);
  }
  const wide = tw.scrollWidth > tw.clientWidth + 1; bar.hidden = !wide;
  if (wide) { bar.firstChild.style.width = tw.scrollWidth + 'px'; bar.scrollLeft = tw.scrollLeft; }
}
let twQueued = false;
const syncAllTW = () => { if (twQueued) return; twQueued = true; requestAnimationFrame(() => { twQueued = false; document.querySelectorAll('#m .tw').forEach(syncTW); }); };
new MutationObserver(syncAllTW).observe($('#m'), {childList: true, subtree: true});
addEventListener('resize', syncAllTW);
const t = new Date(), y = t.getMonth() > 5 && !(t.getMonth() == 6 && t.getDate() < 16) ? t.getFullYear() : t.getFullYear() - 1; // Shrawan 1 ≈ Jul 16
$('#from').value = y + '-07-16'; $('#to').value = (y + 1) + '-07-15'; load();
</script></body></html>
```

```js
// lib/charts.js — plain SVG/HTML charts
// (split out of the old single-file index.html by migrate.js; code is unchanged)
import { esc } from './dom.js';
import { K, PAL, f } from './format.js';

export const hbars = (items, col = 'var(--pine)') => { const mx = Math.max(...items.map(i => Math.abs(i.v)), 1); return items.length ? items.map(i => `<div class="hb" title="${esc(i.l)}: ${f(i.v)}"><span>${esc(i.l)}</span><div><i style="width:${Math.max(Math.abs(i.v) / mx * 100, 1.5)}%;background:${col}"></i></div><b>${K(i.v)}</b>${i.s ? `<small>${esc(i.s)}</small>` : ''}</div>`).join('') : '<p class="sub" style="margin:0">Nothing to show for this period.</p>'; };

export function barChart(labels, series) {
  const W = 720, H = 250, L = 50, B = 26, T = 10, all = series.flatMap(s => s.vals), mx = Math.max(...all, 1), mn = Math.min(...all, 0), raw = (mx - mn) / 4, p = 10 ** Math.floor(Math.log10(raw)), step = [1, 2, 2.5, 5, 10].map(x => x * p).find(x => x >= raw), top = Math.ceil(mx / step) * step, bot = Math.floor(mn / step) * step;
  const y = v => T + (top - v) / ((top - bot) || 1) * (H - T - B), gw = (W - L - 8) / labels.length, bw = Math.min(26, gw * .8 / series.length);
  let s = `<svg viewBox="0 0 ${W} ${H}" role="img" style="width:100%;height:auto;display:block">`;
  for (let v = bot; v <= top + 1e-9; v += step) s += `<line x1="${L}" x2="${W - 8}" y1="${y(v)}" y2="${y(v)}" stroke="#E4E2DB"/><text x="${L - 6}" y="${y(v) + 4}" text-anchor="end" font-size="11" fill="#656A77">${K(v)}</text>`;
  labels.forEach((lb, i) => {
    const x0 = L + i * gw + (gw - bw * series.length) / 2;
    series.forEach((se, j) => { const v = se.vals[i]; s += `<rect x="${x0 + j * bw}" y="${Math.min(y(v), y(0))}" width="${bw - 2}" height="${Math.abs(y(v) - y(0))}" rx="2" fill="${v < 0 ? '#B42318' : se.color}"><title>${esc(lb)} · ${esc(se.name)}: ${f(v)}</title></rect>`; });
    s += `<text x="${L + i * gw + gw / 2}" y="${H - 8}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#656A77">${esc(lb)}</text>`;
  });
  return s + '</svg>' + (series.length > 1 ? `<div class="lg">${series.map(x => `<span><i style="background:${x.color}"></i>${esc(x.name)}</span>`).join('')}</div>` : '');
}

export function donut(items) {
  const tot = items.reduce((s, i) => s + i.v, 0); if (!tot) return '<p class="sub" style="margin:0">Nothing to show for this period.</p>'; let off = 25;
  const arcs = items.map((i, k) => { const q = i.v / tot * 100, a = `<circle r="15.915" cx="21" cy="21" fill="none" stroke="${PAL[k % PAL.length]}" stroke-width="7" stroke-dasharray="${q} ${100 - q}" stroke-dashoffset="${off}"><title>${esc(i.l)}: ${f(i.v)} (${q.toFixed(1)}%)</title></circle>`; off -= q; return a; }).join('');
  return `<div class="dn"><svg viewBox="0 0 42 42" width="170" height="170" role="img">${arcs}<text x="21" y="22.5" text-anchor="middle" font-size="4.2" font-weight="600" fill="#1E2230">${K(tot)}</text></svg><div>${items.map((i, k) => `<div class="lgi"><i style="background:${PAL[k % PAL.length]}"></i>${esc(i.l)}<b>${(i.v / tot * 100).toFixed(0)}%</b></div>`).join('')}</div></div>`;
}
```

```js
// lib/datepair.js — keeps every AD date field and its BS twin in step, so you can type EITHER one.
// Type or pick the English (AD) date and the Nepali (BS) date fills in; type the BS date (2083-07-17, 2083/7/17) and the AD date fills in.
// Works for every date pair in the app without touching the pages: bills, receipts, payments, salary, voucher and the Cash book rows.
import { ad2bs, bs2ad, bsNorm } from './nepdate.js';

const PAIRS = { pd: 'pbs', sd: 'sbs', rdt: 'rbs', ydt: 'ybs', ldt: 'lbs', vd: 'vb', rfd: 'rfbs', cbd: 'cbbs' }; // AD input id -> BS input id
const REV = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(PAIRS).map(([a, b]) => [b, a])), G = id => document.getElementById(id);

const twin = el => {
  if (PAIRS[el.id]) return { ad: el, bs: G(PAIRS[el.id]) };
  if (REV[el.id]) return { ad: G(REV[el.id]), bs: el };
  const tr = el.closest && el.closest('tr'); // Cash book rows
  if (tr && el.classList.contains('cd')) return { ad: el, bs: tr.querySelector('.cb2') };
  if (tr && el.classList.contains('cb2')) return { ad: tr.querySelector('.cd'), bs: el };
  return null;
};

function onEdit(e) {
  const el = e.target; if (!(el instanceof HTMLInputElement)) return; const t = twin(el); if (!t || !t.ad || !t.bs) return;
  if (el === t.ad) { const b = ad2bs(el.value); if (b) { t.bs.value = b; t.bs.style.borderColor = ''; t.bs.title = ''; } return; }
  const v = el.value.trim(); if (!v) { el.style.borderColor = ''; return; }
  const n = bsNorm(v);
  if (n) { t.ad.value = bs2ad(n); el.style.borderColor = ''; el.title = ''; if (e.type == 'change') el.value = n; } // tidy 2083/7/5 into 2083-07-05 once you leave the field
  else if (e.type == 'change') { el.style.borderColor = '#B42318'; el.title = 'Not a valid BS date. Use yyyy-mm-dd, for example 2083-07-17'; }
}

document.addEventListener('input', onEdit);
document.addEventListener('change', onEdit);

// A form that opens with today's AD date and an empty BS box gets the BS date filled in (existing BS dates are never overwritten)
const fill = () => { for (const [a, b] of Object.entries(PAIRS)) { const A = G(a), B = G(b); if (A && B && A.value && !B.value) B.value = ad2bs(A.value); } };
const m = document.getElementById('m'); if (m) new MutationObserver(fill).observe(m, { childList: true, subtree: true });
```

```js
// lib/dom.js — DOM helpers, toast, downloads, API post(), sidebar and table-scrollbar behaviour
// (split out of the old single-file index.html by migrate.js; code is unchanged)

export const $ = s => document.querySelector(s);

export const esc = s => String(s ?? '').replace(/[&<>"]/g, c => ({ '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;' }[c]));

export const badAD = d => d && +d.slice(0, 4) > 2060 && (alert('The Date (AD) field says year ' + d.slice(0, 4) + ', which looks like a BS date. Put the English (AD) date there and type the BS date in the BS field.'), true);

export const toast = (m, k) => { const t = $('#toast'); t.innerHTML = esc(m) + (k ? '<br><a href="#" style="color:#fff;font-weight:600" onclick="goRec(\'' + k + '\');return false">View in Records →</a>' : ''); t.style.display = 'block'; clearTimeout(window.tt); window.tt = setTimeout(() => t.style.display = 'none', 7000); };

export async function getFile(url) {
  const r = await fetch(url); if (!r.ok) return alert((await r.json()).error || 'Download failed');
  const saved = r.headers.get('X-Saved-To'); if (saved) return toast('Saved to ' + decodeURIComponent(saved));
  const a = document.createElement('a'); a.href = URL.createObjectURL(await r.blob()); a.download = (/filename="([^"]+)"/.exec(r.headers.get('Content-Disposition')) || [])[1] || 'file.xlsx'; a.click();
  toast("Downloaded by the browser. Set a storage folder (and keep its switch on) in Settings to save elsewhere.");
}

export const F = id => $('#' + id).value;

export const N = id => +F(id) || 0;

export async function post(url, body, method = 'POST') { if (badAD(body.date)) return null; const r = await fetch(url, { method, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(body) }); const j = await r.json(); if (!r.ok) { alert(j.error); return null; } return j; }

export function filt(inp, tbody) { const q = inp.value.trim().toLowerCase(); document.querySelectorAll('#' + tbody + ' tr[data-q]').forEach(r => r.hidden = !!q && !r.dataset.q.includes(q)); }

// ---- Collapsible sidebar: wide screens remember the choice; narrow screens start collapsed ----
export const NARROW = matchMedia('(max-width:1180px)');

export let sideTmp = null; // temporary choice on a narrow screen (not remembered)

export const sideStore = {
  get() { try { return localStorage.getItem('sideCollapsed') === '1'; } catch (e) { return false; } },
  set(v) { try { localStorage.setItem('sideCollapsed', v ? '1' : '0'); } catch (e) { } }
};

export let sideForce = null; // a page (e.g. an open VAT register) can force the sidebar closed

export const setSideForce = v => (sideForce = v);

export function applySide() {
  const c = sideForce ?? (NARROW.matches ? (sideTmp ?? true) : sideStore.get()), b = $('#sbtog'), lbl = c ? 'Expand menu' : 'Collapse menu';
  document.querySelector('.app').classList.toggle('sc', c);
  b.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(!c)); b.title = lbl; b.setAttribute('aria-label', lbl);
}

export function toggleSide() { sideForce = null; const c = document.querySelector('.app').classList.contains('sc'); if (NARROW.matches) sideTmp = !c; else sideStore.set(!c); applySide(); }

// ---- Scrollbar above any table wider than its card, mirrored with the one below ----
export const twRO = new ResizeObserver(es => es.forEach(e => syncTW(e.target.closest('.tw'))));

export function syncTW(tw) {
  if (!tw || !tw.isConnected) return;
  let bar = tw.previousElementSibling;
  if (!bar || !bar.classList.contains('tws')) {
    bar = document.createElement('div'); bar.className = 'tws'; bar.hidden = true; bar.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true'); bar.innerHTML = '<div></div>'; tw.before(bar);
    bar.addEventListener('scroll', () => { if (Math.abs(tw.scrollLeft - bar.scrollLeft) >= 1) tw.scrollLeft = bar.scrollLeft; });
    tw.addEventListener('scroll', () => { if (Math.abs(tw.scrollLeft - bar.scrollLeft) >= 1) bar.scrollLeft = tw.scrollLeft; });
    twRO.observe(tw); const t = tw.querySelector('table'); if (t) twRO.observe(t);
  }
  const wide = tw.scrollWidth > tw.clientWidth + 1; bar.hidden = !wide;
  if (wide) { bar.firstChild.style.width = tw.scrollWidth + 'px'; bar.scrollLeft = tw.scrollLeft; }
}

export let twQueued = false;

export const syncAllTW = () => { if (twQueued) return; twQueued = true; requestAnimationFrame(() => { twQueued = false; document.querySelectorAll('#m .tw').forEach(syncTW); }); };

export const setSideTmp = v => (sideTmp = v);
```

```js
// lib/format.js — number / date formatting
// (split out of the old single-file index.html by migrate.js; code is unchanged)

export const ymd = (d = new Date()) => d.getFullYear() + '-' + String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0') + '-' + String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0'); // local date, not UTC

export const f = n => (+n).toLocaleString('en-IN', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 }); // lakh/crore grouping

// ---- Dashboard helpers (plain SVG/HTML, no libraries) ----
export const K = n => { const a = Math.abs(n), s = n < 0 ? '-' : ''; return s + (a >= 1e7 ? (a / 1e7).toFixed(2) + ' Cr' : a >= 1e5 ? (a / 1e5).toFixed(2) + ' L' : a >= 1e3 ? (a / 1e3).toFixed(1) + 'k' : Math.round(a)); };

export const f0 = n => Math.round(n).toLocaleString('en-IN');

export const PAL = ['#4D6BFE', '#F5A524', '#3DD68C', '#FF7AB6', '#6B84FF', '#FF5C5C', '#7DD3FC', '#9A9A9A'];

export const rd = n => Math.round(n * 100) / 100;
```

```js
  const t = Date.UTC(+m[1], +m[2] - 1, +m[3]); if (isNaN(t) || new Date(t).getUTCMonth() != +m[2] - 1) return '';
  let n = Math.round((t - ANCHOR_AD) / DAY) + ANCHOR_ORD; if (n < 0) return '';
  let y = START; for (; y < START + BS.length; y++) { const L = BS[y - START].reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0); if (n < L) break; n -= L; }
  if (y >= START + BS.length) return '';
  let mo = 1; while (n >= bsDays(y, mo)) { n -= bsDays(y, mo); mo++; }
  return y + '-' + p2(mo) + '-' + p2(n + 1);
}

// "2083-07-17" (or 2083/7/17) -> "2026-11-03", or '' if invalid
export function bs2ad(bs) {
  const m = /^(\d{4})[-\/.](\d{1,2})[-\/.](\d{1,2})$/.exec(String(bs || '').trim()); if (!m) return '';
  const y = +m[1], mo = +m[2], d = +m[3]; if (!bsValid(y, mo, d)) return '';
  const t = new Date(ANCHOR_AD + (bsOrd(y, mo, d) - ANCHOR_ORD) * DAY); return t.getUTCFullYear() + '-' + p2(t.getUTCMonth() + 1) + '-' + p2(t.getUTCDate());
}

// Normalise whatever was typed into a BS date as yyyy-mm-dd (2083/7/5 -> 2083-07-05), or '' if it is not a real BS date
export const bsNorm = s => { const m = /^(\d{4})[-\/.](\d{1,2})[-\/.](\d{1,2})$/.exec(String(s || '').trim()); return m && bsValid(+m[1], +m[2], +m[3]) ? m[1] + '-' + p2(+m[2]) + '-' + p2(+m[3]) : ''; };

// A single field that may hold either kind: year >= 2060 is read as BS, otherwise AD. Returns {ad, bs} or null.
export function either(s) {
  const m = /^(\d{4})/.exec(String(s || '').trim()); if (!m) return null;
  if (+m[1] >= 2060) { const ad = bs2ad(s); return ad ? { ad, bs: bsNorm(s) } : null; }
  const bs = ad2bs(s); return bs ? { ad: String(s).trim().replace(/[\/.]/g, '-').replace(/-(\d)(?=-|$)/g, '-0$1'), bs } : null;
}
```

```js
}
```

```js
  if (v.sal) { window.sle = v; window.sls = null; setTab('sal'); render(); return scrollTo(0, 0); }
  if (v.rcpt) { window.rnew = !!v.rcpt.other; window.rc = v.rcpt.other ? null : v.rcpt.customer; window.er = v; window.rpre = null; setTab('rcv'); render(); return scrollTo(0, 0); }

  window.ev = v; setTab('voucher'); render(); scrollTo(0, 0);
}
```

```js
// pages/cashbook.js — Cash book: two-sided entry page that looks like the paper Day Book
// LEFT = receipts (cash coming in, Dr cash), RIGHT = payments (cash going out, Cr cash). One date for the whole entry (AD or BS), every row you save becomes an ordinary voucher.
import { $, esc, post, toast } from '../lib/dom.js';
import { f, rd, ymd } from '../lib/format.js';
import { ad2bs, bs2ad, bsNorm } from '../lib/nepdate.js';
import { D, acc, cashAccs, load, net, per, pre, resolveAcc } from '../lib/state.js';

const aname = c => (acc(c) || {}).name || c;

// ---- entry rows: Particulars (wide) | L.F. | Amount. L.F. is the ledger folio: it fills in by itself with the account code you picked. ----
const erow = side => `<tr data-r="${side}">
  <td class="cacc"><input list="al" class="ca" placeholder="Particulars: type account code or name" oninput="cbLf(this)" onkeydown="cbAcc(event)"><input class="cn" placeholder="Narration (optional)"></td>
  <td class="lf"><span class="lfv"></span></td>
  <td class="n"><input class="cm" type="number" step="any" inputmode="decimal" placeholder="0.00" style="text-align:right" oninput="cbSum('${side}')" onkeydown="cbKey(event,'${side}')"></td>
  <td class="cact"><button class="x" title="Remove row" onclick="this.closest('tr').remove();cbSum('${side}')">×</button></td></tr>`;

export function cbAdd(side) { const tb = $('#cbe-' + side); tb.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', erow(side)); return tb.lastElementChild; }

export function cbLf(el) { const c = resolveAcc(el.value); el.closest('tr').querySelector('.lfv').textContent = c || ''; el.style.borderColor = el.value.trim() && !c ? '#B42318' : ''; }

const pend = side => rd([...document.querySelectorAll(`#cbe-${side} .cm`)].reduce((t, i) => t + (+i.value || 0), 0));

export function cbSum(side) { const o = $('#cbt-' + side); if (o) o.textContent = f(pend(side)); cbDay(); }

export function cbKey(e, side) { if (e.key != 'Enter') return; e.preventDefault(); const tr = e.target.closest('tr'); (tr.nextElementSibling || cbAdd(side)).querySelector('.ca').focus(); } // Enter on the amount: next row

export function cbAcc(e) { if (e.key != 'Enter') return; e.preventDefault(); e.target.closest('tr').querySelector('.cm').focus(); } // Enter on the particulars: go to the amount

// ---- the day's balance: opening + what is saved for that date + the rows typed but not saved yet ----
const day = (code, d, pin, pout) => {
  let rin = 0, rout = 0; D.vouchers.forEach(v => { if (v.date == d) v.lines.forEach(l => { if (l.account == code) { rin += l.dr; rout += l.cr; } }); });
  const open = rd(net(code, x => x < d)); rin = rd(rin + pin); rout = rd(rout + pout); return { open, rin, rout, close: rd(open + rin - rout) };
};

const dayHtml = x => `Opening ${f(x.open)} · Receipts ${f(x.rin)} · Payments ${f(x.rout)}`;

const dateNow = () => $('#cbd').value || bs2ad($('#cbbs').value.trim());

export function cbDay() {
  const code = $('#cbacc') && $('#cbacc').value, d = $('#cbd') && dateNow(); if (!code || !d) return; window.cbdt = d;
  const x = day(code, d, pend('in'), pend('out')); $('#cbdl').textContent = d; $('#cbdb').textContent = f(x.close); $('#cbdd').textContent = dayHtml(x);
}

const grab = side => [...document.querySelectorAll(`#cbe-${side} tr[data-r]`)].map(r => ({ t: r.querySelector('.ca').value, n: r.querySelector('.cn').value, m: r.querySelector('.cm').value })).filter(x => x.t.trim() || x.m);

function put(side, rows) {
  if (!rows.length) return; const tb = $('#cbe-' + side);
  rows.forEach((x, i) => { const r = tb.children[i] || cbAdd(side); r.querySelector('.ca').value = x.t; r.querySelector('.cn').value = x.n; r.querySelector('.cm').value = x.m; cbLf(r.querySelector('.ca')); }); cbSum(side);
}

export async function cbSave(side) {
  const code = $('#cbacc').value, R = side == 'in', cash = new Set(cashAccs().map(a => a.code)), items = [], d = dateNow();
  if (!d) return alert('Enter the date at the top (English AD or Nepali BS). A BS date must look like 2083-07-17.');
  for (const r of document.querySelectorAll(`#cbe-${side} tr[data-r]`)) {
    const t = r.querySelector('.ca').value, m = rd(+r.querySelector('.cm').value || 0), n = r.querySelector('.cn').value.trim();
    if (!t.trim() && !m) continue; // empty row: ignored
    const a = resolveAcc(t);
    if (!a) return alert('Account not found: "' + (t.trim() || 'blank') + '". Pick an account from the list while typing, or add it in the Accounts tab.');
    if (a == code) return alert('Particulars cannot be the cash/bank account itself (' + aname(code) + ').');
    if (m <= 0) return alert('Enter an amount for ' + aname(a) + '.');
    items.push({ a, m, n, t });
  } // everything is checked before anything is posted
  if (!items.length) return alert('Nothing to save. Fill in at least one row (particulars and amount).');
  const other = R ? 'out' : 'in', keep = grab(other); let ok = 0;
  for (const x of items) {
    const body = {
      type: cash.has(x.a) ? 'Contra' : R ? 'Receipt' : 'Payment', date: d, bs: ad2bs(d), ref: '', narration: x.n || (R ? 'Received from ' : 'Paid to ') + aname(x.a),
      lines: R ? [{ account: code, dr: x.m, cr: 0 }, { account: x.a, dr: 0, cr: x.m }] : [{ account: x.a, dr: x.m, cr: 0 }, { account: code, dr: 0, cr: x.m }]
    };
    if (!await post('/api/vouchers', body)) break; ok++;
  }
  await load(); put(other, keep); put(side, items.slice(ok)); // rows typed on the other side (and any that failed to save) are kept
  if (ok) toast(ok + (R ? ' receipt' : ' payment') + (ok > 1 ? 's' : '') + ' saved to ' + aname(code));
}

// Vouchers that touch the cash/bank account in the selected period, split into the receipts side and the payments side
function book(code) {
  const IN = [], OUT = [];
  D.vouchers.filter(v => per(v.date) && v.lines.some(l => l.account == code)).sort((a, b) => a.date.localeCompare(b.date) || a.id - b.id).forEach(v => {
    const mine = v.lines.filter(l => l.account == code), dr = rd(mine.reduce((t, l) => t + l.dr, 0)), cr = rd(mine.reduce((t, l) => t + l.cr, 0)), rest = v.lines.filter(l => l.account != code);
    const mk = (amt, pick) => { const ac = [...new Set(rest.filter(pick).map(l => l.account))]; return { id: v.id, date: v.date, bs: v.bs, no: v.no, narr: v.narration, who: ac.map(aname).join(', '), lf: ac.join(', '), amt }; };
    if (dr) IN.push(mk(dr, l => l.cr > 0));
    if (cr) OUT.push(mk(cr, l => l.dr > 0));
  });
  return { IN, OUT };
}

const CSS = `<style>
.cbtop{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:16px 28px;align-items:flex-end;padding:14px 18px;margin-bottom:16px}
.cbtl{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:14px 20px;align-items:flex-end}
.cbtl label{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:500;color:var(--mut)}
.cbdt{display:flex;gap:8px}.cbdt input{width:auto;min-width:150px}
.cbday{margin-left:auto;text-align:right}.cbday span{display:block;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--mut)}
.cbday b{display:block;font:650 26px/1.25 var(--ui);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:var(--ink)}.cbday small{color:var(--mut);font-size:12px}
.cbk{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:20px;align-items:start;margin-bottom:16px}
.cbk>.card{margin:0}.cbk .in{border-top:3px solid var(--ok)}.cbk .out{border-top:3px solid var(--err)}
.cbk table{table-layout:fixed;width:100%}.cbk .tw{overflow-x:hidden}
.cbk th,.cbk td{padding:10px 12px;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.cbk .tw td:first-child{white-space:normal}
.cbk td input{border-color:var(--line);background:var(--panel-2);padding:7px 10px;min-height:36px}
.cbk td.lf{text-align:center;color:var(--mut);font-size:13px}.cbk .cn{margin-top:5px;min-height:30px;padding:4px 10px;font-size:12.5px}
.cbk .actbar{justify-content:space-between}
@media(max-width:1100px){.cbk{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
</style>`;

export const cashbook = () => {
  const ca = cashAccs(), cur = (ca.find(a => a.code == window.cbc) || ca.find(a => /cash/i.test(a.name)) || ca[0] || {}).code;
  if (!cur) return '<div class="card"><p class="sub" style="margin:0">No cash or bank account found. Add one in the Accounts tab first.</p></div>';

' · ' + esc(e.narr) : ''}</small></td><td>${esc(e.lf)}</td><td class="n">${f(e.amt)}</td><td class="act"><button onclick="editV(${e.id})">Edit</button> <button class="d" onclick="del(${e.id})">Delete</button></td></tr>`;
  const left = (open > 0 ? bal('To Balance b/d', open) : '') + IN.map(e => line(e, 'To')).join('') + (close < 0 ? bal('To Balance c/d', -close) : '');
```

```js
// pages/dashboard.js — Dashboard
// (split out of the old single-file index.html by migrate.js; code is unchanged)
import { barChart, donut, hbars } from '../lib/charts.js';
import { K, f0, rd } from '../lib/format.js';
import { D, FR, TO, acc, cashAccs, cum, net, ofType, per } from '../lib/state.js';

export const dash = () => {
  const sales = D.bills.filter(b => b.kind == 'sales' && per(b.date)), purch = D.bills.filter(b => b.kind == 'purchase' && per(b.date)), tot = l => rd(l.reduce((s, b) => s + b.total, 0));
  const inc = -ofType('I').reduce((s, a) => s + net(a.code, per), 0), exp = ofType('X').reduce((s, a) => s + net(a.code, per), 0), profit = inc - exp;
  const cash = cashAccs().reduce((s, a) => s + net(a.code, cum), 0), rec = D.receivables.reduce((t, c) => t + Math.max(c.balance, 0), 0), pay = D.payables.reduce((t, c) => t + Math.max(c.balance, 0), 0);
  const vat = -net('2020', cum) - net('1050', cum), unsold = D.bills.filter(b => b.kind == 'purchase' && !b.sold), unsoldAmt = unsold.reduce((t, b) => t + b.total, 0);
  // months in the selected period
  const months = []; let [y, m] = FR().split('-').map(Number); const [ey, em] = TO().split('-').map(Number);
  while ((y < ey || (y == ey && m <= em)) && months.length < 36) { months.push(y + '-' + String(m).padStart(2, '0')); if (++m > 12) { m = 1; y++; } }
  const MN = ['Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'May', 'Jun', 'Jul', 'Aug', 'Sep', 'Oct', 'Nov', 'Dec'], lab = months.map(k => MN[+k.slice(5) - 1] + " '" + k.slice(2, 4));
  const byM = l => months.map(k => rd(l.filter(b => b.date.slice(0, 7) == k).reduce((s, b) => s + b.total, 0)));
  const plM = months.map(k => rd(D.vouchers.filter(v => per(v.date) && v.date.slice(0, 7) == k).reduce((s, v) => s + v.lines.reduce((t, l) => { const a = acc(l.account); return a && 'IX'.includes(a.type) ? t + l.cr - l.dr : t; }, 0), 0)));
  // sales by category with margin on bills made from a purchase
  const cat = {}; sales.forEach(b => { const c = b.category || 'Other', pb = D.bills.find(x => x.id == b.purchaseId), e = cat[c] = cat[c] || { v: 0, m: 0, n: 0 }, rev = b.nonTax + b.taxable; e.v += rev; e.n++; if (pb) e.m += rev - (pb.nonTax + pb.taxable); });
  const catItems = Object.entries(cat).sort((a, b) => b[1].v - a[1].v).map(([l, e]) => ({ l, v: e.v, s: e.n + ' bill' + (e.n > 1 ? 's' : '') + (e.m ? ' · margin ' + K(e.m) : '') }));
  const top = (list, key) => { const o = {}; list.forEach(b => o[b[key]] = (o[b[key]] || 0) + b.total); return Object.entries(o).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]).slice(0, 5).map(([l, v]) => ({ l, v })); };
  const age = d => Math.floor((Date.now() - new Date(d)) / 864e5), aging = list => { const b = [0, 0, 0, 0]; list.forEach(x => b[age(x.date) <= 30 ? 0 : age(x.date) <= 60 ? 1 : age(x.date) <= 90 ? 2 : 3] += x.due); return ['0–30 days', '31–60 days', '61–90 days', '90+ days'].map((l, i) => ({ l, v: b[i] })); };
  const dueR = D.receivables.flatMap(c => c.bills.filter(b => b.due > .004)), dueP = D.payables.flatMap(c => c.bills.filter(b => b.due > .004));
  let ex = ofType('X').map(a => ({ l: a.name, v: net(a.code, per) })).filter(x => x.v > .004).sort((a, b) => b.v - a.v); if (ex.length > 6) ex = [...ex.slice(0, 6), { l: 'Other expenses', v: ex.slice(6).reduce((s, x) => s + x.v, 0) }];
  const kp = (l, v, s, c = '') => `<div class="${c}"><span>${l}</span><b>${v}</b>${s ? `<small>${s}</small>` : ''}</div>`;
  return `<p class="sub">Figures for <b>${FR()}</b> to <b>${TO()}</b> (change the period at the top). Balances such as cash, receivable and payable are as at ${TO()}. Months are English (AD) months.</p>
    <div class="vat k4">${kp('Sales billed', f0(tot(sales)), sales.length + (sales.length == 1 ? ' bill' : ' bills') + ', incl. VAT')}${kp('Purchases billed', f0(tot(purch)), purch.length + (purch.length == 1 ? ' bill' : ' bills') + ', incl. VAT')}${kp('Net profit', f0(profit), 'Income ' + K(inc) + ' − expenses ' + K(exp), 'net')}${kp('Cash &amp; bank', f0(cash), '')}
      ${kp('Receivable from customers', f0(rec), dueR.length + (dueR.length == 1 ? ' unpaid bill' : ' unpaid bills'))}${kp('Payable to suppliers', f0(pay), dueP.length + (dueP.length == 1 ? ' unpaid bill' : ' unpaid bills'))}${kp('VAT ' + (vat >= 0 ? 'payable' : 'credit'), f0(Math.abs(vat)), 'Output − input VAT')}${kp('Purchases not yet sold', unsold.length, f0(unsoldAmt) + ' waiting for a sales bill')}</div>
    <div class="dash">

      <div class="card"><div class="ch"><h2>Profit by month</h2><span class="sub" style="margin:0">Income − expenses (red = loss)</span></div>${barChart(lab, [{ name: 'Profit', color: '#1D7448', vals: plM }])}</div>
```

```js
// pick by typed name (datalist). Resolves to the exact stored name.
export const pickByName = (list, val, setter) => {
  const hit = list.find(x => x.name.toLowerCase() === String(val).trim().toLowerCase());
  if (hit && hit.name !== setter.current) setter.set(hit.name);
};

  parties,
```

```js
// pages/ledger.js — Ledger page

import { esc } from '../lib/dom.js';
import { f } from '../lib/format.js';
import { D, acc, net, per, pre } from '../lib/state.js';

export const ledger = () => {
  const c = window.lc || D.accounts[0].code, a = acc(c), isB = 'ALE'.includes(a.type);
  let run = isB ? net(c, pre) : 0; const open = run;
  const items = D.vouchers.filter(v => per(v.date)).sort((x, y) => x.date.localeCompare(y.date) || x.id - y.id).flatMap(v => v.lines.filter(l => l.account == c).map(l => ({ v, l })));
  const bal = n => f(Math.abs(n)) + (n >= 0 ? ' Dr' : ' Cr');
  return `<div class="card"><div class="row" style="grid-template-columns:minmax(220px,420px)"><label>Account<select onchange="lc=this.value;render()">${D.accounts.map(x => `<option value="${x.code}" ${x.code == c ? 'selected' : ''}>${x.code} ${esc(x.name)}</option>`).join('')}</select></label></div></div>
    <div class="card"><div class="tw"><table><tr><th>Date</th><th>Voucher</th><th>Narration</th><th class="n">Debit</th><th class="n">Credit</th><th class="n">Balance</th></tr>
    <tr class="grp"><td colspan="5">Opening balance</td><td class="n">${bal(open)}</td></tr>` + items.map(({ v, l }) => {
    run += l.dr - l.cr;
    return `<tr><td>${v.date}</td><td>${v.no}</td><td>${esc(v.narration)}</td><td class="n">${l.dr ? f(l.dr) : ''}</td><td class="n">${l.cr ? f(l.cr) : ''}</td><td class="n">${bal(run)}</td></tr>`;
  }).join('') +
    `<tr class="t"><td colspan="5">Closing balance</td><td class="n">${bal(run)}</td></tr></table></div></div>`;
};
```

```js
// pages/payments-forms.js — Payments made actions, cheque/bank pickers, split cheques
// (split out of the old single-file index.html by migrate.js; code is unchanged)
import { $, F, N, esc, post, toast } from '../lib/dom.js';
import { f, rd } from '../lib/format.js';
import { D, acc, cashAccs, load, render } from '../lib/state.js';
import { fmtHit, fmtParts } from './settings.js';

export const banksFor = instr => { const runs = String(instr || '').match(/\d+/g) || []; return (D.db.banks || []).filter(b => acc(b.ledger) && fmtParts(b.chequeFormat).some(p => runs.some(r => fmtHit(p, r)))); };

export function chqPick(inId, accId, modeId) { if (F(modeId) != 'Cheque') return; const h = banksFor(F(inId)), s = $('#' + accId); if (h.length == 1 && s.querySelector(`option[value="${h[0].ledger}"]`)) s.value = h[0].ledger; }

export function chqOk(inId, accId, modeId) {
  if (F(modeId) != 'Cheque') return true; const h = banksFor(F(inId)); if (h.length != 1 || h[0].ledger == F(accId)) return true;
  return confirm(`Cheque no. ${F(inId)} fits the format of ${h[0].name} (${h[0].chequeFormat}), but "${(acc(F(accId)) || {}).name || 'another account'}" is chosen under Paid from.\n\nSave anyway?`);
}

export const payFromName = p => p.splits ? [...new Set(p.splits.map(y => (acc(y.account) || {}).name || y.account))].join(' + ') : (acc(p.account) || {}).name || ''; // a split payment (several cheques / banks) lists every bank

export const paidFrom = vid => { const v = D.vouchers.find(y => y.id == vid), p = v && (v.pmt || v.sal), a = p && payFromName(p); return a ? `<br><small>Paid from ${esc(a)}</small>` : ''; };

// ---- One payment by several cheques / banks (Payments made). The first cheque uses the normal Paid from + Cheque no. fields; each extra cheque is a row here. ----
export const spRow = (ca, m = {}) => `<div class="row" data-sp style="margin-top:8px;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.4fr) minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1fr) auto"><label>Paid from<select data-f="account">${ca.map(a => `<option value="${a.code}" ${a.code == m.account ? 'selected' : ''}>${esc(a.name)}</option>`).join('')}</select></label>
  <label>Cheque no.<input data-f="instrument" value="${esc(m.instrument || '')}" oninput="spPick(this)"></label><label>Amount<input data-f="amount" type="number" step="any" value="${m.amount ?? ''}" oninput="spSum()"></label>
  <div><button type="button" class="x" title="Remove this cheque" onclick="this.closest('[data-sp]').remove();spSum()">×</button></div></div>`;

export const splitBox = pre => `<div id="ysw" ${pre.mode == 'Cheque' ? '' : 'hidden'} style="margin-top:6px"><div id="ysp">${(pre.more || []).map(m => spRow(cashAccs(), m)).join('')}</div>
  <div class="actbar" style="margin:8px 0 0"><button type="button" onclick="spAdd()">+ Part paid by another cheque / bank</button><span id="ysum" class="sub" style="margin:0">${spText(+pre.amount || 0, (pre.more || []).reduce((t, m) => t + (+m.amount || 0), 0), (pre.more || []).length)}</span></div></div>`;

export function spAdd() { const ca = cashAccs(), other = ca.find(a => /bank/i.test(a.name) && a.code != F('yac')) || ca[0]; $('#ysp').insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', spRow(ca, { account: other && other.code })); spSum(); $('#ysp').lastElementChild.querySelector('[data-f=instrument]').focus(); }

export function spPick(el) { const h = banksFor(el.value), s = el.closest('[data-sp]').querySelector('[data-f=account]'); if (h.length == 1 && s.querySelector(`option[value="${h[0].ledger}"]`)) s.value = h[0].ledger; }

export const spText = (total, ex, n) => { const first = rd(total - ex); return n ? (first > 0 ? `First cheque: <b>${f(first)}</b> · other cheques: <b>${f(ex)}</b>` : '<b style="color:var(--err)">The other cheques are as much as the whole payment</b>') : 'Use this when one payment is made with more than one cheque, or from more than one bank.'; };

export function spSum() { const o = $('#ysum'); if (!o) return; const rows = [...document.querySelectorAll('#ysp [data-sp]')]; o.innerHTML = spText(N('yam'), rows.reduce((t, r) => t + (+r.querySelector('[data-f=amount]').value || 0), 0), rows.length); }

export function spRows() {
  if (!$('#ysp') || F('ymo') != 'Cheque') return []; const out = [];
  for (const r of document.querySelectorAll('#ysp [data-sp]')) {
    const g = k => r.querySelector('[data-f=' + k + ']').value, amount = +g('amount') || 0, instrument = g('instrument').trim(); if (!amount && !instrument) continue; // empty row: ignored
    if (amount <= 0) { alert('Enter an amount for every extra cheque, or remove the empty one.'); return null; }
    const h = banksFor(instrument); if (h.length == 1 && h[0].ledger != g('account') && !confirm(`Cheque no. ${instrument} fits the format of ${h[0].name} (${h[0].chequeFormat}), but "${(acc(g('account')) || {}).name || 'another account'}" is chosen under Paid from.\n\nSave anyway?`)) return null;
    out.push({ account: g('account'), instrument, amount });
  }
  if (out.length && rd(N('yam') - out.reduce((t, x) => t + x.amount, 0)) <= 0) { alert('The extra cheques add up to the whole payment or more. Nothing is left for the first cheque.'); return null; }
  return out;
}

// Payments made (to suppliers; mirrors Payments received)
export function pickSup(i) { window.pyn = false; window.pys = D.payables[i].name; window.pye = null; window.pyp = null; render(); if (window.matchMedia && matchMedia('(max-width:1000px)').matches) $('#sdet').scrollIntoView(); }

export function newPaid() { window.pyn = true; window.pys = null; window.pye = null; window.pyp = null; render(); scrollTo(0, 0); }

export function paySupBill(id, due) { window.pye = null; window.pyp = { billId: id, amount: due }; render(); $('#yam').focus(); }

export function ymode() { $('#yfw').hidden = $('#ymo').value != 'Fonepay'; if ($('#ysw')) $('#ysw').hidden = $('#ymo').value != 'Cheque'; const want = { Cash: ['cash'], Cheque: ['bank'], Fonepay: ['fonepay', 'bank'], 'Bank transfer': ['bank'] }[$('#ymo').value] || []; for (const w of want) { const a = cashAccs().find(x => x.name.toLowerCase().includes(w)); if (a) { $('#yac').value = a.code; break; } } chqPick('yin', 'yac', 'ymo'); }

// ---- Payments made by staff out of their own pocket: the company owes them ("Due to <name>") until it reimburses them ----
export const staffOwed = code => rd(D.vouchers.reduce((t, v) => t + v.lines.filter(l => l.account == code).reduce((s, l) => s + l.cr - l.dr, 0), 0));

export function ypbChg() { const on = !!F('ypb').trim(); $('#yfr').hidden = on; if ($('#ysw')) $('#ysw').hidden = on || F('ymo') != 'Cheque'; }

export function reimburse(code) { const a = acc(code); window.pyn = true; window.pys = null; window.pye = null; window.pyp = { debit: code, amount: staffOwed(code), payee: a.name.replace(/^Due to /, '') }; render(); scrollTo(0, 0); }

export function ycrChg() { $('#ycnw').hidden = !!F('ycr'); }

export async function savePayment(isNew) {
  const staff = F('ypb').trim(), bySt = F('ysf'); if (staff && bySt) return alert('Choose either "Paid by staff / CEO" or "Paid by staff (own money)", not both.'); if (!staff && !bySt && !chqOk('yin', 'yac', 'ymo')) return; const more = staff || bySt ? [] : spRows(); if (!more) return; const er = window.pye, cr = isNew ? F('ycr') : '', body = { supplier: isNew ? (cr ? '' : F('ycn')) : window.pys, debitAccount: cr, payee: isNew ? F('ypy') : (er && er.pmt.payee || ''), date: F('ydt'), bs: F('ybs'), amount: N('yam'), mode: F('ymo'), account: F('yac'), instrument: F('yin'), billId: isNew ? null : (F('ybl') || null), note: F('ynt'), fee: N('yfe'), more, paidBy: staff, byStaff: bySt, inv: $('#yiv') ? { billNo: F('yiv'), supplierPan: F('yip'), taxable: N('yit') } : undefined };
  const j = await post(er ? '/api/payments/' + er.id : '/api/payments', body, er ? 'PUT' : 'POST'); if (!j) return; window.pye = null; window.pyp = null; if (isNew) { window.pyn = false; window.pys = cr ? null : body.supplier; } await load();
  toast('Payment ' + j.no + (er ? ' updated' : ' recorded') + (j.saved ? '\nSaved to ' + j.saved : ''), 'made');
}

export function pickSupByName(v) { const c = D.payables.find(x => x.name.toLowerCase() === String(v).trim().toLowerCase()); if (c && c.name !== window.pys) { window.pys = c.name; window.pyn = false; window.pye = null; render(); } }
```

```js
// pages/receipts-forms.js — Payments received actions
// (split out of the old single-file index.html by migrate.js; code is unchanged)
import { $, F, N, post, toast } from '../lib/dom.js';
import { D, cashAccs, load, render } from '../lib/state.js';

export function newPay() { window.rnew = true; window.rc = null; window.er = null; window.rpre = null; render(); scrollTo(0, 0); }

export function rcrChg() { $('#rcnw').hidden = !!F('rcr'); }

export async function saveNewReceipt() {
  const er = window.er, cr = F('rcr'), body = { customer: cr ? '' : F('rcn'), creditAccount: cr, payer: F('rpy'), date: F('rdt'), bs: F('rbs'), amount: N('ram'), mode: F('rmo'), account: F('rac'), instrument: F('rin'), note: F('rnt') };
  const j = await post(er ? '/api/receipts/' + er.id : '/api/receipts', body, er ? 'PUT' : 'POST'); if (!j) return; window.er = null; window.rpre = null; window.rnew = false; window.rc = cr ? null : body.customer; await load();
  toast('Payment ' + j.no + (er ? ' updated' : ' recorded') + (j.saved ? '\nSaved to ' + j.saved : ''), 'received');
}

export function pickCust(i) { window.rnew = false; window.rc = D.receivables[i].name; window.er = null; window.rpre = null; render(); if (window.matchMedia && matchMedia('(max-width:1000px)').matches) $('#cdet').scrollIntoView(); }

export function rmode() { const want = { Cash: ['cash'], Cheque: ['bank'], Fonepay: ['fonepay', 'bank'], 'Bank transfer': ['bank'] }[$('#rmo').value] || []; for (const w of want) { const a = cashAccs().find(x => x.name.toLowerCase().includes(w)); if (a) { $('#rac').value = a.code; break; } } }

export function rcvBill(id, due) { window.er = null; window.rpre = { billId: id, amount: due }; render(); $('#ram').focus(); }

export async function saveReceipt() {
  const er = window.er, body = { customer: window.rc, date: F('rdt'), bs: F('rbs'), amount: N('ram'), mode: F('rmo'), account: F('rac'), instrument: F('rin'), billId: F('rbl') || null, note: F('rnt'), payer: er && er.rcpt.payer || '' };
  const j = await post(er ? '/api/receipts/' + er.id : '/api/receipts', body, er ? 'PUT' : 'POST'); if (!j) return; window.er = null; window.rpre = null; await load();
  toast('Payment ' + j.no + (er ? ' updated' : ' recorded') + (j.saved ? '\nSaved to ' + j.saved : ''), 'received');
}

export function pickCustByName(v) { const c = D.receivables.find(x => x.name.toLowerCase() === String(v).trim().toLowerCase()); if (c && c.name !== window.rc) { window.rc = c.name; window.rnew = false; window.er = null; render(); } }
```

```js
// pages/records.js — Records page
// (split out of the old single-file index.html by migrate.js; code is unchanged)
import { $, esc, toast } from '../lib/dom.js';
import { f } from '../lib/format.js';
import { D, MODES, load, render, setTab } from '../lib/state.js';
import { payFromName } from './payments-forms.js';

export async function rm(id, ask) { if (!confirm(ask)) return; window.sp = null; if (window.er && window.er.id == id) window.er = null; if (window.pye && window.pye.id == id) window.pye = null; if (window.ev && window.ev.id == id) window.ev = null; if (window.sle && window.sle.id == id) window.sle = null; if (window.eb && window.eb.voucherId == id) window.eb = null; if (window.rfe && window.rfe.id == id) window.rfe = null; const r = await fetch('/api/vouchers/' + id, { method: 'DELETE' }), j = await r.json().catch(() => ({})); await load(); toast(j.files && j.files.length ? 'Deleted. Excel file(s) removed:\n' + j.files.join('\n') : 'Deleted.'); }

export const del = id => rm(id, 'Delete this voucher and its Excel file? This cannot be undone.');

export const delBill = (id, kind) => rm(id, 'Delete this ' + kind + ' bill, its voucher and their Excel files? This cannot be undone.');
```

```js
// pages/registers.js — VAT register page (each section is a full-width bar that expands)
import { $, applySide, esc, post, setSideForce, syncAllTW, toast } from '../lib/dom.js';
import { f, rd } from '../lib/format.js';
import { D, FR, TO, load } from '../lib/state.js';

const ONE_AT_A_TIME = true; // false = several sections can stay open together

// Open / close a section. While any section is open the sidebar collapses; when all are closed it returns.
export function regToggle(id) {
  const o = window.regOpen = window.regOpen || {}, was = !!o[id];
  if (ONE_AT_A_TIME) for (const k in o) delete o[k];
  if (was) delete o[id]; else o[id] = true;
  document.querySelectorAll('.rsec').forEach(s => { const on = !!o[s.id.slice(3)]; s.classList.toggle('open', on); s.querySelector('.rhd').setAttribute('aria-expanded', on); });
  setSideForce(Object.keys(o).length ? true : null); applySide(); syncAllTW(); regFilter();
}

const sec = (id, title, meta, body) => {
  const on = !!(window.regOpen && window.regOpen[id]), mx = window.regMaxed === id;
  return `<section class="rsec${on ? ' open' : ''}" id="rs-${id}"${mx ? ` data-max="1" style="${MAXCSS}"` : ''}><button type="button" class="rhd" aria-expanded="${on}" onclick="regToggle('${id}')"><b>${title}</b><span>${meta}</span><i aria-hidden="true"></i></button><div class="rbody card">${mx ? body.replaceAll('class="tw rscroll"', 'class="tw rscroll" style="max-height:none"') : body}</div></section>`;
};

// Maximise: a section fills the whole screen (state survives re-renders such as after "Add to purchase book")
const MAXCSS = 'position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:60;overflow:auto;padding:62px 16px 12px;background:Canvas';
export function regMax(id) {
  const s = document.getElementById('rs-' + id); if (!s) return;
  const on = window.regMaxed !== id; window.regMaxed = on ? id : null;
  s.style.cssText = on ? MAXCSS : ''; if (on) s.dataset.max = '1'; else delete s.dataset.max;
  const rb = document.getElementById('regbar'); if (rb) rb.style.cssText = on ? BARMAX : BARNORM;
  s.querySelectorAll('.rscroll').forEach(t => t.style.maxHeight = on ? 'none' : '');
  s.querySelectorAll('.mxb').forEach(b => b.textContent = on ? 'Restore size' : 'Maximise');
  syncAllTW();
}
const xlBtn = (path, label) => `<button type="button" class="p sp" onclick="getFile('${path}?from=${FR()}&to=${TO()}')">${label}</button>`;
const rvBtn = () => xlBtn('/api/xlsx/review', 'Download Excel (review vouchers)'), loBtn = () => xlBtn('/api/xlsx/leftout', 'Download Excel (left-out payments)');
const mxBtn = id => `<button type="button" class="mxb" onclick="regMax('${id}')">${window.regMaxed === id ? 'Restore size' : 'Maximise'}</button>`;

// ---- Search: one box for the whole page; it filters the rows of every section, so it works on whichever section is open ----
const BARNORM = 'position:sticky;top:0;z-index:5;background:Canvas;padding:6px 0;display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap';
const BARMAX = 'position:fixed;top:10px;left:16px;right:16px;z-index:70;background:Canvas;padding:6px 0;display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap';
const bar = () => `<div id="regbar" style="${window.regMaxed ? BARMAX : BARNORM}"><input id="regq" type="search" placeholder="Search the open section: bill no., supplier, PAN, narration, amount…" value="${esc(window.regQ || '')}" oninput="regSearch(this.value)" onkeydown="if(event.key==='Escape')regClear()" style="flex:1;min-width:220px;max-width:560px"><button type="button" onclick="regClear()">Clear</button><span id="regqs" class="sub" style="margin:0"></span></div>`;

export function regSearch(v) { window.regQ = v || ''; regFilter(); }
export function regClear() { window.regQ = ''; const i = document.getElementById('regq'); if (i) i.value = ''; regFilter(); }

export function regFilter() {
  const terms = (window.regQ || '').trim().toLowerCase().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean), open = window.regOpen || {}, counts = {};
  document.querySelectorAll('.rsec').forEach(sc => {
    const id = sc.id.slice(3); let tot = 0, vis = 0;
    sc.querySelectorAll('table').forEach(tb => {
      const trs = [...tb.querySelectorAll('tr')];
      trs.forEach((tr, i) => {
        if (tr.querySelector('th') || tr.classList.contains('t') || tr.dataset.empty || tr.dataset.with) return;
        const nx = trs[i + 1], pair = nx && nx.dataset.with, txt = (tr.textContent + (pair ? ' ' + nx.textContent : '')).toLowerCase(), flat = txt.replace(/,/g, '');
        const ok = terms.every(t => txt.includes(t) || flat.includes(t.replace(/,/g, '')));
        tr.style.display = ok ? '' : 'none'; if (pair) nx.style.display = ok ? '' : 'none';
        tot++; if (ok) vis++;
      });
    });
    counts[id] = { tot, vis, title: (sc.querySelector('.rhd b') || {}).textContent || id };
  });
  const st = document.getElementById('regqs'); if (!st) return;
  if (!terms.length) { st.textContent = ''; return; }
  const op = Object.keys(open).filter(k => open[k] && counts[k]);
  st.textContent = op.length ? op.map(k => `${counts[k].vis} of ${counts[k].tot} rows match`).join(' · ')
    : 'Open a section to see matches: ' + Object.values(counts).map(c => `${c.title.replace(/\s*\(.*$/, '')} ${c.vis}`).join(' · ');
}

export const reg = () => {
  // Purchase rows = saved bills + purchases recorded only as payments / linked vouchers
  const rows = k => [...D.bills, ...(D.payPurchases || []), ...(D.refundRows || [])].filter(b => b.kind == k && b.date >= FR() && b.date <= TO()).sort((a, b) => a.date.localeCompare(b.date) || String(a.billNo).localeCompare(String(b.billNo), undefined, { numeric: true }));
  const sum = (R, k) => rd(R.reduce((s, b) => s + b[k], 0)), PR = rows('purchase'), SR = rows('sales');
  const mk = (kind, title, R) => {
    const P = kind == 'purchase', noBs = R.filter(b => !b.bs).length;
    const body = `<div class="ch">${mxBtn(kind)}${noBs ? `<span class="err">${noBs} bill(s) have no BS date, so the AD date is shown in the register.</span>` : ''}<button class="p sp" onclick="getFile('/api/xlsx/register/${kind}?from=${FR()}&to=${TO()}')">Download Excel</button></div>
      <div class="tw rscroll"><table><tr><th>Miti</th><th>Bill no.</th><th>${P ? 'Supplier' : 'Buyer'}</th><th>PAN</th><th>Particulars</th><th class="n">Total</th><th class="n">Exempt</th><th class="n">Taxable</th><th class="n">VAT</th></tr>` +
      R.map(b => `<tr><td>${esc(b.bs || b.date)}</td><td>${esc(b.billNo || (b.fromPayment ? b.voucher + ' (payment)' : ''))}</td><td>${esc(P ? b.supplier : b.customer)}</td><td>${esc(P ? b.supplierPan : b.customerVat)}</td><td>${esc(b.particulars)}</td><td class="n">${f(b.total)}</td><td class="n">${f(b.nonTax)}</td><td class="n">${f(b.taxable)}</td><td class="n">${f(b.vat)}</td></tr>`).join('') +
      `<tr class="t"><td colspan="5">Total</td><td class="n">${f(sum(R, 'total'))}</td><td class="n">${f(sum(R, 'nonTax'))}</td><td class="n">${f(sum(R, 'taxable'))}</td><td class="n">${f(sum(R, 'vat'))}</td></tr></table></div>`;
    return sec(kind, title, `${R.length} bill${R.length == 1 ? '' : 's'} · VAT ${f(sum(R, 'vat'))}`, body);
  };
  const o = sum(SR, 'vat'), i = sum(PR, 'vat');
  const html = bar() + `<div class="vat"><div><span>Output VAT (sales)</span><b>${f(o)}</b></div><div><span>Input VAT (purchases)</span><b>${f(i)}</b></div><div class="net"><span>VAT for this period: ${o >= i ? 'payable' : 'credit carried forward'}</span><b>${f(o - i)}</b></div></div>` +
    mk('purchase', 'Purchase book (खरिद खाता)', PR) + mk('sales', 'Sales book (बिक्री खाता)', SR) + review();
  setTimeout(regFilter, 0); return html;
};

// ---- Review: what is (and is not) in the purchase book besides bills, and old records that need attention ----
const inPeriod = d => d >= FR() && d <= TO();

export const review = () => {
  const R = D.review || { included: [], excluded: [], journals: [], issues: [] }, J = R.journals.filter(j => inPeriod(j.date)), exc = R.excluded.filter(x => inPeriod(x.date)), fuel = (R.fuel || []).filter(x => inPeriod(x.date)), oth = (R.others || []).filter(x => inPeriod(x.date));
  const th = (...h) => '<tr>' + h.map(x => `<th${/^#/.test(x) ? ' class="n"' : ''}>${x.replace(/^#/, '')}</th>`).join('') + '</tr>', empty = (n, t) => `<tr data-empty="1"><td colspan="${n}"><i>${t}</i></td></tr>`;
  const inp = (id, ph, v = '', w = 90) => `<input id="${id}" placeholder="${ph}" value="${esc(v)}" style="width:${w}px">`, num = (id, ph, v) => `<input id="${id}" type="number" step="any" placeholder="${ph}" value="${v || ''}" style="width:80px">`;
  const FLEX = 'display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;align-items:center';
  const jr = j => {
    const t = j.taxInv, F = !t && j.fuel ? j.fuel : null, tx = j.vat > 0 ? rd(j.vat / .13) : 0, form = t
      ? `<div style="${FLEX}">${esc(t.supplier)} · PAN ${esc(t.supplierPan)} · bill ${esc(t.billNo)} · taxable ${f(t.taxable)} · VAT ${f(t.vat)} <button onclick="unlinkTaxInv(${j.id})">Remove from purchase book</button></div>`
      : F && F.inBook ? `<div style="${FLEX}">Fuel (no VAT no. / invoice no.) · taxable ${f(F.taxable)} · VAT ${f(F.vat)} <button onclick="fuelRemove(${j.id})">Remove from purchase book</button></div>`
      : `<div style="${FLEX}">${inp('ti' + j.id + 's', 'Supplier', '', 190)}${inp('ti' + j.id + 'p', F ? 'PAN (optional for fuel)' : 'PAN (9 digits)', '', 130)}${inp('ti' + j.id + 'b', F ? 'Invoice no. (optional)' : 'Invoice no.', '', 120)}${num('ti' + j.id + 'n', 'Non-taxable', F ? 0 : rd(j.exp - tx))}${num('ti' + j.id + 't', 'Taxable', F ? F.taxable : tx)}${num('ti' + j.id + 'v', 'VAT', F ? F.vat : j.vat)}<button class="p" onclick="linkTaxInv(${j.id}${F ? ', true' : ''})">Add to purchase book</button>${F ? `<small>Fuel: no VAT no. or invoice no. needed. VAT is ${F.vatBooked ? 'as booked to 1050' : '13/113 of the amount'}.</small>` : ''}</div>`;
    return `<tr><td style="white-space:nowrap">${esc(j.no)}<br>${esc(j.bs || j.date)}</td><td>${esc(j.narration)}<br><small>Credited to: ${esc(j.credits.join(', '))}</small></td><td class="n" style="white-space:nowrap">${f(j.exp)}<br><small>VAT ${f(j.vat)}</small></td><td><span class="chip ${j.status.startsWith('In purchase book') ? 'ok' : 'due'}">${esc(j.status)}</span>${j.problem ? `<br><span class="err">${esc(j.problem)}</span>` : ''}</td></tr>
      <tr data-with="1"><td colspan="4" style="padding-top:0;border-bottom:2px solid rgba(128,128,128,.35)">${form}</td></tr>`;
  };

  // 1. Hand-made vouchers that may hold a purchase
  const pending = J.filter(j => !j.status.startsWith('In purchase book')).length;
  const vouchers = sec('rev-vouchers', 'Review: purchases that are not purchase bills', `${J.length} voucher${J.length == 1 ? '' : 's'} · ${pending} not in purchase book`,
    `<div class="ch">${mxBtn('rev-vouchers')}${rvBtn()}</div><p class="note">Vouchers typed by hand (for example expenses the CEO paid for the company) are <b>not</b> in the purchase book until you add the supplier's tax invoice details below. Input VAT can only be claimed with a tax invoice in the company's name and PAN. The voucher must already debit the VAT to <b>1050 VAT Receivable</b>. <b>Fuel</b> (a voucher debiting a fuel expense account) is the exception: it can be added with the <b>Add fuel to purchase book</b> button without a VAT no. or invoice no. (VAT = 13/113 of the amount, unless the voucher already debits VAT to 1050; the voucher no. is shown in place of the bill no.).</p>
    <div class="tw" style="max-height:none"><table>${th('Voucher', 'Narration', '#Expense / VAT', 'Status and tax invoice')}${J.length ? J.map(jr).join('') : empty(4, 'No hand-made vouchers with expenses in this period')}</table></div>`);

  // 2. Fuel paid with no VAT bill / bill no.: review, then add to the purchase book (VAT = 13/113 of the amount paid)
  const fuelNew = fuel.filter(x => !x.inBook), fuelTot = rd(fuel.reduce((t, x) => t + (+x.amount || 0), 0));
  const fuelSec = sec('rev-fuel', 'Review: fuel purchases (add to purchase book)', `${fuel.length} payment${fuel.length == 1 ? '' : 's'} · ${fuel.length - fuelNew.length} in purchase book · ${f(fuelTot)}`,
    `<div class="ch">${mxBtn('rev-fuel')}${fuelNew.length ? `<button class="p sp" onclick="fuelAddAll([${fuelNew.map(x => x.id).join(',')}])">Add all ${fuelNew.length} to purchase book</button>` : ''}${loBtn()}</div><p class="note">Fuel paid from Payments made can go in the purchase book even without a VAT no. or bill no. Review each payment, then press <b>Add</b>. The VAT is worked out by us as 13/113 of the amount paid, and the voucher number is shown in place of the bill number. This changes the register only: the ledger still holds the full amount in the expense account, so the VAT is not in 1050 VAT Receivable.</p>
    <div class="tw" style="max-height:none"><table>${th('Voucher', 'Date', 'Paid to', 'Charged to', 'Note', '#Amount', '#Taxable', '#VAT (13/113)', 'Purchase book')}${fuel.length ? fuel.map(x => `<tr><td>${esc(x.no)}</td><td>${esc(x.bs || x.date)}</td><td>${esc(x.payee)}</td><td>${esc(x.account)}</td><td><small>${esc(x.note)}</small></td><td class="n">${f(x.amount)}</td><td class="n">${f(x.taxable)}</td><td class="n">${f(x.vatInTotal)}</td><td style="white-space:nowrap">${x.inBook ? `<span class="chip ok">In purchase book</span> <button onclick="fuelRemove(${x.id})">Remove</button>` : `<button class="p" onclick="fuelAdd(${x.id})">Add</button>`}</td></tr>`).join('') : empty(9, 'No fuel payments in this period')}</table></div>`);

  // 3. Every other payment made with no invoice: left out of the purchase book unless reviewed and added by hand (permits, entry fees etc.)
  const othLeft = oth.filter(x => !x.inBook), othNew = othLeft.filter(x => x.canBook);
  const payments = sec('rev-payments', 'Payments left out of the purchase book (no invoice)', `${othLeft.length} left out · ${oth.length - othLeft.length} in purchase book`,
    `<div class="ch">${mxBtn('rev-payments')}${loBtn()}</div><p class="note">Payments made without an invoice are not in the purchase book: only VAT bills go in. The exception is a purchase (for example <b>permits and entry fees</b>) that you have reviewed: press <b>Add to purchase book</b> and it goes in with the VAT worked out as 13/113 of the amount paid, and the voucher number in place of the bill number. This changes the register only: the ledger still holds the full amount in the expense account. Salary, loans, bank charges, depreciation and advances cannot be added.</p>
    <div class="tw" style="max-height:none"><table>${th('Voucher', 'Date', 'Paid to', 'Charged to', 'Note', '#Amount', '#VAT (13/113)', 'Why / purchase book')}${oth.length ? oth.map(x => `<tr><td>${esc(x.no)}</td><td>${esc(x.bs || x.date)}</td><td>${esc(x.payee)}</td><td>${esc(x.account)}</td><td><small>${esc(x.note)}</small></td><td class="n">${f(x.amount)}</td><td class="n">${x.canBook ? f(x.vatInTotal) : ''}</td><td>${x.inBook ? `<span class="chip ok">In purchase book</span> <button onclick="fuelRemove(${x.id})">Remove</button>` : x.canBook ? `<button class="p" onclick="fuelAdd(${x.id})">Add to purchase book</button><br><small>${esc(x.reason)}</small>` : `<small>${esc(x.reason)}</small>`}</td></tr>`).join('') : empty(8, 'None in this period')}</table></div>`);

  // 4. Saved bills with problems (all dates)
  const issues = sec('rev-issues', 'Saved bills that need attention', `${R.issues.length} issue${R.issues.length == 1 ? '' : 's'} · all dates`,
    `<div class="ch"><span class="sub" style="margin:0">All dates. Fix with Records → edit</span>${mxBtn('rev-issues')}</div>
    <div class="tw" style="max-height:none"><table>${th('Type', 'Bill no.', 'Party', 'Date', 'Problem')}${R.issues.length ? R.issues.map(x => `<tr><td>${x.kind}</td><td>${esc(x.billNo)}</td><td>${esc(x.party)}</td><td>${esc(x.date)}</td><td class="err">${esc(x.issue)}</td></tr>`).join('') : empty(5, 'No problems found')}</table></div>`);

  return vouchers + fuelSec + payments + issues;
};

export async function linkTaxInv(id, fuel) {
  const g = k => $('#ti' + id + k).value, body = { supplier: g('s'), supplierPan: g('p'), billNo: g('b'), nonTax: g('n'), taxable: g('t'), vat: g('v') };
  const full = body.supplier.trim() && /^\d{9}$/.test(body.supplierPan.trim()) && body.billNo.trim() && +body.vat > 0;
  if (fuel && !full) return fuelAdd(id, { supplier: body.supplier.trim(), billNo: body.billNo.trim() }); // fuel: no VAT no. / invoice no. needed
  if (!full) return alert('Only VAT bills go in the purchase book. It needs the supplier name, a 9-digit VAT/PAN number, the bill number and VAT above zero. A PAN-only bill, or one without a bill number, is not added.');
  const j = await post('/api/vouchers/' + id + '/taxinv', body); if (!j) return; await load(); toast('Added to the purchase book');
}

export async function unlinkTaxInv(id) { if (!confirm('Remove this voucher from the purchase book? The voucher itself is not changed.')) return; await fetch('/api/vouchers/' + id + '/taxinv', { method: 'DELETE' }); await load(); }

export async function fuelAdd(id, det) { const r = await fetch('/api/vouchers/' + id + '/fuelbook', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(det || {}) }), j = await r.json().catch(() => ({})); if (!r.ok) return alert(j.error || 'Could not add this payment'); await load(); toast('Added to the purchase book'); }

export async function fuelRemove(id) { if (!confirm('Remove this fuel payment from the purchase book? The payment itself is not changed.')) return; await fetch('/api/vouchers/' + id + '/fuelbook', { method: 'DELETE' }); await load(); }

export async function fuelAddAll(ids) { if (!confirm(ids.length + ' fuel payment(s) will be added to the purchase book, with VAT worked out as 13/113 of each amount. Continue?')) return; const j = await post('/api/fuelbook', { ids }); if (!j) return; await load(); toast(j.added + ' fuel payment(s) added to the purchase book'); }
```

```js
// pages/salary-forms.js — Salary page actions
// (split out of the old single-file index.html by migrate.js; code is unchanged)
import { $, F, N, post, toast } from '../lib/dom.js';
import { f } from '../lib/format.js';
import { D, cashAccs, load, render } from '../lib/state.js';
import { chqOk, chqPick } from './payments-forms.js';

// ---- Salary payment page ----
export function lmode() { $('#lfw').hidden = $('#lmo').value != 'Fonepay'; const want = { Cash: ['cash'], Cheque: ['bank'], Fonepay: ['fonepay', 'bank'], 'Bank transfer': ['bank'] }[$('#lmo').value] || []; for (const w of want) { const a = cashAccs().find(x => x.name.toLowerCase().includes(w)); if (a) { $('#lac').value = a.code; break; } } chqPick('lin', 'lac', 'lmo'); }

export async function saveSalary() {
  if (!chqOk('lin', 'lac', 'lmo')) return; const er = window.sle, body = { staff: F('lnm'), period: F('lpr'), date: F('ldt'), bs: F('lbs'), amount: N('lam'), mode: F('lmo'), account: F('lac'), instrument: F('lin'), note: F('lnt'), debitAccount: F('lde'), fee: N('lfe') };
  const j = await post(er ? '/api/salaries/' + er.id : '/api/salaries', body, er ? 'PUT' : 'POST'); if (!j) return; window.sle = null; window.slp = null; window.sls = null; await load();
  toast('Salary ' + j.no + (er ? ' updated' : ' recorded for ' + body.staff) + (j.saved ? '\nSaved to ' + j.saved : ''), 'salary');
}

export function pickStaff(i) { window.sle = null; window.sls = D.db.staff[i].name; window.slp = { staff: D.db.staff[i].name }; render(); }

export async function saveStaff() { const j = await post('/api/db/staff', { name: F('ldn'), designation: F('ldg'), phone: F('lph'), ledger: F('ldl') }); if (j) { window.sls = j.name; await load(); toast('Staff saved'); } }

export async function delStaff(i) { if (!confirm('Remove this person from the staff list? Their past salary payments stay in the books.')) return; await fetch('/api/db/staff/' + encodeURIComponent(D.db.staff[i].name), { method: 'DELETE' }); window.sls = null; load(); }

export async function migrateOld() {
  const p = await (await fetch('/api/migrate')).json(); if (!p.salaries.length && !p.files) return toast('Nothing to update. No old salary payments or payment voucher files need converting.');
  if (!confirm((p.salaries.length ? p.salaries.length + ' payment(s) will become salary payments:\n\n' + p.salaries.map(x => x.date + '  ' + x.payee + '  ' + f(x.amount)).join('\n') : '') + (p.files ? '\n\n' + p.files + ' payment voucher Excel file(s) will be moved from the PV folder to the PMV folder.' : '') + '\n\nA backup of data.json and db.json is made first. Continue?')) return;
  const j = await (await fetch('/api/migrate', { method: 'POST' })).json(); await load(); toast(j.converted + ' payment(s) converted, ' + j.moved + ' file(s) moved to PMV. Backup files end with .bak-' + j.backup);
}

export function pickStaffByName(v) { const i = D.db.staff.findIndex(x => x.name.toLowerCase() === String(v).trim().toLowerCase()); if (i >= 0 && D.db.staff[i].name !== window.sls) { window.sls = D.db.staff[i].name; window.sle = null; window.slp = null; render(); } }
```
