// pages/settings.js — Settings page: company, categories, storage, bank accounts, cheque formats, bank matching/splitting
// (split out of the old single-file index.html by migrate.js; code is unchanged)
import { $, F, esc, post, toast } from '../lib/dom.js';
import { f, rd } from '../lib/format.js';
import { D, acc, load, render } from '../lib/state.js';

export async function rebuildFiles() {
  if (!confirm('Rewrite the Excel files of every voucher and bill from this app\'s data? Files with the same names in the storage folder are replaced.')) return;
  const j = await post('/api/rebuild-files', { missing: $('#rbm').checked, from: $('#rbf').value }); if (!j) return; await load();
  alert(j.vouchers + ' voucher file(s) and ' + j.bills + ' bill file(s) rebuilt.' + (j.orphanCount ? '\n\n' + j.orphanCount + ' file(s) in the folder do not belong to any voucher here (maybe made by another copy). They were left alone:\n' + j.orphans.slice(0, 25).join(', ') + (j.orphanCount > 25 ? ', …' : '') : ''));
}

export async function addCat() { const j = await post('/api/categories', { name: F('newcat') }); if (j) load(); }

export async function delCat(i) { if (!confirm('Remove this category from the list? Existing entries keep their accounts.')) return; await fetch('/api/categories/' + encodeURIComponent(D.settings.categories[i]), { method: 'DELETE' }); load(); }

// ---- Bank accounts and cheque number formats ----
// Same rule as server.js: a cheque number fits a bank when one run of digits in it matches the format (7895xxxx: x = any digit; digits only = "starts with").
export const fmtParts = f => String(f || '').split(/[,;]+/).map(x => x.toLowerCase().replace(/[\s-]/g, '').replace(/[#*?]/g, 'x')).filter(Boolean).map(s => ({ s, pre: !s.includes('x') }));

export const fmtHit = (p, run) => p.pre ? run.startsWith(p.s) : run.length === p.s.length && [...p.s].every((c, i) => c === 'x' || c === run[i]);

export function bankCard() {
  const B = D.db.banks || [], e = B.find(b => b.ledger == window.bke), bkey = window.bke || ''; if (!window.bkfs || window.bkfsFor !== bkey) { window.bkfs = e ? fmtParts(e.chequeFormat).map(p => p.s) : []; window.bkfsFor = bkey; }
  const free = D.accounts.filter(a => a.type == 'A' && (/bank/i.test(a.name) || a.group == 'Bank Accounts') && !B.some(b => b.ledger == a.code));
  return `<div class="card" id="bkcard"><div class="ch"><h2>Bank accounts</h2><span class="sub" style="margin:0">Pick one under “Paid from” on Payments made and Salary payment</span></div>
    <div class="row"><label>Bank name<input id="bkn" value="${esc(e ? e.bank : '')}" placeholder="e.g. Nabil Bank"></label><label>Account no.<input id="bka" value="${esc(e ? e.account : '')}"></label>
      <div class="fld w2"><span>Cheque no. formats <small>(one for each cheque book)</small></span><div id="bkfc" style="display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;min-height:26px;align-items:center">${bkfChips()}</div>
        <div style="display:flex;gap:8px"><input id="bkf" placeholder="e.g. 7895xxxx, then Enter" onkeydown="bkfKey(event)" onblur="bkfAdd(true)"><button type="button" style="white-space:nowrap" onclick="bkfAdd()">Add format</button></div></div>
      ${!e && free.length ? `<label>Ledger account<select id="bkl"><option value="">Create a new one</option>${free.map(a => `<option value="${a.code}">Use existing: ${esc(a.name)}</option>`).join('')}</select></label>` : ''}
      <div><button class="p" onclick="saveBank()">${e ? 'Update bank account' : 'Add bank account'}</button>${e ? ' <button onclick="window.bke=null;window.bkfs=null;render()">Cancel</button>' : ''}</div></div>
    <p class="sub" style="margin:4px 0 14px"><small>Cheque no. format: type the digits that are the same on every cheque of that bank and <b>x</b> for the digits that change, e.g. <b>7895xxxx</b>. A bank can have <b>several formats</b>, one for each cheque book: type one and press Enter (or Add format), then add the next, e.g. 7895xxxx and 4410xxxx; typing digits only (7895) means “starts with 7895”. It is used to pick the bank when you type a cheque number, and to update old records below. Each bank account gets its own ledger account, so it shows in the ledger, trial balance and balance sheet.</small></p>
    <div class="tw"><table><thead><tr><th>Bank</th><th>Account no.</th><th>Cheque no. formats</th><th>Ledger account</th><th></th></tr></thead><tbody>${B.map(b => `<tr><td><b>${esc(b.bank)}</b></td><td>${esc(b.account)}</td><td>${fmtParts(b.chequeFormat).map(p => `<span class="chip" style="margin:0 4px 4px 0" title="${esc(fmtHint(p.s))}">${esc(p.s)}</span>`).join('') || '—'}</td><td>${esc((acc(b.ledger) || {}).name || '')}<br><small>${esc(b.ledger)}</small></td><td class="act"><button onclick="editBank('${b.ledger}')">Edit</button> <button class="d" onclick="delBank('${b.ledger}')">Remove</button></td></tr>`).join('') || '<tr><td class="empty" colspan="5">No bank accounts yet.</td></tr>'}</tbody></table></div></div>`;
}

export async function saveBank() { if (!bkfAdd()) return; const e = window.bke, j = await post('/api/banks' + (e ? '/' + e : ''), { bank: F('bkn'), account: F('bka'), chequeFormat: window.bkfs.join(', '), ledger: e || !$('#bkl') ? '' : F('bkl') }, e ? 'PUT' : 'POST'); if (!j) return; window.bke = null; window.bkfs = null; await load(); toast('Bank account ' + (e ? 'updated' : 'added') + ': ' + j.name); }

export function editBank(code) { window.bke = code; window.bkfs = null; render(); $('#bkcard').scrollIntoView({ block: 'start' }); $('#bkn').focus(); }

export async function delBank(code) { if (!confirm('Remove this bank account from the list? Payments already made from it keep their ledger account.')) return; const r = await fetch('/api/banks/' + encodeURIComponent(code), { method: 'DELETE' }), j = await r.json(); if (!r.ok) return alert(j.error); if (window.bke == code) { window.bke = null; window.bkfs = null; } await load(); toast(j.kept ? 'Removed from the list. Its ledger account is kept because it has entries.' : 'Bank account removed.'); }

export async function bankScan() { const r = await fetch('/api/bank-match'); window.bm = await r.json(); render(); $('#bmcard').scrollIntoView({ block: 'start' }); }

export async function bankApply() {
  if (!confirm(window.bm.change.length + ' cheque payment(s) will be moved to the bank account their cheque number belongs to. Amounts and dates stay the same; only the “paid from” account changes.\n\nA backup of data.json is made first. Continue?')) return;
  const j = await post('/api/bank-match', {}); if (!j) return; window.bm = null; await load(); toast(j.moved + ' payment(s) moved to their bank account' + (j.files ? ', ' + j.files + ' voucher Excel file(s) refreshed' : '') + (j.skipped ? '. ' + j.skipped + ' skipped (no bank line found)' : '') + (j.backup ? '. Backup: data.json.bak-' + j.backup : ''));
}

export function bankMatchCard() {
  const m = window.bm, rows = (L, cols) => `<div class="tw"><table><thead><tr><th>Date</th><th>Voucher</th><th>Paid to</th><th>Cheque no.</th><th class="n">Amount</th>${cols.map(c => `<th>${c[0]}</th>`).join('')}</tr></thead><tbody>${L.map(r => `<tr><td>${r.date}${r.bs ? '<br><small>' + esc(r.bs) + '</small>' : ''}</td><td><b>${r.no}</b></td><td>${esc(r.who)}</td><td>${esc(r.cheque) || '—'}</td><td class="n">${f(r.amount)}</td>${cols.map(c => `<td>${c[1](r)}</td>`).join('')}</tr>`).join('')}</tbody></table></div>`;
  const more = (L, t, cols) => L.length ? `<details style="margin:10px 0 0"><summary style="cursor:pointer;font-weight:600;font-size:13px">${L.length} ${t}</summary>${rows(L, cols)}</details>` : '';
  const body = !m ? '' : !m.banks ? '<p class="sub" style="margin:12px 0 0">Add a cheque no. format to at least one bank account above first.</p>' : `<div style="margin-top:14px">
    <p class="sub" style="margin:0 0 10px"><b>${m.change.length}</b> cheque payment(s) will move to the bank their cheque number belongs to. <b>${m.check.length}</b> need your check and <b>${m.none.length}</b> have no matching bank; those are left as they are.</p>
    ${m.change.length ? rows(m.change, [['Now', r => esc(r.from)], ['Will be', r => '<b>' + esc(r.to) + '</b>']]) : '<p class="sub" style="margin:0">Nothing to move: every cheque that fits a bank format is already on that bank.</p>'}
    ${more(m.check, 'to check', [['Paid from', r => esc(r.from)], ['Why', r => esc(r.note)]])}${more(m.none, 'with no matching bank', [['Paid from', r => esc(r.from)], ['Why', r => esc(r.note)]])}
    <div class="actbar">${m.change.length ? `<button class="p" onclick="bankApply()">Move ${m.change.length} payment(s)</button>` : ''}<button onclick="window.bm=null;render()">Close</button></div></div>`;
  return `<div class="card" id="bmcard"><div class="ch"><h2>Match old cheque payments to banks</h2></div><p class="sub" style="margin:0 0 10px">Looks at every old payment made and salary payment paid by cheque and, using the cheque no. formats above, works out which bank account it came from. You see the list first; nothing changes until you press Move. Ledgers, trial balance and the voucher Excel files are updated, and a backup of data.json is made first. Run it again any time, for example after adding another bank.</p><button onclick="bankScan()">Check old cheque payments</button>${body}</div>`;
}

// ---- Several cheque number formats for one bank (chips) ----
export const fmtHint = s => s.includes('x') ? `Any ${s.length}-digit cheque number that matches ${s} (x = any digit)` : `Any cheque number starting with ${s}`;

export const bkfChips = () => (window.bkfs || []).map((s, i) => `<span class="chip" title="${esc(fmtHint(s))}">${esc(s)} <a href="#" title="Remove this format" onclick="bkfDel(${i});return false">×</a></span>`).join(' ') || '<small>No format yet</small>';

export function bkfAdd(silent) {
  const el = $('#bkf'); if (!el) return true; const parts = fmtParts(el.value); if (!parts.length) return true;
  if (parts.some(p => !/^[0-9x]+$/.test(p.s) || !/\d/.test(p.s))) { if (!silent) alert('A cheque number format can only contain digits and x, for example 7895xxxx'); return false; }
  parts.forEach(p => { if (!window.bkfs.includes(p.s)) window.bkfs.push(p.s); }); el.value = ''; $('#bkfc').innerHTML = bkfChips(); return true;
}

export function bkfDel(i) { window.bkfs.splice(i, 1); $('#bkfc').innerHTML = bkfChips(); }

export function bkfKey(e) { if (e.key == 'Enter' || e.key == ',') { e.preventDefault(); bkfAdd(); } }

// ---- Old payments with several cheque numbers from different banks in one voucher: type each cheque's amount, then split ----
export async function splitScanUI() { window.bsp = await (await fetch('/api/bank-split')).json(); render(); $('#bspcard').scrollIntoView({ block: 'start' }); }

export function splitSum(id) {
  const r = window.bsp.rows.find(x => x.id == id), ins = [...document.querySelectorAll(`[data-sv="${id}"]`)], sum = rd(ins.reduce((t, i) => t + (+i.value || 0), 0)), o = $('#bsr' + id);
  o.innerHTML = !sum ? '<small>Type each cheque’s amount</small>' : Math.abs(sum - r.total) < .005 ? '<span class="chip ok">Adds up</span>' : `<small style="color:var(--err)">${f(sum)} entered · ${f(r.total - sum)} ${sum > r.total ? 'too much' : 'to go'}</small>`;
}

export function splitType(el, id) {
  const r = window.bsp.rows.find(x => x.id == id), ins = [...document.querySelectorAll(`[data-sv="${id}"]`)]; el.dataset.auto = '';
  if (ins.length == 2) { const o = ins.find(i => i !== el); if (!o.value || o.dataset.auto) { const v = rd(r.total - (+el.value || 0)); o.value = el.value && v > 0 ? v : ''; o.dataset.auto = '1'; } } // two cheques: the second is filled in with what is left
  splitSum(id);
}

export async function bankSplitApply() {
  const items = [];
  for (const r of window.bsp.rows) {
    const vals = [...document.querySelectorAll(`[data-sv="${r.id}"]`)].map(i => ({ cheque: i.dataset.ch, amount: +i.value || 0 })); if (!vals.some(v => v.amount)) continue;
    if (vals.some(v => v.amount <= 0)) return alert(`Enter an amount for every cheque of ${r.no}, or clear them all to leave it for later.`);
    const sum = rd(vals.reduce((t, v) => t + v.amount, 0)); if (Math.abs(sum - r.total) > .004) return alert(`${r.no}: the cheques add up to ${f(sum)} but the payment is ${f(r.total)}.`);
    items.push({ id: r.id, parts: vals });
  }
  if (!items.length) return alert('Type the amount of each cheque first. Payments left empty stay as they are.');
  if (!confirm(items.length + ' payment(s) will be split so each cheque is booked to its own bank account. The supplier, total amount and date stay the same; only the “paid from” side is divided.\n\nA backup of data.json is made first. Continue?')) return;
  const j = await post('/api/bank-split', { items }); if (!j) return; window.bsp = null; await load(); toast(j.split + ' payment(s) split by bank' + (j.files ? ', ' + j.files + ' voucher Excel file(s) refreshed' : '') + '. Backup: data.json.bak-' + j.backup);
}

export function bankSplitCard() {
  const m = window.bsp,
    amt = (r, p) => `<div style="margin:0 0 8px"><b>${esc(p.cheque)}</b> <small>· ${esc(p.bank)}</small><br><input type="number" step="any" placeholder="Amount" style="width:150px;margin-top:3px" data-sv="${r.id}" data-ch="${esc(p.cheque)}" oninput="splitType(this,${r.id})"></div>`,
    who = r => `<td>${r.date}${r.bs ? '<br><small>' + esc(r.bs) + '</small>' : ''}</td><td><b>${r.no}</b></td><td>${esc(r.who)}<br><small>Cheque field: ${esc(r.ref)}</small></td>`,
    body = !m ? '' : m.error ? `<p class="sub" style="margin:12px 0 0;color:var(--err)">The server did not understand this request (${esc(m.error)}). It is probably still running the old server.js: replace it with the new server.js, stop the server and start it again with <b>node server.js</b>, then press Check old payments.</p>` : m.banks < 2 ? '<p class="sub" style="margin:12px 0 0">Add a cheque no. format to at least two bank accounts above first.</p>' : `<div style="margin-top:14px">
      <p class="sub" style="margin:0 0 10px"><b>${m.rows.length}</b> payment(s) can be split. ${m.check.length ? `<b>${m.check.length}</b> need a look by hand.` : ''}</p>
      ${m.rows.length ? `<div class="tw"><table><thead><tr><th>Date</th><th>Voucher</th><th>Paid to</th><th>Now paid from</th><th class="n">Payment</th><th>Cheques and their amounts</th><th></th></tr></thead><tbody>${m.rows.map(r => `<tr>${who(r)}<td>${esc(r.from)}</td><td class="n">${f(r.total)}</td><td>${r.parts.map(p => amt(r, p)).join('')}</td><td id="bsr${r.id}"><small>Type each cheque’s amount</small></td></tr>`).join('')}</tbody></table></div>` : '<p class="sub" style="margin:0">No old payment has cheque numbers from different banks in one voucher.</p>'}
      ${m.check.length ? `<details style="margin:10px 0 0"><summary style="cursor:pointer;font-weight:600;font-size:13px">${m.check.length} to check by hand</summary><div class="tw"><table><thead><tr><th>Date</th><th>Voucher</th><th>Paid to</th><th class="n">Payment</th><th>Why</th></tr></thead><tbody>${m.check.map(r => `<tr>${who(r)}<td class="n">${f(r.total)}</td><td>${esc(r.note)}</td></tr>`).join('')}</tbody></table></div></details>` : ''}
      <div class="actbar">${m.rows.length ? '<button class="p" onclick="bankSplitApply()">Split the payments I filled in</button>' : ''}<button onclick="window.bsp=null;render()">Close</button></div></div>`;
  return `<div class="card" id="bspcard"><div class="ch"><h2>Split old payments made with several cheques</h2></div><p class="sub" style="margin:0 0 10px">Finds old payments where one voucher lists cheque numbers from <b>different banks</b> (for example “7895001, 4410002”). Each cheque is matched to its bank by the formats above; you type the amount of each cheque, and the payment is split so every bank’s ledger shows its own cheque. The supplier, total, date and bill stay the same. Payments you leave empty are not touched, and a backup of data.json is made first.</p><button onclick="splitScanUI()">Check old payments</button>${body}</div>`;
}

export async function saveFee(id) { const el = $('#ff' + id), v = D.vouchers.find(x => x.id == id); if (el.value === '') return alert('Enter the Fonepay charge (0 if there was none).'); const r = await fetch('/api/' + (v.sal ? export const settings = () => {

  if (q.length && vis.length == 1 && window.stl[+vis[0].dataset.i].n != window.stn) { const v = $('#sq').value; window.stn = window.stl[+vis[0].dataset.i].n; render(); const e = $('#sq'); e.value = v; e.focus(); e.setSelectionRange(v.length, v.length); sqFilter(); }

// pages/statements.js — Statements page
// (split out of the old single-file index.html by migrate.js; code is unchanged)
import { esc } from '../lib/dom.js';
import { f } from '../lib/format.js';
import { D, FR, TO, cum, net } from '../lib/state.js';

// ---- Statements page ----
export const SK = [['supplier', 'Suppliers'], ['customer', 'Customers'], ['staff', 'Staff'], ['expense', 'Expenses']];

export function stmtList(k) {
  const key = x => String(x || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  if (k == 'supplier') return D.payables.map(x => ({ n: x.name, s: f(x.balance), t: 'we owe', sub: x.pan }));
  if (k == 'customer') return D.receivables.map(x => ({ n: x.name, s: f(x.balance), t: 'they owe', sub: x.pan }));
  if (k == 'staff') return D.db.staff.slice().sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name)).map(x => ({ n: x.name, s: f(D.vouchers.filter(v => v.sal && key(v.sal.staff) == key(x.name)).reduce((t, v) => t + v.sal.amount, 0)), t: 'paid', sub: x.designation }));
  return D.accounts.filter(a => a.type == 'X').map(a => ({ n: a.name, s: f(net(a.code, cum)), t: 'to date', sub: a.group }));
}

export function stmtDates() { return { from: window.stf || FR(), to: window.stt || TO() }; }

export const stmt = () => {
  const k = window.stk || 'supplier', L = stmtList(k), d = stmtDates(), sel = L.find(x => x.n == window.stn); window.stl = L;
  const open = !!window.stlist, tabs = `<div class="seg">${SK.map(([id, t]) => `<button class="${id == k ? 'on' : ''}" onclick="window.stk='${id}';window.stn=null;window.stlist=false;render()">${t}</button>`).join('')}</div>`;
  // picker bar: always visible, collapsed by default
  const bar = `<div class="card" style="padding:14px 18px;margin-bottom:16px">
      <div class="fl" style="flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center">
        <label style="flex-direction:row;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin:0;white-space:nowrap;font-weight:500">${SK.find(x => x[0] == k)[1]}
          <input type="search" id="spick2" list="stmtlist" placeholder="Type a name…"
                 value="${sel ? esc(sel.n) : ''}" onchange="pickStmtByName(this.value)" style="min-width:300px">
        </label>
        <datalist id="stmtlist">${L.map(x => `<option value="${esc(x.n)}">`).join('')}</datalist>
        <button onclick="window.stlist=!window.stlist;render()">${open ? '▴ Hide list' : '▾ Show list'}</button>
        ${sel ? `<button class="p" onclick="getFile(stmtUrl('xlsx/'))">Download Excel</button>` : ''}
        <span class="sub" style="margin:0 0 0 auto">${L.length} ${SK.find(x => x[0] == k)[1].toLowerCase()}</span>
      </div>
    </div>`;
  // the expandable list (only when toggled open)
  const list = !open ? '' : `<div class="card">
      <input type="search" id="sq" placeholder="Search by name…" oninput="sqFilter()" style="margin-bottom:12px">
      <div class="tw"><table><thead><tr><th>Name</th><th class="n">Balance</th></tr></thead><tbody id="smbody">${L.map((x, i) => `<tr class="click ${sel && sel.n == x.n ? 'sel' : ''}" data-i="${i}" data-q="${esc((x.n + ' ' + (x.sub || '')).toLowerCase())}" onclick="pickStmt(${i})"><td><b>${esc(x.n)}</b>${x.sub ? '<br><small>' + esc(x.sub) + '</small>' : ''}</td><td class="n">${x.s}<br><small>${x.t}</small></td></tr>`).join('') || '<tr><td class="empty" colspan="2">Nothing here yet.</td></tr>'}</tbody></table></div>
    </div>`;
  // the statement below the bar
  const stmt = `<div class="card"><div class="ch">
        <h2>${sel ? 'Statement: ' + esc(sel.n) : 'Statement'}</h2>
        ${sel ? `<div class="fl" style="margin-left:auto">
          <label style="margin:0">From<input type="date" id="sdf" value="${d.from}" onchange="setStmtDates()"></label>
          <label style="margin:0">To<input type="date" id="sdt" value="${d.to}" onchange="setStmtDates()"></label>
        </div>` : ''}
      </div>
      ${sel ? '<div id="smain"><p class="sub">Loading…</p></div>'
            : `<p class="sub" style="margin:0">Pick a ${SK.find(x => x[0] == k)[1].toLowerCase().replace(/s$/, '')} above${open ? ', or click a name in the list' : ' (use “Show list” to browse with balances)'} to see its statement.</p>`}
    </div>`;
  return tabs + bar + list + stmt;
};

// pages/trial.js — Trial balance, income statement, balance sheet
// (split out of the old single-file index.html by migrate.js; code is unchanged)
import { esc } from '../lib/dom.js';
import { f } from '../lib/format.js';
import { D, FR, TO, closing, cum, groups, net, ofType, per, priorPL } from '../lib/state.js';

export const rows = (list, valFn) => list.map(a => ({ a, v: valFn(a) })).filter(x => Math.abs(x.v) > .004);

export const section = (title, list, sign) => { // list of accounts, sign flips Dr-Cr into natural balance
  let tot = 0, h = `<tr class="sec"><th colspan="2">${title}</th></tr>`;
  groups(list).forEach(g => {
    const r = rows(list.filter(a => a.group == g), a => sign * closing(a)); if (!r.length) return;
    h += (g == title ? '' : `<tr class="grp"><td colspan="2">${esc(g)}</td></tr>`) + r.map(x => `<tr><td class="ind">${x.a.code} ${esc(x.a.name)}</td><td class="n">${f(x.v)}</td></tr>`).join(''); tot += r.reduce((s, x) => s + x.v, 0);
  });
  return { h, tot };
};

export const dl = k => `<div class="tool"><button class="p" onclick="getFile('/api/xlsx/statement/${k}?from=${FR()}&to=${TO()}')">Download Excel</button></div>`;

export const collected = () => {
  const got = D.vouchers.filter(v => v.rcpt && !v.rcpt.other && per(v.date)).reduce((t, v) => t + v.rcpt.amount, 0), due = D.accounts.filter(a => a.group == 'Sundry Debtors').reduce((t, a) => t + net(a.code, cum), 0);
  return `<div class="vat" style="max-width:820px"><div><span>Received from customers in this period</span><b>${f(got)}</b></div><div><span>Still receivable from customers (as at ${TO()})</span><b>${f(due)}</b></div></div><p class="sub" style="max-width:820px"><small>Income below is counted when the sales bill is made. The two figures above show how much of what you billed has actually been collected.</small></p>`;
};

export const tb = () => {
  let dr = 0, cr = 0; const p = priorPL();
  const r = ofType('ALEIX').map(a => ({ a, v: closing(a) })).filter(x => Math.abs(x.v) > .004);
  if (Math.abs(p) > .004) r.push({ a: { code: '', name: "Prior years' profit/(loss) carried forward" }, v: p });
  return `<p class="sub">As at ${TO()}</p>${dl('tb')}<div class="card sheet"><div class="tw"><table><tr><th>Account</th><th class="n">Debit</th><th class="n">Credit</th></tr>` + r.map(x => {
    x.v > 0 ? dr += x.v : cr -= x.v;
    return `<tr><td>${x.a.code} ${esc(x.a.name)}</td><td class="n">${x.v > 0 ? f(x.v) : ''}</td><td class="n">${x.v < 0 ? f(-x.v) : ''}</td></tr>`;
  }).join('') +
    `<tr class="t"><td>Total ${Math.abs(dr - cr) < .005 ? '<span class="ok">✓ tallies</span>' : '<span class="err">(does not tally)</span>'}</td><td class="n">${f(dr)}</td><td class="n">${f(cr)}</td></tr></table></div></div>`;
};

export const pl = () => {
  const inc = section('Income', ofType('I'), -1), dc = section('Direct Costs', ofType('X').filter(a => a.group == 'Direct Costs'), 1),
    op = section('Operating Expenses', ofType('X').filter(a => a.group != 'Direct Costs'), 1), gp = inc.tot - dc.tot;
  return `<p class="sub">${FR()} to ${TO()}</p>${dl('pl')}${collected()}<div class="card sheet"><div class="tw"><table>${inc.h}<tr class="t"><td>Total Income</td><td class="n">${f(inc.tot)}</td></tr>${dc.h}
    <tr class="t"><td>Gross Profit</td><td class="n">${f(gp)}</td></tr>${op.h}<tr class="t"><td>Total Operating Expenses</td><td class="n">${f(op.tot)}</td></tr>
    <tr class="t"><td>Net Profit / (Loss)</td><td class="n">${f(gp - op.tot)}</td></tr></table></div></div>`;
};

export const bs = () => {
  const A = section('Assets', ofType('A'), 1), L = section('Liabilities', ofType('L'), -1), E = section('Equity', ofType('E'), -1);
  const cur = -ofType('IX').reduce((s, a) => s + net(a.code, per), 0), pr = -priorPL(), eq = E.tot + cur + pr, rhs = L.tot + eq;
  return `<p class="sub">As at ${TO()}</p>${dl('bs')}<div class="card sheet"><div class="tw"><table>${A.h}<tr class="t"><td>Total Assets</td><td class="n">${f(A.tot)}</td></tr>${L.h}
    <tr class="t"><td>Total Liabilities</td><td class="n">${f(L.tot)}</td></tr>${E.h}<tr><td class="ind">Prior years' profit/(loss)</td><td class="n">${f(pr)}</td></tr>
    <tr><td class="ind">Current period profit/(loss)</td><td class="n">${f(cur)}</td></tr><tr class="t"><td>Total Equity</td><td class="n">${f(eq)}</td></tr>
    <tr class="t"><td>Total Liabilities + Equity ${Math.abs(A.tot - rhs) < .005 ? '<span class="ok">✓ matches assets</span>' : '<span class="err">(does not match assets)</span>'}</td><td class="n">${f(rhs)}</td></tr></table></div></div>`;
};
```

// pages/voucher.js — New voucher page
// (split out of the old single-file index.html by migrate.js; code is unchanged)
import { $, badAD, esc, toast } from '../lib/dom.js';
import { f, ymd } from '../lib/format.js';
import { FR, TO, load, nm, resolveAcc, setTab } from '../lib/state.js';

export const showErr = m => { $('#msg').innerHTML = `<span class="err">${esc(m)}</span>`; alert(m); };

export function addLine(l) {
  $('#ls').insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', `<tr><td><input list="al" class="ac" placeholder="Type code or name" value="${l ? esc(nm(l.account)) : ''}" oninput="calc()"></td>
  <td class="n"><input class="dr" type="number" step="any" style="text-align:right" value="${l && l.dr ? l.dr : ''}" oninput="calc()"></td><td class="n"><input class="cr" type="number" step="any" style="text-align:right" value="${l && l.cr ? l.cr : ''}" oninput="calc()"></td>
  <td><button class="x" title="Remove line" onclick="this.closest('tr').remove();calc()">×</button></td></tr>`);
}

export function calc() {
  let d = 0, c = 0; document.querySelectorAll('#ls tr').forEach(r => { const ac = r.querySelector('.ac'); ac.style.borderColor = ac.value && !resolveAcc(ac.value) ? '#B42318' : ''; d += +r.querySelector('.dr').value || 0; c += +r.querySelector('.cr').value || 0; });
  $('#tot').innerHTML = `<span>Debit <b>${f(d)}</b></span><span>Credit <b>${f(c)}</b></span>` + (Math.abs(d - c) < .005 && d > 0 ? '<span class="ok"><b>Balanced</b></span>' : !d && !c ? '<span>Enter debit and credit amounts</span>' : `<span class="err"><b>Difference ${f(d - c)}</b></span>`);
}

export async function save() {
  if (badAD($('#vd').value)) return;
  const rows = [...document.querySelectorAll('#ls tr')].map(r => ({ t: r.querySelector('.ac').value, dr: r.querySelector('.dr').value, cr: r.querySelector('.cr').value }));
  const bad = rows.filter(r => (+r.dr || +r.cr) && !resolveAcc(r.t));
  if (bad.length) return showErr('Account not found: ' + bad.map(r => '"' + (r.t || 'blank') + '"').join(', ') + '. Pick an account from the list while typing, or add it in the Accounts tab.');
  const lines = rows.map(r => ({ account: resolveAcc(r.t), dr: r.dr, cr: r.cr }));
  const body = { type: $('#vt').value, date: $('#vd').value, bs: $('#vb').value, ref: $('#vr').value, narration: $('#vn').value, lines };
  const ed = window.ev, r = await fetch('/api/vouchers' + (ed ? '/' + ed.id : ''), { method: ed ? 'PUT' : 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(body) });
  const j = await r.json(); if (!r.ok) return showErr(j.error);
  if (ed) { window.ev = null; setTab('daybook'); await load(); return toast('Updated ' + j.no + (j.saved ? '\nExcel refreshed: ' + j.saved : '')); }
  await load(); const out = body.date < FR() || body.date > TO(); $('#msg').innerHTML = `<span class="ok">Saved ${j.no}${j.saved ? ' → ' + esc(j.saved) : ''}</span>` + (out ? ' <span class="err">but its date is outside the From/To period at the top, so it will not show in reports until you change that period.</span>' : '');
}

export const voucher = () => {
  const ev = window.ev || {}; return `${window.ev ? `<div class="note">Editing <b>${esc(ev.no)}</b>. Saving updates the ledgers and reports. The voucher number and type stay the same.</div>` : ''}<div class="card"><div class="row">
   <label>Type<select id="vt" ${window.ev ? 'disabled' : ''}>${['Journal', 'Payment', 'Receipt', 'Purchase', 'Sales', 'Contra'].map(t => `<option ${t == ev.type ? 'selected' : ''}>${t}</option>`).join('')}</select></label>
   <label>Date (AD)<input type="date" id="vd" value="${ev.date || ymd()}"></label>
   <label>Date (BS, optional)<input id="vb" placeholder="2083-06-30" value="${esc(ev.bs)}"></label>
   <label>Bill / Ref no.<input id="vr" value="${esc(ev.ref)}"></label><label class="w4">Narration<input id="vn" value="${esc(ev.narration)}"></label></div></div>
   <div class="card"><div class="tw" style="margin-bottom:0"><table><thead><tr><th>Account</th><th class="n" style="width:170px">Debit</th><th class="n" style="width:170px">Credit</th><th style="width:44px"></th></tr></thead><tbody id="ls"></tbody></table></div>
   <div style="margin-top:14px"><button onclick="addLine()">+ Add line</button></div></div>
   <div class="bar"><span id="tot"></span><span class="sp"><span id="msg"></span> ${window.ev ? '<button onclick="window.ev=null;render()">Cancel</button> ' : ''}<button class="p" onclick="save()">${window.ev ? 'Update voucher' : 'Save voucher'}</button></span></div>`;
};

```css
/* styles/base.css — reset, body, links, inputs, buttons
   (split out of the old index.html <style> by migrate.js; load order: tokens → base → layout → components → pages) */

* {
  box-sizing: border-box
}

[hidden] {
  display: none !important
}

html {
  -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%;
  color-scheme: dark
}

body {
  margin: 0;
  font: 14px/1.55 var(--ui);
  background: var(--bg);
  color: var(--ink);
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased
}

::selection {
  background: #4D6BFE55;
  color: #fff
}

/* ---------- forms ---------- */

input,
select,
textarea,
button {
  font: inherit
}

input,
select,
textarea {
  padding: 8px 12px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 10px;
  background: var(--panel-2);
  color: var(--ink);
  min-height: 38px;
  width: 100%;
  transition: border-color .12s, box-shadow .12s, background .12s;
  color-scheme: dark
}

input::placeholder {
  color: #6B6B6B
}

input:hover,
select:hover {
  border-color: #3A3A3A
}

input:focus,
select:focus,
textarea:focus {
  outline: 0;
  border-color: var(--accent);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(77, 107, 254, .22);
  background: var(--panel)
}

:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--accent);
  outline-offset: 1px
}

input[type=checkbox] {
  width: 16px;
  height: 16px;
  min-height: 0;
  accent-color: var(--accent)
}

select {
  appearance: none;
  -webkit-appearance: none;
  padding-right: 32px;

## FILE: public/styles/layout.css

```css
/* styles/layout.css — app shell: sidebar, top bar, main, responsive layout
   (split out of the old index.html <style> by migrate.js; load order: tokens → base → layout → components → pages) */

.app {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 252px minmax(0, 1fr);
  min-height: 100vh
}

.app>div {
  min-width: 0
}

/* ---------- sidebar ---------- */

.side {
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  height: 100vh;
  overflow: auto;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  padding: 20px 12px 16px;
  color: var(--ink);
  background: var(--panel);
  border-right: 1px solid var(--line);
  scrollbar-width: thin;
  scrollbar-color: #333 transparent
}

.side::after {
  display: none
}

.brand {
  position: relative;
  padding: 0 10px 16px;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line)
}

.brand .short {
  display: none
}

.tog {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  right: 0;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: 30px;
  height: 30px;
  padding: 0;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: none;
  color: var(--mut);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background .12s, color .12s
}

.tog:hover {
  background: var(--hover);
  color: var(--ink)
}

.tog svg {
  width: 16px;
  height: 16px;
  fill: none;
  stroke: currentColor;
  stroke-width: 2;
  stroke-linecap: round;
  stroke-linejoin: round;
  transition: transform .18s
}

.brand .dev {
  font: 700 32px/1.15 var(--ui);
  color: var(--ink);
  letter-spacing: -.02em
}

.brand .lat {
  margin-top: 4px;
  font-size: 12.5px;
  color: var(--mut)
}

.side nav {
  flex: 1
}

.ng {
  margin: 18px 0 6px;
  padding: 0 10px;
  font-size: 11.5px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--mut);
  letter-spacing: .06em;
  text-transform: uppercase
}

.side nav button {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 11px;
  width: 100%;
  min-height: 38px;
  text-align: left;
  background: none;
  border: 0;
  border-radius: 10px;
  color: #C9C9C9;
  padding: 8px 10px;
  cursor: pointer;
  font: 500 14px var(--ui);
  transition: background .12s, color .12s
}

.side nav button svg {
  width: 18px;
  height: 18px;
  flex: none;
  fill: none;
  stroke: currentColor;
  stroke-width: 1.7;
  stroke-linecap: round;
  stroke-linejoin: round;
  opacity: .7;
  transition: opacity .12s
}

.side nav button:hover {
  background: var(--hover);
  color: var(--ink)
}

.side nav button.on {
  background: var(--accent-t);
  color: #fff;
  font-weight: 600
}

.side nav button.on svg {
  stroke: var(--accent-2);
  opacity: 1
}

.side :focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--accent);
  outline-offset: -2px
}

.co {
  margin-top: 14px;
  padding: 12px 10px 0;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 1.45;
  color: var(--mut)
}

.co b {
  display: block;
  color: var(--ink);
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 12.5px
}

/* ---------- top bar ---------- */

.top {
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  z-index: 5;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 16px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  min-height: var(--hdr);
  padding: 12px 28px;
  background: rgba(13, 13, 13, .82);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
  backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line)
}

.top h1 {
  margin: 0;
  font: 600 20px/1.2 var(--ui);
  letter-spacing: -.01em;
  color: var(--ink)
}

.top .tt p {
  margin: 2px 0 0;
  font-size: 13px;
  color: var(--mut)
}

.period {
  margin-left: auto;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 4px;
  padding: 3px 4px 3px 12px;
  background: var(--panel-2);
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 10px;
  font-size: 12.5px;
  color: var(--mut);
  transition: opacity .15s
}

.period.off {
  opacity: .4
}

.period input {
  width: auto;
  min-height: 28px;
  padding: 2px 6px;
  border: 0;
  background: transparent;
  font-size: 13px;
  color: var(--ink);
  border-radius: 6px;
  color-scheme: dark
}

.period input:focus {
  box-shadow: none;
  background: var(--hover)
}

.period select {
  width: auto;
  min-height: 28px;

  ['1040', 'TDS Receivable', 'A', 'Current Assets'], ['1050', 'VAT Receivable (Input VAT)', 'A', 'Current Assets'],

  ['1110', 'Computers & Equipment', 'A', 'Fixed Assets'], ['1190', 'Accumulated Depreciation', 'A', 'Fixed Assets'],
  ['2000', 'Sundry Creditors (Airlines/Hotels/Agents)', 'L', 'Current Liabilities'], ['2010', 'Customer Advances (Booking Deposits)', 'L', 'Current Liabilities'],
  ['2020', 'VAT Payable (Output VAT)', 'L', 'Current Liabilities'], ['2030', 'TDS Payable', 'L', 'Current Liabilities'],
  ['2040', 'Salary Payable', 'L', 'Current Liabilities'], ['2050', 'SSF/PF Payable', 'L', 'Current Liabilities'],
  ['2060', 'Accrued Expenses', 'L', 'Current Liabilities'], ['2100', 'Loan Payable', 'L', 'Long-term Liabilities'],
  ['3000', 'Share Capital', 'E', 'Equity'], ['3010', 'Retained Earnings', 'E', 'Equity'],
  ['4000', 'Tour Package Income', 'I', 'Income'], ['4010', 'Air Ticketing Commission', 'I', 'Income'],
  ['4020', 'Hotel Booking Commission', 'I', 'Income'], ['4030', 'Visa & Service Charges', 'I', 'Income'], ['4040', 'Other Income', 'I', 'Income'],
  ['5000', 'Hotel & Accommodation Cost', 'X', 'Direct Costs'], ['5010', 'Transport & Vehicle Hire', 'X', 'Direct Costs'],
  ['5020', 'Guide & Porter Fees', 'X', 'Direct Costs'], ['5030', 'Permits & Entry Fees', 'X', 'Direct Costs'],
  ['6000', 'Salary & Wages', 'X', 'Operating Expenses'], ['6010', 'Office Rent', 'X', 'Operating Expenses'],
  ['6020', 'Electricity & Water', 'X', 'Operating Expenses'], ['6030', 'Telephone & Internet', 'X', 'Operating Expenses'],
  ['6040', 'Marketing & Advertising', 'X', 'Operating Expenses'], ['6050', 'Office Expenses & Stationery', 'X', 'Operating Expenses'],
  ['6060', 'Bank Charges', 'X', 'Operating Expenses'], ['6070', 'Professional & Audit Fees', 'X', 'Operating Expenses'],
  ['6080', 'Depreciation', 'X', 'Operating Expenses'], ['6090', 'Travel & Meals', 'X', 'Operating Expenses']];

const EXTRA = []; // extra accounts to add to older data files (none now: purchase/sales accounts are created per category)

const rd = n => Math.round(n * 100) / 100;

const split = (nonTax, total) => { const g = total - nonTax, taxable = rd(g / 1.13); return { taxable, vat: rd(g - taxable) }; };

const party = (d, name, type, group, from) => {
  let a = d.accounts.find(x => x.group === group && x.name.toLowerCase() === name.toLowerCase());
  if (!a) { const code = String(Math.max(from - 1, ...d.accounts.filter(x => x.group === group).map(x => +x.code)) + 1); a = { code, name, type, group }; d.accounts.push(a); } return a.code;
};

const catName = c => String(c || 'Other').replace(/\s*(purchase|sales)\s*$/i, '').trim() || 'Other'; // "Hotel Purchase" -> "Hotel"

// ---- Excel files that belong to a record. They are rewritten when the record is edited and deleted with it. ----
const nkey = x => String(x || '').trim().toLowerCase();

const nextBankCode = d => { for (let c = 1011; c < 1020; c++) if (!d.accounts.some(a => a.code === String(c))) return String(c); return String(Math.max(...d.accounts.map(a => +a.code || 0).filter(c => c < 2000)) + 1); };

module.exports = { EXTRA, catName, nextBankCode, nkey, party, rd, seed, split };

```js
// server/banks.js — bank accounts, cheque-number formats, bank matching and splitting
// (split out of the old single-file server.js by migrate.js; code is unchanged)
const { rd } = require('./accounts');
const { splitCredits, splitNote } = require('./posting/payments');
const { loadDb } = require('./store');

// ---- Bank accounts: each one has its own ledger account, so every cheque shows which bank it was paid from. ----
// chequeFormat = the digits that never change on that bank's cheques, x = a digit that does, e.g. 7895xxxx. Several cheque books: separate with commas. Digits only (7895) = "starts with".
const fmtParts = f => String(f || '').split(/[,;]+/).map(x => x.toLowerCase().replace(/[\s-]/g, '').replace(/[#*?]/g, 'x')).filter(Boolean).map(s => ({ s, pre: !s.includes('x') }));

const fmtBad = f => fmtParts(f).some(p => !/^[0-9x]+$/.test(p.s) || !/\d/.test(p.s)) ? 'The cheque number format can only contain digits and x, for example 7895xxxx' : null;

const fmtHit = (p, run) => p.pre ? run.startsWith(p.s) : run.length === p.s.length && [...p.s].every((c, i) => c === 'x' || c === run[i]);

const fmtBoth = (a, b) => {
  if (!a.pre && !b.pre && a.s.length !== b.s.length) return false; if ((a.pre && !b.pre && b.s.length < a.s.length) || (b.pre && !a.pre && a.s.length < b.s.length)) return false;
  for (let i = 0, n = Math.min(a.s.length, b.s.length); i < n; i++) if (a.s[i] !== 'x' && b.s[i] !== 'x' && a.s[i] !== b.s[i]) return false; return true;
}; // could one cheque number fit both formats?

const banksFor = (banks, instr) => { const runs = String(instr || '').match(/\d+/g) || []; return banks.filter(b => fmtParts(b.chequeFormat).some(p => runs.some(r => fmtHit(p, r)))); }; // banks whose format fits a cheque number

const bankAcctName = n => /bank/i.test(n) ? n : 'Bank - ' + n; // "bank" in the name is what puts it in the Paid from lists

// Old cheque payments (payments made + salaries) whose cheque number fits exactly one bank's format. Ones already on a bank account chosen on purpose are only flagged, never moved.
function bankMatch(d) {
  const banks = loadDb().banks.filter(b => d.accounts.some(a => a.code === b.ledger)), chosen = new Set(banks.filter(b => !b.linked).map(b => b.ledger)), nmA = c => (d.accounts.find(a => a.code === c) || {}).name || c, out = { banks: banks.filter(b => fmtParts(b.chequeFormat).length).length, change: [], check: [], none: [] };
  if (!out.banks) return out;
  d.vouchers.filter(v => (v.pmt || v.sal) && (v.pmt || v.sal).mode === 'Cheque').sort((a, b) => a.date.localeCompare(b.date) || a.id - b.id).forEach(v => {
    const p = v.pmt || v.sal; if (p.splits || p.byStaff) return; const hit = banksFor(banks, p.instrument),
      row = { id: v.id, no: v.no, date: v.date, bs: v.bs || '', who: v.sal ? p.staff : p.other ? p.payee : p.supplier, cheque: p.instrument || '', amount: p.amount, from: nmA(p.account) };
    if (hit.length === 1) { if (p.account === hit[0].ledger) return; if (chosen.has(p.account)) out.check.push({ ...row, note: 'Recorded as ' + row.from + ', but the number fits ' + hit[0].name }); else out.change.push({ ...row, to: nmA(hit[0].ledger), toCode: hit[0].ledger }); }
    else if (hit.length > 1) out.check.push({ ...row, note: banksFor(banks, p.instrument).length > 1 && chqRuns(p.instrument).length > 1 && chqRuns(p.instrument).every(r => banksFor(banks, r).length === 1) ? 'Cheques from different banks in one payment: use “Split old payments made with several cheques” below' : 'The number fits more than one bank format' });
    else if (!chosen.has(p.account)) out.none.push({ ...row, note: p.instrument ? 'No bank format fits this number' : 'No cheque number recorded' });
  });
  return out;
}

// ---- Old payments made where ONE voucher holds several cheque numbers that belong to different banks (e.g. "7895001, 4410002").
// splitScan lists them (cheque -> bank by the formats above); the person types each cheque's amount; splitApply turns the voucher into a split payment (one credit line per bank, totals unchanged). ----
const chqRuns = s => [...new Set(String(s || '').match(/\d+/g) || [])];

function splitScan(d) {
  const banks = loadDb().banks.filter(b => d.accounts.some(a => a.code === b.ledger) && fmtParts(b.chequeFormat).length), nmA = c => (d.accounts.find(a => a.code === c) || {}).name || c, out = { banks: banks.length, rows: [], check: [] };
  if (!banks.length) return out;
  d.vouchers.filter(v => v.pmt && !v.pmt.splits && !v.pmt.byStaff && v.pmt.mode === 'Cheque').sort((a, b) => a.date.localeCompare(b.date) || a.id - b.id).forEach(v => {
    const p = v.pmt, runs = chqRuns(p.instrument); if (runs.length < 2) return;
    const hits = runs.map(r => ({ r, b: banksFor(banks, r) })), ok = hits.filter(h => h.b.length === 1);
    if (new Set(ok.map(h => h.b[0].ledger)).size < 2) return; // fewer than two banks recognised: not a multi-bank payment (the match tool above deals with single-bank ones)
    const row = { id: v.id, no: v.no, date: v.date, bs: v.bs || '', who: p.other ? p.payee : p.supplier, ref: p.instrument || '', total: p.amount, from: nmA(p.account), parts: ok.map(h => ({ cheque: h.r, ledger: h.b[0].ledger, bank: h.b[0].name })) };
    const cr = v.lines.filter(l => l.cr > 0);
    if (ok.length !== hits.length) out.check.push({ ...row, note: 'Cheque no. ' + hits.filter(h => h.b.length !== 1).map(h => h.r).join(', ') + ' fits no bank format (or more than one); add its format above or split by hand' });
    else if (!(cr.length === 1 && cr[0].account === p.account && Math.abs(cr[0].cr - p.amount) < .005)) out.check.push({ ...row, note: 'The voucher lines were changed by hand; edit this payment and add the cheques yourself' });
    else out.rows.push(row);

}

function splitPlan(d, items) {
  const scan = splitScan(d), plan = []; // validates everything first; nothing is changed here
  for (const it of items) {
    const row = scan.rows.find(r => r.id === it.id); if (!row) return { error: 'A payment in the list can no longer be split (it was changed or already split). Check again.' };
    const parts = row.parts.map(pt => { const g = (it.parts || []).find(y => String(y.cheque) === pt.cheque); return { account: pt.ledger, instrument: pt.cheque, amount: rd(+(g && g.amount) || 0) }; });

    const sum = rd(parts.reduce((t, y) => t + y.amount, 0)); if (Math.abs(sum - row.total) > .004) return { error: `The cheques of ${row.no} add up to ${sum.toFixed(2)} but the payment is ${row.total.toFixed(2)}` };
    plan.push({ row, parts });
  }

function splitApply(d, plan) {

    const v = d.vouchers.find(y => y.id === row.id), p = v.pmt, i = v.lines.findIndex(l => l.cr > 0 && l.account === p.account);

  }); // only the credit side is rebuilt; the supplier/charge side, amounts and dates stay

}

// server/excel/statements.js — trial balance / income statement / balance sheet and party statements
// (split out of the old single-file server.js by migrate.js; code is unchanged)
const { nkey, rd } = require('../accounts');
const { frame, fx, getExcelJS, put } = require('./workbook');
const { payables } = require('../posting/payables');
const { receivables } = require('../posting/receivables');
const { COMPANY } = require('../settings');
const { loadDb } = require('../store');

// ---- Financial statements to Excel (tb = Trial Balance, pl = Income Statement, bs = Balance Sheet) ----
const bal = (d, a, from, to) => { const bs = 'ALE'.includes(a.type); let s = 0; for (const v of d.vouchers) if (v.date <= to && (bs || v.date >= from)) for (const l of v.lines) if (l.account === a.code) s += l.dr - l.cr; return rd(s); };

const priorPL = (d, from) => rd(d.vouchers.filter(v => v.date < from).reduce((t, v) => t + v.lines.reduce((u, l) => { const a = d.accounts.find(x => x.code === l.account); return a && 'IX'.includes(a.type) ? u + l.dr - l.cr : u; }, 0), 0));

function sec(s, st, title, list, sign, extra = []) {
  put(s, 'A' + st.r, title, { b: 1 }); st.r++; const first = st.r; let tot = 0;
  [...new Set(list.map(a => a.group))].forEach(g => {
    const rows = list.filter(a => a.group === g).map(a => ({ c: a.code, n: a.name, v: sign * bal(st.d, a, st.from, st.to) })).filter(x => x.v); if (!rows.length) return;
    put(s, 'B' + st.r, g, { b: 1 }); st.r++; rows.forEach(x => { put(s, 'A' + st.r, x.c); put(s, 'B' + st.r, x.n); put(s, 'D' + st.r, x.v, { n: 1 }); tot += x.v; st.r++; });
  });
  extra.forEach(x => { put(s, 'B' + st.r, x.n); put(s, 'D' + st.r, x.v, { n: 1 }); tot += x.v; st.r++; });
  const t = st.r; put(s, 'B' + t, 'Total ' + title, { b: 1 }); fx(s, 'E' + t, `SUM(D${first}:D${t - 1})`, tot, 1); st.r += 2; return { cell: 'E' + t, v: rd(tot) };
}

  v.lines.forEach(l => { put(s, 'A' + r, ++n); put(s, 'B' + r, (l.cr ? '      ' : '') + (l.desc || nm(l.account))); if (l.dr) put(s, 'D' + r, l.dr, { n: 1 }); if (l.cr) put(s, 'E' + r, l.cr, { n: 1 }); r++; });
  (v.notes || []).forEach(x => { put(s, 'B' + r, '      ' + x); r++; });

  s.mergeCells(`A${t + 1}:E${t + 1}`); put(s, 'A' + (t + 1), 'Rs. in words: ' + words(sum('dr'))); s.mergeCells(`A${t + 2}:E${t + 2}`); put(s, 'A' + (t + 2), 'Details: ' + (v.narration || '') + (v.ref ? ' (Ref ' + v.ref + ')' : ''), { w: 1 });

// server/excel/workbook.js — shared Excel building blocks: frame(), put(), box(), fx(), words()
// (split out of the old single-file server.js by migrate.js; code is unchanged)
const { rd } = require('../accounts');
const { COMPANY } = require('../settings');

// exceljs is loaded the first time an Excel file is made, so the app still starts without it installed.
let _ExcelJS;
const getExcelJS = () => _ExcelJS || (_ExcelJS = require('exceljs'));

const W = ['', 'One', 'Two', 'Three', 'Four', 'Five', 'Six', 'Seven', 'Eight', 'Nine', 'Ten', 'Eleven', 'Twelve', 'Thirteen', 'Fourteen', 'Fifteen', 'Sixteen', 'Seventeen', 'Eighteen', 'Nineteen'];

const TY = ['', '', 'Twenty', 'Thirty', 'Forty', 'Fifty', 'Sixty', 'Seventy', 'Eighty', 'Ninety'];

const w = n => n < 20 ? W[n] : n < 100 ? TY[n / 10 | 0] + ' ' + W[n % 10] : [[1e7, 'Crore'], [1e5, 'Lakh'], [1e3, 'Thousand'], [100, 'Hundred']].filter(([v]) => n >= v).slice(0, 1).map(([v, t]) => (w(n / v | 0) + ' ' + t + ' ' + w(n % v))).join('');

const words = n => { const r = Math.floor(n), p = Math.round((n - r) * 100); return ('Rupees ' + w(r) + (p ? ' and ' + w(p) + ' Paisa' : '') + ' only').replace(/\s+/g, ' '); };

function frame(title, co = COMPANY) {
  const ExcelJS = getExcelJS(); const wb = new ExcelJS.Workbook(), s = wb.addWorksheet(title); s.columns = [{ width: 9 }, { width: 44 }, { width: 14 }, { width: 18 }, { width: 18 }];
  const m = (r, t, b, size) => { s.mergeCells(`A${r}:E${r}`); const c = s.getCell('A' + r); c.value = t; c.alignment = { horizontal: 'center', wrapText: true }; c.font = { bold: !!b, size: size || 10 }; };
  m(1, co.name, 1, 16); m(2, `${co.addr} | Tel: ${co.tel} | ${co.email}`); m(3, 'VAT No.: ' + (co.vat || '________')); m(4, title.toUpperCase(), 1, 13); return { wb, s };
}

const put = (s, a, v, o = {}) => { const c = s.getCell(a); c.value = v; if (o.b) c.font = { bold: true }; if (o.n) { c.numFmt = '#,##0.00'; c.alignment = { horizontal: 'right' }; } if (o.w) c.alignment = { wrapText: true, vertical: 'top' }; };

const box = (s, r1, r2) => { for (let r = r1; r <= r2; r++) for (const c of 'ABCDE') s.getCell(c + r).border = { top: { style: 'thin' }, bottom: { style: 'thin' }, left: { style: 'thin' }, right: { style: 'thin' } }; };

const fx = (s, a, formula, result, bold) => { const c = s.getCell(a); c.value = { formula, result: rd(result) }; c.numFmt = '#,##0.00'; if (bold) c.font = { bold: true }; };

module.exports = { box, frame, fx, getExcelJS, put, words };

// server/files.js — Excel files in the storage folder: ownership, auto-save, rewrite, delete, rebuild
// (split out of the old single-file server.js by migrate.js; code is unchanged)
const fs = require('fs'), path = require('path');
const { invoiceXlsx, purchaseBillXlsx } = require('./excel/invoice');
const { jvXlsx } = require('./excel/voucher');
const { DB, loadSet } = require('./store');

// ---- Which copy of the app owns the storage folder. A marker file (.owner) holds the path of the data.json that uses the folder; a second copy of the project
// (same settings.json, different location) is refused write access, so it cannot overwrite or delete the first copy's Excel files. ----
const OWNER_F = '.owner';

const ownerState = root => { root = root === undefined ? loadSet().folder : root; if (!root) return { ok: true }; try { const m = path.join(path.resolve(root), OWNER_F); if (!fs.existsSync(m)) return { ok: true, fresh: true }; const o = fs.readFileSync(m, 'utf8').trim(); return o === path.resolve(DB) ? { ok: true } : { ok: false, owner: o }; } catch { return { ok: true }; } };

const claimFolder = root => { try { fs.writeFileSync(path.join(path.resolve(root), OWNER_F), path.resolve(DB)); } catch (e) { console.log('Could not mark the storage folder:', e.message); } };

const canWrite = () => { const s = ownerState(); if (s.fresh) claimFolder(loadSet().folder); if (!s.ok) console.log('The storage folder belongs to another copy of the app (' + s.owner + '): not writing files there.'); return s.ok; };

const store = (sub, name, buf) => { if (!canWrite()) throw new Error('the storage folder belongs to another copy of the app'); const dir = path.join(loadSet().folder, sub); fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true }); const p = path.join(dir, name); fs.writeFileSync(p, Buffer.from(buf)); return p; };

const autoStore = (key, sub, name, buf) => { try { const s = loadSet(); return s.folder && s.auto[key] ? store(sub, name, buf) : null; } catch (e) { console.log('Auto-save failed:', e.message); return null; } };

const autoSaveVoucher = async (v, d) => { const k = vkey(v); if (!k) return null; try { return autoStore(k[0], k[1], v.no + '.xlsx', await jvXlsx(v, d).xlsx.writeBuffer()); } catch (e) { console.log('Auto-save failed:', e.message); return null; } };

const autoSaveInvoice = async b => { try { return autoStore('sv', 'SV', 'Invoice_' + String(b.billNo).replace(/[^\w.-]/g, '_') + '.xlsx', await invoiceXlsx(b).xlsx.writeBuffer()); } catch (e) { console.log('Auto-save failed:', e.message); return null; } };

const vkey = v => v.type === 'Sales' ? ['sv', 'SV'] : v.type === 'Journal' ? ['jv', 'JV'] : v.type === 'Receipt' ? ['rv', 'RV'] : v.type === 'Payment' ? ['pmv', 'PMV'] : null; // which switch/folder a voucher's Excel goes to

const autoSaveBill = async b => { try { return autoStore('pv', 'PV', 'PurchaseBill_' + String(b.billNo).replace(/[^\w.-]/g, '_') + '.xlsx', await purchaseBillXlsx(b).xlsx.writeBuffer()); } catch (e) { console.log('Auto-save failed:', e.message); return null; } };

const safeName = x => String(x).replace(/[^\w.-]/g, '_');

const vFile = v => { const k = vkey(v); return { key: k ? k[0] : 'jv', sub: k ? k[1] : 'JV', name: safeName(v.no) + '.xlsx' }; };

const bFile = b => b.kind === 'purchase' ? { key: 'pv', sub: 'PV', name: 'PurchaseBill_' + safeName(b.billNo) + '.xlsx' } : { key: 'sv', sub: 'SV', name: 'Invoice_' + safeName(b.billNo) + '.xlsx' };

const folderPath = (sub, name) => { const root = loadSet().folder; if (!root || !canWrite()) return null; const r = path.resolve(root), p = path.resolve(r, sub, name); return p.startsWith(r + path.sep) ? p : null; };

const rmFile = (sub, name) => { try { const p = folderPath(sub, name); if (p && fs.existsSync(p)) { fs.unlinkSync(p); return p; } } catch (e) { console.log('Could not delete file:', e.message); } return null; };

const dropVoucher = v => [...new Set([vFile(v).sub, 'JV', ...(v.type === 'Payment' ? ['PV'] : [])])].map(sub => rmFile(sub, vFile(v).name)).filter(Boolean); // JV folder too: older downloads of other voucher types landed there

const dropBill = b => [rmFile(bFile(b).sub, bFile(b).name)].filter(Boolean);

// Rewrite a file after an edit: if it already exists it is refreshed; otherwise it is only created when the auto-save switch is on (and onlyIfExists is false)
const refresh = async (f, make, onlyIfExists) => { try { const p = folderPath(f.sub, f.name); if (p && fs.existsSync(p)) { fs.writeFileSync(p, Buffer.from(await make())); return p; } return onlyIfExists ? null : autoStore(f.key, f.sub, f.name, await make()); } catch (e) { console.log('Auto-save failed:', e.message); return null; } };

const resaveVoucher = async (v, d) => { const r = await refresh(vFile(v), async () => jvXlsx(v, d).xlsx.writeBuffer(), !vkey(v) || d.bills.some(b => b.voucherId === v.id && b.kind === 'sales')); if (v.type === 'Payment') rmFile('PV', vFile(v).name); return r; }; // payment vouchers used to live in PV

const resaveBill = b => refresh(bFile(b), async () => (b.kind === 'purchase' ? purchaseBillXlsx(b) : invoiceXlsx(b)).xlsx.writeBuffer());

// ---- Rebuild the Excel files of vouchers and bills from data.json (for example after another copy of the app overwrote them) ----
async function rebuildFiles(d, createMissing, from) {
  const s = loadSet(); if (!s.folder) return { error: 'Set a storage folder first' }; if (!ownerState().ok) return { error: 'This storage folder belongs to another copy of the app. Save settings and take it over first.' };
  let vouchers = 0, bills = 0; const known = new Set();
  for (const v of d.vouchers) {
    const f = vFile(v); known.add(f.sub + '/' + f.name); if (from && v.date < from) continue; const only = !createMissing || !vkey(v) || d.bills.some(b => b.voucherId === v.id && b.kind === 'sales');
    if (await refresh(f, async () => jvXlsx(v, d).xlsx.writeBuffer(), only)) vouchers++;
  }
  for (const b of d.bills) { const f = bFile(b); known.add(f.sub + '/' + f.name); if (from && b.date < from) continue; if (await refresh(f, async () => (b.kind === 'purchase' ? purchaseBillXlsx(b) : invoiceXlsx(b)).xlsx.writeBuffer(), !createMissing)) bills++; }
  const orphans = []; for (const sub of ['JV', 'PV', 'PMV', 'SV', 'RV']) { try { fs.readdirSync(path.join(path.resolve(s.folder), sub)).forEach(n => { if (/^[A-Z]+-\d+\.xlsx$/i.test(n) && !known.has(sub + '/' + n)) orphans.push(sub + '/' + n); }); } catch { } }
  return { vouchers, bills, orphans: orphans.slice(0, 60), orphanCount: orphans.length };
}

const pvToPmv = d => { const out = []; d.vouchers.filter(v => v.type === 'Payment').forEach(v => { const a = folderPath('PV', safeName(v.no) + '.xlsx'), b = folderPath('PMV', safeName(v.no) + '.xlsx'); if (a && b && fs.existsSync(a) && !fs.existsSync(b)) out.push([a, b]); }); return out; };

module.exports = { autoSaveBill, autoSaveInvoice, autoSaveVoucher, autoStore, claimFolder, dropBill, dropVoucher, ownerState, pvToPmv, rebuildFiles, refresh, resaveBill, resaveVoucher, safeName, vFile, vkey };

// server/http.js — HTTP helpers: send(), readBody(), serveStatic()
// (split out of the old single-file server.js by migrate.js; code is unchanged)
const fs = require('fs'), path = require('path');

const send = (res, c, o) => { res.writeHead(c, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }); res.end(JSON.stringify(o)); };

// Reads a request body (same behaviour as the old inline req.on('data') loop).
const readBody = req => new Promise(resolve => { let b = ''; req.on('data', c => b += c); req.on('end', () => resolve(b)); });

// Static files from ./public. Anything that is not a real file inside public/ gets the app shell (index.html),
// exactly as the old single-file server answered every non-API URL.
const PUBLIC = path.join(__dirname, '..', 'public');
const MIME = { '.html': 'text/html; charset=utf-8', '.js': 'text/javascript; charset=utf-8', '.mjs': 'text/javascript; charset=utf-8', '.css': 'text/css; charset=utf-8', '.json': 'application/json; charset=utf-8', '.svg': 'image/svg+xml', '.png': 'image/png', '.jpg': 'image/jpeg', '.jpeg': 'image/jpeg', '.gif': 'image/gif', '.webp': 'image/webp', '.ico': 'image/x-icon', '.woff': 'font/woff', '.woff2': 'font/woff2', '.map': 'application/json', '.txt': 'text/plain; charset=utf-8' };
function serveStatic(res, u) {
  let rel; try { rel = decodeURIComponent(u); } catch { rel = '/'; }
  const file = path.resolve(PUBLIC, '.' + rel), inside = file.startsWith(PUBLIC + path.sep);
  if (inside && fs.existsSync(file) && fs.statSync(file).isFile()) {
    res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': MIME[path.extname(file).toLowerCase()] || 'application/octet-stream' });
    return res.end(fs.readFileSync(file));
  }
  res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'text/html' });
  return res.end(fs.readFileSync(path.join(PUBLIC, 'index.html')));
}

module.exports = { readBody, send, serveStatic };
```

// server/posting/lines.js — voucher numbering and posting: cleanLines(), PFX, post(), resync()
// (split out of the old single-file server.js by migrate.js; code is unchanged)

const post = (d, type, date, bs, ref, narration, lines) => {
  const p = PFX[type]; d.seq[p] = (d.seq[p] || 0) + 1;
  const v = { type, date, bs, ref, narration, lines: lines.filter(l => l.dr || l.cr), no: p + '-' + String(d.seq[p]).padStart(4, '0'), id: Date.now() + d.vouchers.length }; d.vouchers.push(v); return v;
};

// After deletions, numbering continues from the highest remaining number (so deleting the latest entries frees their numbers)
const resync = d => { const m = {}; d.vouchers.forEach(v => { const [p, n] = v.no.split('-'); m[p] = Math.max(m[p] || 0, +n); }); Object.values(PFX).forEach(p => { d.seq[p] = m[p] || 0; }); d.seq.SB = d.bills.filter(b => b.kind === 'sales').reduce((a, b) => Math.max(a, parseInt(b.billNo) || 0), 0); };

// ---- Shared validation / posting rules, used by both "create" and "edit" ----
function cleanLines(d, raw) {
  const lines = (raw || []).filter(l => l.account && (+l.dr || +l.cr)).map(l => ({ account: l.account, dr: +l.dr || 0, cr: +l.cr || 0 }));
  if (lines.length < 2) return { error: 'At least two lines needed' };

// server/posting/payables.js — per-supplier payables picture
// (split out of the old single-file server.js by migrate.js; code is unchanged)
const { nkey, rd } = require('../accounts');
const { loadDb } = require('../store');

// Per-supplier picture for the Payments made page (same idea as receivables()): the statement is the supplier's ledger account,
// each purchase bill's paid/due comes from the payments: those tied to a bill go to it, the rest are applied to the oldest bills first.
function payables(d) {
  const db = loadDb(), map = new Map(), get = n => { const k = nkey(n); if (!k) return null; if (!map.has(k)) map.set(k, { name: String(n).trim(), pan: '', bills: [], pmts: [] }); return map.get(k); };
  db.parties.filter(p => p.type !== 'customer').forEach(p => { const c = get(p.name); if (c) c.pan = p.pan || ''; });
  d.bills.forEach(x => { if (x.kind !== 'purchase') return; const c = get(x.supplier); if (!c) return; c.bills.push(x); if (!c.pan) c.pan = x.supplierPan || ''; });
  d.vouchers.filter(v => v.pmt && !v.pmt.other).forEach(v => get(v.pmt.supplier).pmts.push(v));
  const vs = d.vouchers.slice().sort((a, b) => a.date.localeCompare(b.date) || a.id - b.id);
  return [...map.values()].map(c => {
    const acct = d.accounts.find(a => a.group === 'Sundry Creditors' && nkey(a.name) === nkey(c.name)); let bal = 0, billed = 0, paidAmt = 0, hand = 0; const statement = [];
    if (acct) vs.forEach(v => v.lines.filter(l => l.account === acct.code).forEach(l => {
      bal = rd(bal + l.cr - l.dr); billed += l.cr; paidAmt += l.dr; if (!v.pmt && !d.bills.some(x => x.voucherId === v.id)) hand += l.dr; // debits made by hand also count as money paid
      statement.push({ date: v.date, bs: v.bs, no: v.no, vid: v.id, type: v.type, ref: v.ref, narration: v.narration, cr: l.cr, dr: l.dr, bal, pmt: !!v.pmt, billId: (d.bills.find(x => x.voucherId === v.id) || {}).id });
    }));
    const bills = c.bills.slice().sort((a, b) => a.date.localeCompare(b.date) || String(a.billNo).localeCompare(String(b.billNo), undefined, { numeric: true })), paid = new Map(bills.map(x => [x.id, 0])); let free = hand;
    c.pmts.forEach(v => { const amt = v.pmt.amount, id = v.pmt.billId; if (id != null && paid.has(id)) paid.set(id, paid.get(id) + amt); else free += amt; });
    bills.forEach(x => { const over = paid.get(x.id) - x.total; if (over > 0) { free += over; paid.set(x.id, x.total); } });
    bills.forEach(x => { const take = Math.min(free, rd(x.total - paid.get(x.id))); if (take > 0) { paid.set(x.id, rd(paid.get(x.id) + take)); free = rd(free - take); } });
    return {
      name: c.name, pan: c.pan, billed: rd(billed), paid: rd(paidAmt), balance: bal, advance: rd(free), statement,
      bills: bills.map(x => { const pd = rd(paid.get(x.id)), due = rd(x.total - pd); return { id: x.id, billNo: x.billNo, date: x.date, bs: x.bs, voucher: x.voucher, total: x.total, paid: pd, due, status: due <= .004 ? 'Paid' : pd > .004 ? 'Partial' : 'Unpaid' }; })
    };
  })
    .sort((a, b) => a.name.toLowerCase().localeCompare(b.name.toLowerCase()));
}

module.exports = { payables };

// server/posting/payments.js — payments made to suppliers, cheque splits
// (split out of the old single-file server.js by migrate.js; code is unchanged)
const { nkey, party, rd } = require('../accounts');

const { purchaseBad } = require('./purchase');
const { loadDb } = require('../store');

// ---- One payment by several cheques (maybe from different banks): pmt.splits = [{ account, instrument, amount }, ...]. pmt.account / pmt.instrument stay as the first cheque's / all cheque numbers
// so older screens keep working; the voucher gets one credit line per bank account. ----
function chequeSplits(d, x, mode, amt, acct, ref) {
  if (!Array.isArray(x.more) || !x.more.length) return {};
  if (mode !== 'Cheque') return { error: 'More than one cheque can only be used when the mode is Cheque' };
  const extra = []; for (const m of x.more) {
    const a = d.accounts.find(y => y.code === String(m.account) && y.type === 'A'), n = rd(+m.amount || 0);
    if (!a) return { error: 'Choose the bank account for every extra cheque' }; if (n <= 0) return { error: 'Enter an amount for every extra cheque' };
    extra.push({ account: a.code, instrument: String(m.instrument || '').trim(), amount: n });
  }
  const first = rd(amt - extra.reduce((t, y) => t + y.amount, 0));
  if (first <= 0.004) return { error: 'The extra cheques add up to the whole payment (or more), so nothing is left for the first cheque' };
  return { splits: [{ account: acct.code, instrument: ref, amount: first }, ...extra] };
}

const splitCredits = (d, splits) => { const by = new Map(); splits.forEach(y => by.set(y.account, rd((by.get(y.account) || 0) + y.amount))); return [...by].map(([account, cr]) => ({ account, dr: 0, cr, desc: (d.accounts.find(a => a.code === account) || {}).name || account })); }; // one credit line per bank account

const splitNote = (d, splits) => ' (' + splits.map(y => (y.instrument || 'no cheque no.') + ' ' + ((d.accounts.find(a => a.code === y.account) || {}).name || y.account) + ' ' + y.amount.toFixed(2)).join('; ') + ')';

// A payment can be for any amount (part of a bill, several bills, or more than is owed). If the payee is not a recorded supplier,
// it is charged to whichever account is chosen instead (Advance to Suppliers, an expense, etc.) and marked `other`.

  const amt = rd(+x.amount || 0), payee = String(x.payee || '').trim(), paidBy = String(x.paidBy || '').trim(),
    stf = x.byStaff ? loadDb().staff.find(s => nkey(s.name) === nkey(x.byStaff)) : null;
  if (x.byStaff && paidBy) return { error: 'Choose either Paid by staff / CEO or Paid by staff (own money), not both' };
  if (x.byStaff && !(stf && stf.ledger && d.accounts.some(a => a.code === stf.ledger))) return { error: 'That staff member has no ledger account linked. Link one under Salary payment > Staff details.' };
  const acct = stf ? d.accounts.find(a => a.code === stf.ledger) : paidBy ? { code: party(d, 'Due to ' + paidBy, 'L', 'Staff Payables', 2300), name: 'Due to ' + paidBy } : d.accounts.find(a => a.code === x.account && a.type === 'A');
  let sup = String(x.supplier || '').trim(), dr = null;
  if (x.debitAccount) { dr = d.accounts.find(a => a.code === String(x.debitAccount)); if (!dr) return { error: 'The account to charge no longer exists' }; if (dr.group === 'Sundry Creditors') { sup = dr.name; dr = null; } }
  if (!x.date || amt <= 0) return { error: 'Date and an amount above zero are required' };
  if (!acct) return { error: 'Choose the cash or bank account the money was paid from' };
  const mode = MODES.includes(x.mode) ? x.mode : 'Cash', ref = String(x.instrument || '').trim(), note = String(x.note || '').trim();
  const fee = mode === 'Fonepay' ? rd(Math.max(+x.fee || 0, 0)) : 0, pf = mode === 'Fonepay' ? { fee } : {}, fn = (fee ? ' (Fonepay charge ' + fee + ')' : '') + (paidBy ? ' - paid by ' + paidBy + ' (company owes ' + paidBy + ')' : ''), out = rd(amt + fee),
    feeL = fee ? [{ account: party(d, 'Fonepay Charges', 'X', 'Operating Expenses', 6000), dr: fee, cr: 0, desc: 'Fonepay charge' }] : []; // the charge is our expense; the supplier still receives the full amount
  if ((paidBy || stf) && Array.isArray(x.more) && x.more.length) return { error: 'A payment made by staff cannot be split over several cheques' };
  const sp = stf ? {} : chequeSplits(d, x, mode, amt, acct, ref); if (sp.error) return sp; // one payment by several cheques / banks: x.more = the cheques after the first
  const crL = sp.splits ? splitCredits(d, sp.splits) : [{ account: acct.code, dr: 0, cr: out, desc: acct.name }], sn = sp.splits ? splitNote(d, sp.splits) : (stf ? ' (paid by ' + stf.name + ')' : ''), instr = sp.splits ? sp.splits.map(y => y.instrument).filter(Boolean).join(', ') : ref, spf = sp.splits ? { splits: sp.splits } : {};

      narration: `Paid to ${payee} by ${mode}${sn}${fn} - charged to ${dr.name}` + (note ? ' - ' + note : ''),
      lines: [{ account: dr.code, dr: net, cr: 0, desc: payee }, ...vatL, ...feeL, ...crL]
    };
  }
  if (x.inv && (x.inv.billNo || x.inv.supplierPan || +x.inv.taxable)) return { error: 'Tax invoice details are only for payments charged to an expense or asset account. For a supplier bill, enter the bill on the Bills page so its VAT is claimed there' };
  if (!sup) return { error: 'Choose a supplier, or choose another account to charge' };
  const bill = x.billId ? d.bills.find(y => String(y.id) === String(x.billId) && y.kind === 'purchase') : null;
  if (bill && nkey(bill.supplier) !== nkey(sup)) return { error: 'That bill belongs to a different supplier' };
  const cid = party(d, sup, 'L', 'Sundry Creditors', 2200), name = d.accounts.find(a => a.code === cid).name;
  return {
    pmt: { supplier: name, ...(payee ? { payee } : {}), ...(paidBy ? { paidBy } : {}), ...(stf ? { byStaff: stf.name } : {}), mode, instrument: instr, billId: bill ? bill.id : null, account: acct.code, amount: amt, note, ...pf, ...spf },
    narration: `Paid to ${name}${payee && nkey(payee) !== nkey(name) ? ' (via ' + payee + ')' : ''} by ${mode}${sn}${fn}` + (bill ? ' against bill ' + bill.billNo : '') + (note ? ' - ' + note : ''),
    lines: [{ account: cid, dr: amt, cr: 0, desc: name }, ...feeL, ...crL]
  };
}

// server/posting/purchase.js — purchase bill validation and posting
// (split out of the old single-file server.js by migrate.js; code is unchanged)
const { catName, party, rd } = require('../accounts');

const { PAN_RE, BS_RE } = require('./vatrules');

const RO_CODE = '9991'; // existing Round Off ledger account

const purchaseBad = p => {
  const nonTax = +p.nonTax || 0, taxable = +p.taxable || 0, vat = +p.vat || 0, roundOff = rd(+p.roundOff || 0), total = rd(nonTax + taxable + vat + roundOff), pan = String(p.supplierPan || '').trim();
  if (!p.supplier || !p.billNo || !p.date || total <= 0) return 'Supplier, bill no., date and amounts are required';
  if (nonTax < 0 || taxable < 0 || vat < 0) return 'Amounts cannot be negative';
  if (Math.abs(roundOff) > 10) return 'Round off looks too large (more than 10). Check the amount';
  if (p.bs && !BS_RE.test(String(p.bs).trim())) return 'Date (BS) must look like 2083-07-15 (year-month-day)';
  if (pan && !PAN_RE.test(pan)) return 'Supplier PAN/VAT no. must be 9 digits';
  if (vat > 0 && !pan) return 'Supplier PAN/VAT no. is required when the bill has VAT, otherwise the VAT cannot be claimed (VAT Act s.17(6), s.10(6))';
  if (vat > 0 && taxable <= 0) return 'The bill has VAT but no taxable amount';
  if (taxable > 0 && Math.abs(vat - rd(taxable * 0.13)) > 1) return `VAT on the bill (${vat}) does not match 13% of the taxable amount (${rd(taxable * 0.13)}). Check the amounts against the supplier's invoice (VAT Act s.7)`;
  return null;
};

function purchaseParts(d, p) {
  const nonTax = +p.nonTax || 0, taxable = +p.taxable || 0, vat = +p.vat || 0, roundOff = rd(+p.roundOff || 0), total = rd(nonTax + taxable + vat + roundOff), cat = catName(p.category),
  pacc = party(d, cat + ' Purchase', 'X', 'Direct Costs', 5100), sup = party(d, p.supplier.trim(), 'L', 'Sundry Creditors', 2200);
  if (roundOff && !d.accounts.some(a => a.code === RO_CODE)) d.accounts.push({ code: RO_CODE, name: 'Round Off', type: 'X', group: 'Operating Expenses' }); // only if missing in this data file
  return {
    nonTax, taxable, vat, roundOff, total, cat, heading: cat + ' Purchase', notes: ['bill no. ' + p.billNo].concat(p.passenger ? [p.passenger] : []),
    narration: `${cat} Purchase - ${p.supplier} bill no. ${p.billNo}` + (p.passenger ? ' - ' + p.passenger : ''),

[{ account: RO_CODE, dr: roundOff > 0 ? roundOff : 0, cr: roundOff < 0 ? -roundOff : 0, desc: 'Round off' }] : []), { account: sup, dr: 0, cr: total, desc: p.supplier }].filter(l => l.dr || l.cr)

```js
// server/posting/purchasebook.js — what goes in the purchase register besides purchase bills
// Rule (Deepak sir, Nov 2026): only VAT bills go in the purchase register, with one exception: FUEL paid from the Payments made page may be added to it
// after review, even without a VAT no. or bill no. (the VAT is worked out by us as 13/113 of the amount paid). Every other payment with no invoice stays out.

// Accounts that are NOT purchases of goods/services even though they are debited by a payment:
// salary (6000), bank charges (6060, exempt financial service), depreciation (6080, not cash), accumulated depreciation (1190)
const NOT_PURCHASE = ['6000', '6060', '6080', '1190'];

// Eligible = expenses, fixed assets and prepaid expenses. Advances to suppliers, tax receivable, loans, creditors etc. are not purchases.
const eligible = a => !!a && !NOT_PURCHASE.includes(a.code) && (a.type === 'X' || a.group === 'Fixed Assets' || a.code === '1060');

// Fuel is found from the expense account name, the payee or the note
const FUEL = /fuel|petrol|diesel|तेल|इन्धन/i;
const isFuel = (a, v) => !!a && FUEL.test([a.name, v.pmt.payee, v.pmt.note].join(' '));

// The VAT hidden inside a VAT-inclusive total (13/113). Shown for review only: nothing is claimed from it.
const vatInTotal = amt => Math.round((+amt || 0) * 13 / 113 * 100) / 100;

// Why a payment made without an invoice is left out of the purchase register (every such payment is left out)
function leftOutReason(a, v) {
  if (!eligible(a)) return 'Not a purchase of goods or services (salary, bank charges, depreciation, advances, tax, loans etc.)';
  if (isFuel(a, v)) return 'Fuel with no VAT bill or bill no.: review it, then add it to the purchase book';
  return 'No invoice: payments made without an invoice are not in the purchase book';
}

// null = a proper VAT bill; otherwise what is missing (no VAT no., no bill no. or no VAT = not a VAT bill)
function vatBillProblem(t) {
  const miss = [];
  if (!String(t.supplier || '').trim()) miss.push('supplier name');
  if (!/^\d{9}$/.test(String(t.supplierPan || '').trim())) miss.push('9-digit VAT/PAN number');
  if (!String(t.billNo || '').trim()) miss.push('bill number');
  if (!(+t.vat > 0)) miss.push('VAT amount');
  return miss.length ? 'Not a VAT bill, so it is left out of the purchase book. Missing: ' + miss.join(', ') + '.' : null;
}

// Register lines for purchases that are not purchase bills: hand-made vouchers (e.g. expenses paid by the CEO) linked to a VAT bill.
// Payments made without an invoice are never register lines. Payments against a supplier's bill are not repeated: the bill is already in the register.
// A payment made to someone who is not a recorded supplier, charged to a fuel expense account
const isFuelPayment = (d, v) => !!(v.pmt && v.pmt.other && (a => eligible(a) && isFuel(a, v))(d.accounts.find(x => x.code === v.pmt.debitAccount)));

// Any payment made to someone who is not a recorded supplier, charged to a purchase-type account (permits, entry fees, etc.), that was left out for having no invoice.
// Like fuel, it may be added by hand after review (v.fuelBook is the shared "added by hand" flag): VAT = 13/113 of the amount paid.
const isBookablePayment = (d, v) => !!(v.pmt && v.pmt.other && eligible(d.accounts.find(x => x.code === v.pmt.debitAccount)));

// Fuel inside a hand-made voucher (journal typed on the New voucher page, e.g. fuel paid by the CEO): the debit lines to a fuel expense account.
// No supplier bill is needed. If the voucher already debits VAT to 1050 that VAT is used; otherwise VAT = 13/113 of the fuel amount (same rule as fuel payments).
// A voucher that has tax invoice details (v.taxInv) is a normal VAT bill and is never treated as fuel.
function fuelJournal(d, v) {
  if (v.pmt || v.sal || v.rcpt || v.purchase || v.refund || v.taxInv || !['Journal', 'Payment'].includes(v.type)) return null;
  if (d.bills.some(b => b.voucherId === v.id)) return null;
  let amt = 0, vat1050 = 0;
  (v.lines || []).forEach(l => { const a = d.accounts.find(x => x.code === l.account); if (l.account === '1050') vat1050 += l.dr - l.cr; else if (eligible(a) && FUEL.test(a.name)) amt += l.dr - l.cr; });
  amt = Math.round(amt * 100) / 100; vat1050 = Math.round(vat1050 * 100) / 100;
  if (amt <= 0) return null;
  const vat = vat1050 > 0 ? vat1050 : vatInTotal(amt), total = vat1050 > 0 ? Math.round((amt + vat1050) * 100) / 100 : amt;
  return { amount: total, vat, taxable: Math.round((total - vat) * 100) / 100, vatBooked: vat1050 > 0 };
}
const isFuelJournal = (d, v) => !!fuelJournal(d, v);

// The supplier is not recorded on a voucher: take the name from the brackets in the narration, e.g. "Being fuel purchase paid by Ram sir (Hari Petrol Pump)"
const supplierFromNarration = n => { const m = String(n || '').match(/\(([^()]+)\)\s*$/); return m ? m[1].trim() : ''; };

// Fuel payments and fuel vouchers that were reviewed and added (v.fuelBook): VAT as worked out above, voucher no. in place of the bill no., no supplier PAN
function fuelVouchers(d) {
  const pay = d.vouchers.filter(v => v.fuelBook && isBookablePayment(d, v)).map(v => {
    const amt = Math.round((+v.pmt.amount || 0) * 100) / 100, vat = vatInTotal(amt), isF = isFuelPayment(d, v), acc = (d.accounts.find(x => x.code === v.pmt.debitAccount) || {}).name || 'Purchase', fb = typeof v.fuelBook === 'object' ? v.fuelBook : {}, what = isF ? 'Fuel' : acc;
    return { id: 'fu' + v.id, kind: 'purchase', fromPayment: 'fuel', fuel: isF, voucher: v.no, voucherId: v.id, billNo: fb.billNo || v.no, supplier: fb.supplier || v.pmt.payee, supplierPan: '', date: v.date, bs: v.bs || '', category: what,
      particulars: v.pmt.note || v.narration || what, note: what + ', voucher ' + v.no + ' (no supplier bill; VAT worked out as 13/113 of the amount paid)', nonTax: 0, taxable: Math.round((amt - vat) * 100) / 100, vat, total: amt };
  });
  const jv = d.vouchers.filter(v => v.fuelBook && !v.taxInv).map(v => ({ v, f: fuelJournal(d, v) })).filter(x => x.f).map(({ v, f }) => ({
    id: 'fu' + v.id, kind: 'purchase', fromPayment: 'fuel', fuel: true, voucher: v.no, voucherId: v.id, billNo: v.fuelBook.billNo || v.no, supplier: (v.fuelBook.supplier) || supplierFromNarration(v.narration) || 'Fuel purchase', supplierPan: '', date: v.date, bs: v.bs || '', category: 'Fuel',
    particulars: v.narration || 'Fuel', note: 'Fuel, voucher ' + v.no + ' (no VAT bill; ' + (f.vatBooked ? 'VAT as booked to 1050' : 'VAT worked out as 13/113 of the amount') + ')', nonTax: 0, taxable: f.taxable, vat: f.vat, total: f.amount }));
  return [...pay, ...jv];
}

function paymentPurchases(d) { return [...invoiceVouchers(d), ...fuelVouchers(d)]; }

function invoiceVouchers(d) {
  return d.vouchers.filter(v => v.taxInv && !vatBillProblem(v.taxInv)).map(v => {
    const t = v.taxInv, nonTax = +t.nonTax || 0, taxable = +t.taxable || 0, vat = +t.vat || 0;

      particulars: v.narration || '', note: 'Voucher ' + v.no + ' (paid on the company\'s behalf)', nonTax, taxable, vat, total: Math.round((nonTax + taxable + vat) * 100) / 100 };
  });
}
